izzyondroid:com.nfcalarmclock.name: NFC Alarm Clock
izzyondroid:com.nfcalarmclock.summary: Customizable and feature-rich alarm clock app.
izzyondroid:com.nfcalarmclock.description:
Customize how your alarms look, easily create/delete alarms, and more. Each alarm can be configured however you want to use it.
 For those that struggle to wake up, you can restrict the volume or have it gradually increase when your alarm goes off. You can also use an NFC card or tag to dismiss your alarm.
 See the full list of features below for a more detailed look into all the things you can do.
 Features: 
 Edit and view alarms all in one screen.
 Swipe left to delete an alarm.
 Swipe right to copy an alarm.
 Play music from your phone to wake up. Can even choose to play all the music in a folder.
 Use NFC to dismiss an alarm. This is optional and can be set on a per-alarm basis. Found by selecting the gear icon next to the volume slider of an alarm.
 Gradually increase the volume when your alarm goes off. This is optional and can be set on a per-alarm basis. Found by selecting the gear icon next to the volume slider of an alarm.
 Restrict changing the volume when your alarm goes off. This is optional and can be set on a per-alarm basis. Found by selecting the gear icon next to the volume slider of an alarm.
 Text-to-speech when your alarm goes off. It will say the current time to you at whatever cadence you choose. This is optional and can be set on a per-alarm basis. Found by selecting the gear icon next to the volume slider of an alarm.
 Choose which audio source you want the alarm sound to play out of (Alarm, Call, Music, Notification, Ringtone). This is optional and can be set on a per-alarm basis. Found by selecting the gear icon next to the volume slider of an alarm.
 Customize the colors of: the theme, name of the alarm, days in which the alarm runs, time, and AM/PM. Found in Settings › Appearance .
 View statistics of how many alarms you have dismissed/snoozed/missed, and how many you have created/deleted.
 Permissions: 
 NFC: (Optional) Allow the app to detect NFC tags.
 Storage: (Optional) Read music that is stored on the phone. You are prompted to enable this permission if and only if you choose to play music as the alarm ringtone. Otherwise, this permission is unused.
 Vibrate: (Optional) Allow the app to vibrate the phone.
 Startup: (Required) Restore alarms when the phone is turned on. By default, Android will delete alarms when the phone is turned off.
 Wakelock: (Required) Prevent the phone from sleeping so that an activated alarm will continue to go off.

izzyondroid:com.nizarmah.igatha.name: Igatha
izzyondroid:com.nizarmah.igatha.description:
Igatha is an offline SOS app designed for emergencies when communication networks fail.
 Igatha: A Lifeline When You Need It Most
 In times of crisis, when traditional communication networks are unavailable, Igatha offers a way to signal for help using Bluetooth technology. Designed for situations like war zones, natural disasters, or remote locations, Igatha operates entirely offline to help you connect with others nearby.
 Features: 
 Offline SOS Broadcasting: Send out an SOS signal via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) without needing internet or cellular service.
 Nearby Signal Detection: Scan for SOS signals from others in your vicinity who may also need assistance.
 Approximate Distance Estimation: Get an idea of how close others are who have sent or received SOS signals.
 Automatic Emergency Detection: The app monitors certain sensor data to detect possible emergencies, such as sudden movements, and can automatically send an SOS signal.
 Important Information: 
 Privacy Respectful: Igatha does not collect or store any personal data. All operations are performed locally on your device.
 Open Source: The app’s source code is available at github.com/nizarmah/igatha. You are welcome to review, contribute, or modify it as needed.
 Limitations: This app is an early version (MVP) and may not function perfectly in all scenarios. Testing has been limited. It is not a guaranteed method of rescue but may provide assistance when no other options are available.
 Who It’s For: 
 Individuals in areas with compromised communication inrastructure.
 People in conflict zones or experiencing natural disasters.
 Anyone who might find themselves without access to traditional communication networks.
 Disclaimer: 
 Igatha is intended to assist in emergencies but should not replace other safety measures. Always use all available resources to ensure your safety.

izzyondroid:top.stevezmt.calsync.name: CalSync - Notification Calendar Sync
izzyondroid:top.stevezmt.calsync.summary: Sync notification time info to calendar automatically
izzyondroid:top.stevezmt.calsync.description:
⚠️ Note: This app is designed specifically for Simplified Chinese environment and only supports Chinese time expression parsing.
 Automatically create calendar events from notifications received from work and social apps by parsing Chinese time expressions.
 Features:
 Automatically recognizes Chinese time expressions in notifications (e.g., "明天下午3点" = tomorrow 3pm, "周五晚上8点" = Friday 8pm)
 Supports rich Chinese relative time parsing ("3天后" = in 3 days, "1个半小时后" = in 1.5 hours)
 Supports fuzzy time expressions ("今晚" = tonight, "下午" = afternoon, "周末" = weekend)
 Customizable keyword filters and app whitelist
 Multiple calendar selection support
 Fully offline, no internet permission required
 Privacy-respecting, data never leaves your device
 Use Cases (Chinese social/work apps):
 WeChat/QQ group notifications: "明天下午3点开会" (meeting tomorrow 3pm)
 Work notifications: "周五晚上8点项目汇报" (project report Friday 8pm)
 Social plans: "下周二一起吃饭" (dinner together next Tuesday)
 Permissions:
 Calendar access: Read and create calendar events
 Notification access: Read system notifications to extract time information
 Foreground service: Keep service running in background
 Exact alarm: Used for crash recovery mechanism
 Query packages: Used for app picker to display installed apps
 This app contains no ads, tracking, or data collection.
 Target audience: Chinese-speaking users who use Chinese messaging and social apps.
 Note: Github Release version uses private signing, although both are built automatically by Actions, the signatures of the two packages are different.

fdroid:com.cleannote.app.name: NearNote
fdroid:com.cleannote.app.summary: Offline notes with location-based reminders, folders, and timeline
fdroid:com.cleannote.app.description:
NearNote is an offline-first notes app with location-based reminders, rich media, folders, and timeline organization.
Superpower of NearNote:
You make a trip for Reason A (your main plan), and NearNote alerts you about an unrelated Task B that happens to be right next to where you are—saving you a dedicated trip later!
Here are relatable daily life examples where your primary reason for visiting has nothing to do with the note:
1. Dropping Kids at School / Soccer Practice
Why you are there: Dropping off or picking up your kid at school or sports practice.
The NearNote alert: "Drop off outdated prescription meds at the civic pharmacy disposal bin across the street."
The "Aha!" moment: You didn't make a special trip to dispose of old medicines, but since you're waiting 10 minutes in the car during pickup right across from that clinic, you get it done immediately.
2. Going to a Restaurant / Cafe for Dinner with Friends
Why you are there: Having Friday night dinner or coffee at a downtown restaurant.
The NearNote alert: "Return borrowed library book / drop off book in the 24/7 library drop box around the corner."
The "Aha!" moment: The book has been in your car/backpack for two weeks because you never found time for a "library trip." Because dinner was in the same block, the drop-box alert lets you return it on your 2-minute walk back to the car.
3. Going to the Cinema / Mall for a Movie
Why you are there: Watching a weekend movie at the shopping complex.
The NearNote alert: "Get watch battery replaced at the kiosk in the lobby" OR "Pick up tailored trousers from the 1st-floor tailor."
The "Aha!" moment: You wouldn't drive all the way to the mall just to change a $5 watch battery or collect one pair of pants. Since the cinema is in that exact building, you drop it off before the movie starts and pick it up right after.
Key Features:
• Location-Based & Exact Reminders: Set geofence alerts that notify you when you arrive at a place, plus scheduled alarms for timely tasks.
• Folder Organization: Group notes into custom folders (Errands, Personal, Work) with quick filtering right from the bottom bar.
• Rich Media Attachments: Attach photos of notes, presentation slides, sketches, and documents directly to your entries.
Privacy & Network:
NearNote is an offline-first app with zero tracking, analytics, or ads. Searching for a place in the location reminder picker uses OpenStreetMap Nominatim online to look up coordinates.

fdroid:com.kunzisoft.keepass.libre.name: KeePassDX Passkey Vault
fdroid:com.kunzisoft.keepass.libre.summary: Manage Passkey / Password in a local and open-source vault
fdroid:com.kunzisoft.keepass.libre.description:
KeePassDX is an open source passkey, password safe and manager allows editing encrypted data in a single file in the open KeePass format and fill in the forms in a secure way , requires no Internet connection and integrates Android design standards. The app is open source, with no advertising .
 Features 
- Passkeys for authentication and local storage of private keys.
- Biometric recognition for fast unlocking (fingerprint / face unlock / …).
- One-time password management (HOTP / TOTP) for two-factor authentication (2FA).
- Autofill for easy form filling with passwords.
- Magikeyboard to efficiently fill in any field.
- Create encrypted database files.
- Organisation of credentials by entry and in group trees.
- Allows opening and copying URI / URL fields quickly.
- Dynamic templates for each type of entry.
- History of each entry.
- Precise management of settings.
- Material design with themes.
- Support for .kdb and .kdbx files (version 1 to 4) with AES - Twofish - ChaCha20 - Argon2 algorithm.
- Compatible with the majority of alternative programs (KeePass, KeePassXC, KeeWeb, …).
- Code written in native languages (Kotlin / Java / JNI / C).
You can donate or buy the pro version for better service and a quick development of features you want: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kunzisoft.keepass.pro 
The project is constantly evolving. Do not hesitate to check the development status of the next updates: https://github.com/Kunzisoft/KeePassDX/projects 
Send issues to: https://github.com/Kunzisoft/KeePassDX/issues

fdroid:com.vladpen.cams.name: Cams
fdroid:com.vladpen.cams.summary: Simple RTSP viewer for IP cameras
fdroid:com.vladpen.cams.description:
Simple Android mobile app for playing RTSP streams from IP cameras
Features:
* View RTSP streams from any IP cameras, including H.265+.
* Multiple video cameras on a single screen.
* Image zoom.
* 2 channel cameras support
* Watching videos via SFTP protocol.

fdroid:com.wchung.qrshare.summary: Generate QR codes on share intent
fdroid:com.wchung.qrshare.description:

fdroid:com.yogeshpaliyal.deepr.name: Deepr
fdroid:com.yogeshpaliyal.deepr.summary: Save links and app deep links. Open them in one tap.
fdroid:com.yogeshpaliyal.deepr.description:
Deepr saves links and app deep links so you can open them again in one tap.
Paste a link, share one to Deepr from any app, or scan a QR code. Deepr fetches the title and preview image, and you can add tags and a note. Your links stay on your phone unless you choose to share them through the local server or back them up. No account is needed, except for Google Drive backup in Deepr Pro.
What you can do:
- Open deep links straight into other apps, not just web pages
- Tag links and filter by one or more tags
- Star favourites and start the app on them
- Sort by newest, most opened, or name
- Pin a link to your home screen as a shortcut
- Keep work and personal links apart with profiles
- Save from the share menu without opening Deepr ("Save silently")
- Manage links from a computer through the built-in local web server and API
- Export to CSV or browser bookmarks (HTML), auto-back up to a folder, or import from CSV and Chrome bookmarks
- Lock the app with your screen lock
Deepr is free and open source: https://github.com/yogeshpaliyal/Deepr

fdroid:de.k3b.android.lossless_jpg_crop.name: LLCrop (loss less)
fdroid:de.k3b.android.lossless_jpg_crop.summary: Loss Less Cropping and Rotation: Remove unwanted parts of jpg photo without qual
fdroid:de.k3b.android.lossless_jpg_crop.description:
LLCrop allows you to either remove unwanted outer areas from
a jpg-photo or to create zoom-ins.
Simply load a JPEG image from the in-app image browser,
adjust the rectangular selection, rotate it if necessary
and save it as a new image file.
While there are many apps capable of cropping images (often with
additional features), they generally cause quality loss because
they re-encode to JPEG again when saving the output file.
LLCrop (the "LL" stands for lossless) can
crop JPEG images without quality loss
because it crops the raw JPEG image without re-encoding the file.
It also preserves embedded metadata (EXIF/IPTC and XMP).

fdroid:de.schildbach.wallet.name: Bitcoin Wallet
fdroid:de.schildbach.wallet.summary: Your own Bitcoins, in your own pocket!
fdroid:de.schildbach.wallet.description:

 FEATURES

• Display of Bitcoin amount in BTC, mBTC and µBTC.
• Conversion to and from national currencies.

• Sweeping of paper wallets (e.g. those used for cold storage).
• App widget for Bitcoin balance.
• Safety: Supports Taproot, Segwit and the new bech32m format.
• Privacy: Supports Tor via the separate Orbot app.
 CONTRIBUTE 
Bitcoin Wallet is open source and free software . License: GPLv3
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html
Our source code is available at GitLab:
https://gitlab.com/bitcoin-wallet/bitcoin-wallet
All translations are managed via Transifex:
https://explore.transifex.com/bitcoin-wallet/bitcoin-wallet/

fdroid:de.westnordost.luftlinie.description:

fdroid:dev.gpxit.app.name: GPXIT
fdroid:dev.gpxit.app.summary: Find train connections home during your bike ride
fdroid:dev.gpxit.app.description:
GPXIT helps cyclists who plan one-way bike routes and need to take a train home. Import your GPX route, and the app discovers train stations along your path. When you're ready to head home, it shows you the best options: which station to ride to, how long you'll wait, and when you'll arrive home.
Features:
- Import GPX routes (share from Komoot or any cycling app)
- Automatic discovery of train stations along your route
- "Take me home" — see all upcoming stations with cycling time, wait time, and connections
- Search for nearby stations anywhere on the map
- Detailed connection info with intermediate stops and changes
- Navigate to any station via your preferred map app
- Download map tiles for offline use
- Shops, bakeries, drinking water, toilets and bike repair along your route, with opening hours — offline, for the countries you choose
- Configurable transport types (regional trains, S-Bahn, U-Bahn, tram, bus, ferry)
- Optional ICE/IC/EC long-distance connections
- Transit data via Deutsche Bahn (covers German and international connections), plus Rejseplanen, Resrobot and Traveline where DB is weak, and optionally the community-run Transitous service
Privacy:
- No tracking, no analytics, no accounts
- All data stays on your device
- Location is only used to show your position on the map
- Internet is used only for map tiles (OpenStreetMap), transit queries (Deutsche Bahn; Rejseplanen, Resrobot or Traveline for places they cover; Transitous only if enabled) and downloading the offline POI data (GitHub)

fdroid:io.github.keco216.clockwork.name: Clockwork: 2FA Authenticator
fdroid:io.github.keco216.clockwork.summary: Offline 2FA authenticator: TOTP codes, no network permission, no accounts.
fdroid:io.github.keco216.clockwork.description:
Clockwork is a two-factor authenticator (2FA) that generates TOTP codes entirely on your device. It declares no INTERNET permission at all — the app cannot open a connection, and you can check that in the manifest before you believe a word of this.
That is the difference. Most authenticator apps hold network access for sync, service icons or update checks. Clockwork does not have the permission, so the question never comes up.
WHAT IT DOES
• Generates TOTP codes (RFC 6238) — SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512, 6 to 8 digits, any period.
• Add accounts the way you happen to have them: scan a QR code, import a QR image, paste an otpauth:// link, or type a Base32 secret. A full Google Authenticator export is converted automatically.
• A dial with 30 marks and a moving hand shows the time left — a position you read at a glance, not a shrinking bar.
• One tap copies the code, and the next one is on screen before it becomes valid.
• Broken input is explained line by line, never silently swallowed.
YOUR SECRETS STAY YOURS
• By default nothing is stored at all. Close the app and the secrets are gone.
• Switch the vault on and they stay here, encrypted with your passphrase: AES-256-GCM, key derived by PBKDF2-SHA-256 with 600,000 iterations. Only the sealed envelope is written to disk — never the plaintext, never the passphrase, never the derived key.
• Unlock with your fingerprint if you want to. The passphrase stays the only way back in.
• Locks automatically after a time you choose and when you leave the app. Screenshots and preview images can be blocked.
• Android backup is switched off, so the encrypted vault never leaves the device.
PRIVACY
Nothing is collected, because there is nowhere for it to go. No analytics, no telemetry, no update pings, no advertising identifiers, no accounts, no ads. The camera permission serves the QR scanner alone and is declared optional hardware — importing a QR image works without it.
BUILT TO BE CHECKED
Open source under the MIT licence. The OTP algorithms are written from scratch against the RFC test vectors — no OTP library. Source code, test suite and the measurement scripts behind every claim above are public at github.com/keco216/clockwork.
Speaks 37 languages, all bundled, including right-to-left layouts.
Android 8.0 or newer. On Android 7, 1.5.4 stays the final version.
One thing, independent of this app: set up backup codes with every provider before you rely on any authenticator. They are the only thing that gets you back in when a secret is gone.

fdroid:io.github.revocx35.npmmobile.name: NPM Mobile
fdroid:io.github.revocx35.npmmobile.summary: Native Android client for Nginx Proxy Manager: hosts, SSL, access lists, users
fdroid:io.github.revocx35.npmmobile.description:
NPM Mobile manages your Nginx Proxy Manager (NPM) server from your phone. It is a native app, not a web wrapper: it talks directly to your server's API, with no cloud service in between and no tracking.
 Features 
 Dashboard: host counts, NPM update notice, and a list of problems (hosts whose nginx config failed, certificates expiring soon)
 Proxy hosts: create, edit, enable/disable and delete; domains, forward scheme/host/port, caching, exploit blocking, websockets, access lists, custom locations, SSL (force SSL, HTTP/2, HSTS) and custom nginx configuration
 Redirection hosts, streams (TCP/UDP) and 404 hosts 
 SSL certificates: request Let's Encrypt certificates (HTTP or DNS challenge with any provider NPM supports), test domain reachability, renew, download, delete, and upload custom certificates with validation
 Access lists: basic-auth users and allow/deny IP rules
 Users (admins): accounts, roles, per-section permissions and passwords
 Audit log and the default site setting
 Your account: profile, password, and two-factor authentication (QR code setup, backup codes); 2FA sign-in is supported
 Several NPM servers, automatic session renewal, light/dark theme and Material You colors
Session tokens are stored encrypted with a key from the Android Keystore. Plain HTTP is allowed for LAN addresses (NPM's admin UI usually runs on port 81); for HTTP to a public address the app warns you first.
Tested with Nginx Proxy Manager 2.15. This is an unofficial app, not affiliated with the Nginx Proxy Manager project.

fdroid:io.github.sds100.keymapper.name: Key Mapper
fdroid:io.github.sds100.keymapper.summary: Make shortcuts for ANYTHING! Remap volume, power, keyboard, or floating buttons!
fdroid:io.github.sds100.keymapper.description:
Make custom macros on your keyboard or gamepad, make on-screen buttons in any app, and unlock new functionality from your volume buttons!
Key Mapper supports a huge variety of buttons and keys*:
- ALL your phone buttons (volume AND side key)
- Game controllers (D-pad, ABXY, and most others)
- Keyboards
- Headsets and headphones
- Fingerprint sensor
Not enough keys? Design your own on-screen button layouts and remap those just like real keys!
What shortcuts can I make?
--------------------------
With over 100 individual actions, the sky is the limit.
Build complex macros with screen taps and gestures, keyboard inputs, open apps, control media, and even send intents directly to other apps.
How much control do I have?
---------------------------
TRIGGERS: You decide how to trigger a key map. Long press, double press, press as many times as you like! Combine keys on different devices, and even include your on-screen buttons.
ACTIONS: Design specific macros for what you want to do. Combine over 100 actions, and choose the delay between each one. Set repeating actions to automate and speed up slow tasks.
CONSTRAINTS: You choose when key maps should run and when they shouldn't. Only need it in one specific app? Or when media is playing? On your lockscreen? Constrain your key maps for maximum control.
* Most devices are already supported, with new devices being added over time. Let us know if it's not working for you and we can prioritize your device.
Not currently supported:
 - Mouse buttons
 - Joysticks and triggers (LT,RT) on gamepads
Security and accessibility services
---------------------------
This app includes our Key Mapper Accessibility service that uses the Android Accessibility API to detect the app in focus and adapt key presses to user-defined key maps. It is also used to draw assistive Floating Button overlays on top of other apps.
By accepting to run the accessibility service, the app will monitor key strokes while you're using your device. It will also emulate swipes and pinches if you are using those actions in the app.
It will NOT collect any user data or connect to the internet to send any data anywhere.
Our accessibility service is only triggered by the user when pressing a physical key on their device. It can be turned off any time by the user in the system accessibility settings.

keymapper.app/discord
See the code for yourself! (Open source)

Read the documentation:
keymapper.app

fdroid:tech.mmarca.openvitals.description:
OpenVitals is a private health dashboard for Android. It shows your Health Connect data in one place: activity, sleep, heart, body, vitals, nutrition, hydration, caffeine, mindfulness and, if you want it, cycle tracking.
Your data stays on your phone. There is no account, no cloud sync, no ads and no analytics, and the app has no internet permission. OpenVitals reads Health Connect only after you grant access, and it writes only the entries you save.
What you can do
* See your day on a dashboard you can reorder
* Explore each metric by day, week, month or year, with trends, goals and your personal baseline
* Check Daily Readiness, Body Energy, Training Readiness, stress, HRV status, cardio load and sleep score, each with a plain explanation of how it is worked out
* Log drinks, food, workouts, mindfulness, weight, body fat, blood pressure, blood oxygen, temperature and more, straight into Health Connect
* Follow your caffeine: active amount, daily limit and a bedtime forecast
* Record GPS workouts with live stats, offline maps and Bluetooth heart rate, cadence and power sensors
* Import Apple Health exports and GPX, KML, KMZ, TCX, FIT and CSV files
* Build a PDF health report to share with your doctor
* Track your cycle: periods, symptoms, basal temperature, next-period estimates and pill reminders
* Copy data between two phones over Bluetooth, with no account and no network
* Earn badges for steps, distance, floors, workouts, hydration, sleep and mindfulness
* Turn on reminders for drinking, mindfulness and your cycle
* Choose metric or imperial units, a light, dark or AMOLED theme, and one of 14 languages
Why OpenVitals
* Private by design: no account, no cloud, no ads, no tracking
* Health Connect stays the source of truth. Only watch measurements and cycle notes that Health Connect cannot store are kept in the app, on your phone
* You choose each permission and can change it later
* Open source: the code, release notes and builds are public
Requirements
OpenVitals needs Health Connect. It is part of Android 14 and newer. On Android 13 and older, install the Health Connect app from Google Play.
Health disclaimer
OpenVitals is for general wellness and information only. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or medical condition. Cycle estimates are not a method of contraception. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

Welcome to MUBI: Apple TV App of the Year. Discover great films, from iconic directors to emerging artists. From everywhere around the world. Each carefully chosen by MUBI’s curators.
Stream or download beautiful movies, anytime. On any screen or device, anywhere.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
MUBI offers a monthly and a yearly auto-renewing subscription with a 7 day free trial period.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms and conditions: https://mubi.com/terms_of_service
Privacy policy: https://mubi.com/privacy_policy
Support: http://help.mubi.com
If you have any problems, comments or suggestions for improving our app, please contact us at support@mubi.com.
USER NOTES
A Wi-Fi connection is recommended for quality viewing and downloading of films. A weak cellular connection may result in interrupted playback.
The content available on MUBI may vary by region.
Some titles shown above may not be available in your country.

apple-itunes:962923207.description:
Goodnight - The Voice Dating App.
Talk first, swipe less. Match and chat, meet singles nearby, and turn conversations into real connections.
Tired of endlessly swiping on regular dating apps? 
Here, your voice can spark everything from delightful coffee chats to dream dates.
You don’t need perfect selfies or clever pickup lines. Just pick up the phone, join a live chat, and let your personality shine. Talk, laugh, share - it’s all about real conversations that bring singles together.
Voice Interaction · Meaningful Engagement
Exchange ideas and daily stories through voice.
Build connections based on shared interests and values.
Continue conversations naturally with friends you choose to connect with.

Emphasis on voice and meaningful interaction rather than appearance

Unlock additional features like more exposure and advanced filtering
Core voice and community functions are free to use

Open Goodnight and let your voice start a meaningful conversation.

Privacy Policy: https://goodnight.io/privacy

apple-macos:1530838633.name: KeyBell • Mechanical keyboard
apple-macos:1530838633.description:
You will fall in love with this utility app. KeyBell plays a relaxing and nostalgic mechanical sound every time you type something on your keyboard.
You can choose from multiple sound profiles, including modern ones, and the app stays in the background without ever interrupting your workflow.
It works on your entire Mac, in all apps, including Mail, Office, Pages, Notes or browsers.
It's perfect if you write a lot on your computer because the sound feedback gives you a productivity boost and you will want to type even more. It's designed for journalists, writers, bloggers, programmers or anyone who wants to liven up a boring, silent keyboard.
FEATURES
• Get sound feedback for keystrokes and mouse clicks in any app on your computer
• Select from more than 25 sound profiles organized in 5 categories: Mechanical Keyboards, Typewriters, Electronics, Fun and Mouse clicks
• Custom profiles for applications - deactivate or play different sounds for different applications
• Automatically enable the app when you wear headphones, only on speakers, or always
• Configurable hotkeys for activation, volume and other actions
• Very effective and addictive productivity tool
• Small utility, easy to understand and use
SUPPORT
We read your support emails every day.
Write with confidence any question, feedback, or complaint, and you will receive an answer in a very short period of time.

flathub:ar.com.pilas_engine.App.description:
Ideamos esta herramienta para que los jóvenes puedan descubrir y aprender a programar computadoras. Creemos que aprender a programar es espectacular, porque les permite tener el control de las computadora, inventar y desarrollar cualquier tipo de software.

flathub:com.dreamsourcelab.DSView.name: DSView
flathub:com.dreamsourcelab.DSView.summary: An open source multi-function instrument for everyone
flathub:com.dreamsourcelab.DSView.description:
DSView is a GUI program for supporting various instruments from DreamSourceLab, including logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, etc. DSView is based on the sigrok project.
 The sigrok project aims at creating a portable, cross-platform, Free/Libre/Open-Source signal analysis software suite that supports various device types (such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, multimeters, and more).
 It is necessary to add the following line to the /etc/udev/rules.d/60-dreamsourcelab.rules file:
 SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTRS{idVendor}=="2a0e", MODE="0666"

flathub:org.contourterminal.Contour.name: Contour Terminal Emulator
flathub:org.contourterminal.Contour.summary: Contour is a modern and actually fast, modal, virtual terminal emulator, for everyday use
flathub:org.contourterminal.Contour.description:
Contour is a modern and actually fast, modal, virtual terminal emulator,
 for everyday use. It is aiming for power users with a modern feature mindset.
 Available on all major platforms, Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, Windows.
 GPU-accelerated rendering.
 Font ligatures support (such as in Fira Code).
 Unicode: Emoji support (-: 🌈 💝 😛 👪 - including ZWJ, VS15, VS16 emoji :-)
 Unicode: Grapheme cluster support
 Bold and italic fonts
 High-DPI support.
 Vertical Line Markers (quickly jump to markers in your history!)
 Vi-like input modes for improved selection and copy'n'paste experience and Vi-like scrolloff feature.
 Blurred behind transparent background when using Windows 10 or KDE window manager on Linux.
 Blurrable Background image support.
 Runtime configuration reload
 256-color and Truecolor support
 Key binding customization
 Color Schemes
 Profiles (grouped customization of: color scheme, login shell, and related behaviors)
 Synchronized rendering
 Text reflow (configurable via SM ? 2028 / RM ? 2028)
 Clickable hyperlinks via OSC 8
 Clipboard setting via OSC 52
 Sixel inline images
 Terminal page buffer capture VT extension
 Builtin Fira Code inspired progress bar support.
 Read-only mode, protecting against accidental user-input to the running application, such as Ctrl+C.
 VT320 Host-programmable and Indicator status line support.
 Size indicator on resize.
 and much more ...

fedora-packages:ebtables/ebtables-legacy.description: Ethernet bridge tables is a firewalling tool to transparently filter network traffic passing a bridge. The filtering possibilities are limited to link layer filtering and some basic filtering on higher network layers. This tool is the userspace control for the bridge and ebtables kernel components (built by default in Fedora kernels). The ebtables tool can be used together with the other Linux filtering tools, like iptables. There are no known incompatibility issues. Note that it is considered legacy upstream since nftables provides the same functionality in a much newer code-base. To aid in migration, there is ebtables-nft utility, a drop-in replacement for the legacy one which uses nftables internally. It is provided by iptables-nft package.

fedora-packages:erlang-riak_ensemble/erl.name: erlang-riak_ensemble
fedora-packages:erlang-riak_ensemble/erl.description: A consensus library that supports creating multiple consensus groups (ensembles). Each ensemble is a separate Multi-Paxos instance with its own leader, set of members, and state. Each ensemble also supports an extended API that provides consistent key/value operations. Conceptually, this is identical to treating each key as a separate Paxos entity. However, this isn't accomplished by having each key maintain its own Paxos group. Instead, an ensemble emulates per-key consensus through a combination of per-key and per-ensemble state.

fedora-packages:flare-engine/flare-engin.description: Flare (Free Libre Action Roleplaying Engine) is a simple game engine built to handle a very specific kind of game: single-player 2D action RPGs. Flare is not a re-implementation of an existing game or engine. It is a tribute to and exploration of the action RPG genre. Rather than building a very abstract, robust game engine, the goal of this project is to build several real games and harvest an engine from the common, reusable code. The first game, in progress, is a fantasy dungeon crawl. Flare uses simple file formats (INI style config files) for most of the game data, allowing anyone to easily modify game contents. Open formats are preferred (png, ogg). The game code is C++. This package contains the engine only.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-io/gap-pkg-io.name: gap-pkg-io
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-io/gap-pkg-io.description: This GAP package provides a link to the standard UNIX I/O functionality that is available through the C library. This part basically consists of functions on the GAP level that allow functions in the C library to be called. Built on top of this is a layer for buffered input/output which is implemented completely in the GAP language. It is intended to be used by programs for which it is not necessary to have full direct access to the operating system. On this level, quite a few convenience functions are implemented for interprocess communication like starting up pipelines of processes to filter data through them and to start up processes and then communicate with them. There is also support for creating network connections over TCP/IP and UDP. Building on this, the package contains an implementation of the client side of the HTTP protocol making it possible among other things to access web pages from within GAP. Another part of the package is a framework for object serialization. That is, GAP objects can be converted into a platform-independent byte sequence which can be stored to a file or sent over the network. The code takes complete care of arbitrarily self-referential data structures like lists containing themselves as an entry. The resulting byte strings can be read back into GAP and the original objects are rebuilt with exactly the same self-references. This works for most of the standard builtin types of GAP like numbers, permutations, polynomials, lists, and records and can be extended to nearly arbitrary GAP objects.

fedora-packages:python-hl7/python3-hl7.description: python-hl7 is a simple library for parsing messages of Health Level 7 (HL7) version 2.x into Python objects. python-hl7 includes a simple client that can send HL7 messages to a Minimal Lower Level Protocol (MLLP) server (mllp_send). HL7 is a communication protocol and message format for health care data. It is the de-facto standard for transmitting data between clinical information systems and between clinical devices. The version 2.x series, which is often is a pipe delimited format is currently the most widely accepted version of HL7 (there is an alternative XML-based format).

fedora-packages:python-shamir-mnemonic/p.name: python3-shamir-mnemonic
fedora-packages:python-shamir-mnemonic/p.summary: Reference implementation of SLIP-0039: Shamir’s Secret-Sharing for Mnemonic Codes
fedora-packages:python-shamir-mnemonic/p.description: This SLIP describes a standard and interoperable implementation of Shamir's secret sharing (SSS). SSS splits a secret into unique parts which can be distributed among participants, and requires a specified minimum number of parts to be supplied in order to reconstruct the original secret. Knowledge of fewer than the required number of parts does not leak information about the secret.

fedora-packages:python-utmp/python3-utmp.name: python3-utmp
fedora-packages:python-utmp/python3-utmp.description: python-utmp consists of three modules, providing access to utmp records. It is quite difficult to access utmp record portably, because every UNIX has different structure of utmp files. Currently, python-utmp works on platforms which provide getutent, getutid, getutline, pututline, setutent, endutent and utmpname functions (such as GNU systems (Linux and hurd) and System V unices) and on BSD systems using simple utmp structure.

fedora-packages:q4wine/q4wine.name: q4wine

fedora-packages:remctl/remctl.name: remctl
fedora-packages:remctl/remctl.description: remctl (the client) and remctld (the server) implement a client/server protocol for running single commands on a remote host using Kerberos v5 authentication and returning the output. They use a very simple GSS-API-authenticated network protocol, combined with server-side ACL support and a server configuration file that maps remctl commands to programs that should be run when that command is called by an authorised user.

firefox-addons:1001698.name: xBrowserSync
firefox-addons:1001698.summary: Browser syncing as it should be: secure, anonymous and free! Sync bookmarks across your browsers and devices, no sign up required.
firefox-addons:1001698.description:
xBrowserSync is a completely free and open source tool for syncing your bookmarks and browser data between your desktop browsers. xBrowserSync respects your privacy and gives you complete anonymity — no sign up is required and no personal data is ever collected. It is also completely secure; your data is encrypted client-side with military grade encryption, Even if someone intercepted your data, only you can decrypt it.
xBrowserSync enriches your bookmarks with the addition of descriptions and tags. An intuitive search interface lets you find bookmarks quickly and easily, or simply browse your bookmarks hierarchy by folders. And don’t ever worry about losing your data thanks to the included back up and restore functionality.
The web extension fully supports your native desktop browser bookmarking features; xBrowserSync will preserve your existing bookmarks hierarchy and any changes you make using the native bookmarking functionality are synced by xBrowserSync automatically. xBrowserSync will even add metadata to new bookmarks automatically!
With the xBrowserSync mobile app you can use xBrowserSync on the go with your Android device. Once you have created a new sync on your desktop browser using the web extension, simply scan your sync ID code into the app and enter your password to connect to your synced data. Add new bookmarks easily by sharing from your favourite apps (browsers, YouTube, Spotify and any other app that shares URLs), xBrowserSync will even populate the bookmark properties for you.
For ultimate privacy, configure your very own xBrowserSync cloud service on your Linux or Windows server to sync to. The code for the xBrowserSync cloud service is open source and is easy to set up for any relatively tech savvy individual.
Welcome to browser syncing as it should be: secure, anonymous and free!
Key features: 
★ Sync bookmarks between desktop browsers (syncing of additional browser data will be added in future versions), and access bookmarks on the move using the xBrowserSync Android app.
★ Absolutely free, there are no charges for using the service. Ever.
★ Totally anonymous, no sign up or submission of personal data required, just install and sync.
★ Encrypts your browser data client-side using military grade encryption that only you can decrypt.
★ Browse, find, modify and share bookmarks quickly and easily.
★ Enrich your bookmarks with descriptions and tags.
★ Works with native desktop browser bookmarking features.
★ Add bookmarks with the mobile app by sharing from your favourite apps.
★ Share bookmarks with friends with the mobile app.
★ Back up and restore your synced data for total peace of mind.
★ Run your very own xBrowserSync cloud service for syncing in complete privacy.
For more information visit www.xbrowsersync.org .
 Important: There are known issues when using the native Firefox bookmark features with xBrowserSync, please review them carefully before use.

In order to work with this add-on, please open a webpage that contains HTML5 video elements. Then, play a desired video element and open toolbar popup UI. Within the UI, adjust the playback speed and then click on the - green - check mark button. The playback speed will be changed according to the value shown in the popup.

firefox-addons:931997.name: Download Images From Tabs
firefox-addons:931997.summary: Download images from tabs to the left, right or from the current tab. You can select links and open them in new tabs for download.
firefox-addons:931997.description:
The main purpose of this addon is to download images from tabs more easily.
 Features: 
- Easy image download from tabs to the left, to the right or only from the current tab.
- Essential settings like auto close tabs, save only the biggest image on the tab, subfolder in the downloads directory and minimum sizes for landscape and portrait images.
- Select links on any page and open them in new tabs, or open and immediately start downloading from these tabs.
- Context menus all over the place for more convenient use.
- One click mode if you need a faster approach.
- Basic duplicate checks, images with identical urls are not saved twice in the same download session.
 How to: 
- one click - right click on the addon icon (on the toolbar) and select "enable one click mode" (to disable do the same), when enabled you can left click on the addon icon to trigger download of the images (using current settings)
- context menu places - when you right click on any page, on link or selected links, the addon icon.
What you CANNOT do with this addon:
- Multitasking, you need to wait while previous download is finished before starting a new one.
- Download images if they cannot be accessed directly, e.g. protected by authorization, cookies or referrer header (API limitations).
- Download images to folder of your choice, you can save images only in a subfolder under your firefox downloads directory (API limitations).
- Download dynamic images whose url starts with "data:image..." and not usual https etc.
 Default settings: 
download images from tabs on the right
min portrait size: 56x100px
min landscape size: 100x56px
save only largest image from tab
close tabs after download
If this addon was helpful, please consider making a small donation to support ME , just kidding... future development.

bluejetty:00003931:ios.name: Community College Hero
bluejetty:00003931:ios.summary:
Outwit your professors at superpower school! Ace your exams, date your classmates, and bring down the nation’s most wanted villains to earn your degree.
"Community College Hero: Trial by Fire" is a thrilling 168,000-word interactive novel
bluejetty:00003931:ios.description:
Outwit your professors at superpower school! Ace your exams, date your classmates, and bring down the nation’s most wanted villains to earn your degree.
"Community College Hero: Trial by Fire" is a thrilling 168,000-word interactive novel by Eric Moser, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based--without graphics or sound effects--and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
You’ve won a scholarship to the nation’s newest college course for heroes! But can you discover your classmates’ secret identities before they learn yours? Choose your costume and your mask (and maybe your date for this weekend) and get ready to fight crime and dazzle the citizenry! Be an acrobat, sharpshooter, detective, or soldier, with all the abilities that come with each. Wield brass knuckles, a slingshot, or even retractable roller skates in your shoes. Will you investigate the big bad, or wait until you’ve had more training? Escape liability for damaging other people’s property as you learn to control your new powers, or pay up what you owe? 
Will you be a brooder, charmer, traditionalist, or trickster? Step into your new super identity, and claim your place as a Community College Hero!
• Learn to become a costumed crime fighter at the nation’s newest hero-training school in this 176,000-word comic book-inspired adventure!
• Strive to stop a mysterious new villain causing chaos in your city!
• Fully customize your character! Will you be a wisecracking acrobat? A brooding detective? A charming sharpshooter? The choice is yours!
• Everyone seems to have a secret! Will you uncover your classmates’ secrets and protect your own?
• Find romance among six potential romantic interests, embark on crazy adventures with your classmates, and ace your exams to earn cool equipment upgrades.
• Explore every side adventure, relationship and study session to discover 46 different accomplishments!
• Play as male, female or non-binary.
• Play as gay, straight, bisexual or asexual.

bluejetty:00062003:ios.description:
*Nurturing Bonds, One Story at a Time*
TRANSFORM BEDTIME WITH STORYBOOK
Welcome to Storybook, the award-winning app designed to help parents improve their children's sleep, manage anxiety, and boost self-esteem through guided relaxation techniques, narrated bedtime stories, affirmations, and soothing music. Trusted by over 3 million families worldwide, Storybook creates meaningful, screen-free bedtime routines that build a lasting bond between parents and children. 
***Storybook is recommended by leading psychologists, therapists, and child well-being experts.***
Benefits for Families:
• STRENGTHEN FAMILY BONDS: Create special moments and deepen your connection with your children through engaging stories and relaxing massages.
• PROMOTE DEEP SLEEP: Encourage restful sleep and minimize nightmares with our expert-designed sessions. Develop healthy sleep habits that ensure peaceful nights.
•BOOST SELF-ESTEEM: Build your child's confidence and self-worth through positive affirmations and soothing bedtime routines that promote emotional well-being and resilience.
•MANAGE ANXIETY: Help your child navigate and reduce anxiety with calming techniques and guided meditations designed specifically for children.
•HOLISTIC HEALTH BENEFITS: Reduce muscle and headache pain naturally, improve mood, stimulate the digestive system, and more. Foster a positive home atmosphere with our calming routines.
Discover Storybook:
Storybook offers over 400 content tracks and more than 100 massage techniques for children 0-12, with new weekly content. Our app is easy to use – simply follow the techniques and enjoy the audio stories together. Or meditate, pray, express gratitude, listen to powerful affirmations, or enjoy a white noise music session. We also feature special Catholic and Bible stories and content for children and families to enjoy and reflect on together.
Features:
• GUIDED RELAXATION & MASSAGES Easy-to-follow techniques and enjoy a unique bonding experience with your children. Designed by certified sleep experts and backed up by science!
• NARRATED BEDTIME STORIES Listen to beautifully narrated stories that encourage values, captivate your children’s imagination, and help them wind down for the night.
• AFFIRMATIONS (DAY AND NIGHT) Boost your child’s self-esteem and confidence with positive affirmations that set the tone for a positive day and peaceful night.
• GUIDED MEDITATIONS Help your child relax and manage anxiety with guided meditations designed specifically for their needs.
• GRATITUDES & PRAYERS Encourage a sense of gratitude and mindfulness with nightly prayers and gratitude exercises.
• SONGS Listen together to powerful songs that will help your child understand key messages and values, while enjoying a screen-free experience.
• SOOTHING MUSIC & SOUNDS Create a serene environment with calming music and ambient sounds that promote relaxation and deep sleep.
• SCIENTIFICALLY BACKED METHODS Our techniques are supported and backed by research and scientific evidence, showing that infant massage reduces stress, increases oxytocin levels, lowers cortisol levels, and supports neurological and muscular development.
• EASY-TO-USE INTERFACE User-friendly design ensures a hassle-free experience for parents and children alike. 
Certifications:
• FSI (Family Sleep Institute) 
• IMUSA (Infant Massage USA)
• KidSAFE 
• Recommended by Harvard experts
Pricing:
Start your free trial and experience better sleep routines, a calmer home, a confident child, and a happier family. Subscription is priced at $59.99/year for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
***Join millions of families already enjoying Storybook. Download now!***
Additional Resources:
• Support: info@familify.com
• Privacy Policy: https://www.storybook-app.com/privacy-policy
• Terms of Service: https://www.storybook-app.com/user-agreement

Join over 200,000 users! Reload is the #1 Science-backed app that is built for you to improve your habits, stay focused and lock in within 60 days. We generate you a custom plan that’s fully customisable and tailored to your needs. We are trusted by thousands during their self improvement journey. 
Track your progress, create habits and use our RR (Reload Rating) system to help build consistency. Finish tasks, earn XP and watch as you get one step closer to your goals.

- Enable extreme mode to truly challenge yourself.
- Visualise your progress with habit heatmaps and timers.
- Built in community with people on the same journey as you.

- Use our productivity tools to help you on your life reset journey.

- Improve your focus, discipline and productivity.
- Feel calmer and more in control.
- Reach your goals faster.
- Boost your mental clarity without relying on willpower.

bluejetty:00147256:ios.description: BURN LA! Download the App to book your spot with us in one of our Los Angeles studio locations. From the App you can select studio locations, view class schedules, make class reservations, view your existing reservation, buy classes and manage your account. BURN Studios founded and created by Maria Chase is a results driven workout and studio concept backed by science! BURN is wellness studio offering customized group fitness classes in LED/NIR Red + Blue Light, Infrared Heat Therapy BURN Method classes are RESULTS driven and uniquely developed by Maria Chase with a strategic approach to effectively redesigning the physique, boosting the metabolism by building lean muscle to BURN more fat. Classes range from our foundational BURN45, a weighted swift succession style class, to ISOBURN, a Pilates and Sculpt based Isometric sequencing workout. Each class offers a unique and wholistic approach to muscular design and conditioning resulting in a balanced, beautiful and strong physique for all fitness levels. Classes range from 45-60 minutes and are designed to be easily modified to accommodate all levels from beginner to advanced. We believe weights are the fountain of youth and a key component to an efficient fat burning workout. Optional weights we use in the studio include dumbbells 1-12lbs, resistant bands light-heavy, ankle weights 1-6lbs and sliders. Join our community @burn_LA on instagram

bluejetty:00153100:ios.description:
A SokkerPRO foi criada em 2014, por apostadores profissionais, hoje seu app é o mais completo, veja as principais funcionalidades:
• Live Score
Pode acompanhar os jogos em tempo real, com o mínimo de delay possível
• Estatísticas ao vivo
São várias estatísticas para você acompanhar em tempo real
• Prognósticos Pré Live
Baseado em matemática, nós disponibilizamos prognóstico para a suas apostas em cada jogo
• Premium Tips
As dicas da SokkerPRO que fazem muito sucesso estará aqui, com o seu serviço Corner DoubleUP, um sistema novo de apostas em cantos, além de seleções para apostas de " Ambas Marcam" entre outras apostas
• Prognóstico de Especialistas
Temos um time de especialistas que fornece suas apostas, para você lucrar junto com eles, pré live e live
• Race to Goal
Funcionalidade exclusiva que só encontra em nosso app, agora ficou claro ver qual o time está mais próximo de marcar um gol
• Advanced Search
Ficou mais fácil encontrar jogos ao vivo, você pode pesquisar apenas jogos com o time da casa perdendo por exemplo, para apostar nos cantos
• Corner Prediction
Um algoritmo exclusivo com uma grande taxa de acerto para o mercado de Cantos
• Live Alert
Criamos um robô, que analisa todos os jogos ao vivo em tempo real, e baseado em número, irá informar a você situações como: Equipe perto de marcar ou tomar um gol, jogos com tendência a sair cantos, Possibilidade de uma equipe ganhar o jogo, Momento do jogo, e muito mais
O melhor, tudo isso com notificações em seu smartphone, para não perder nenhuma oportunidade
Isso é só uma parte do que pode encontrar em nosso aplicativo

Exercise your brain and become a merge master with Dice Merge, the brand new match and merge puzzle game from Mobilityware!
Drag and drop customizable dice blocks onto the puzzle board and try to make your match! The value of the die is associated with its color. Create and collect ruby gems by matching 3 of the same color dice in order to merge into higher values. Keep merging until you form a ruby.

SMART

CHALLENGING
- As your strategy improves, you can earn different boosters that will help you master each objective-based level!
UNIQUE
- Customize your background and dice to reflect your personality!
TIMELESS
- No time limit - no pressure!
We value your feedback!
Please contact us at support@mobilityware.com

bluejetty:00040949:ios.name: Mares App
bluejetty:00040949:ios.summary:
APPLE WATCH ULTRA DIVE COMPUTER
Transform your Ultra into a dive computer. Record dives directly on your wrist and sync automatically to the Mares App. (In-app purchase required.)
DIGITAL LOGBOOK: Log your Scuba, Freediving, Extended Range
bluejetty:00040949:ios.description:
APPLE WATCH ULTRA DIVE COMPUTER
Transform your Ultra into a dive computer. Record dives directly on your wrist and sync automatically to the Mares App. (In-app purchase required.)
DIGITAL LOGBOOK: Log your Scuba, Freediving, Extended Range and Rebreather (SCR/CCR) dives in seconds via Bluetooth. Easily share your dives via QR code. Add new dives with your device’s GPS and download your dives from selected dive computers (1*).
DIVE SITES: With the help of the Mares dive site database, you can immediately assign a dive site to your logged dives. You can also add your own private dive sites and share them with your dive buddies using a QR code. You can download your dive data directly from selected Mares dive computers .
WILDLIFE: A variety of local wildlife is already stored in the app for individual dive sites. This means you can immediately assign the highlights of your underwater encounters to your logged dives. Your sightings are displayed on your personal world map.
DIVE BUDDIES: Easily add your dive buddies via QR code or manually in the app. Share your best dives and most exciting animal encounters with friends using the Mares app.
STATISTICS: All your dives and data can be seen at a glance, including your longest or deepest dive, your average dive time and more!
DIGITAL EQUIPMENT: Store important dive equipment details, including serial numbers, photos and invoices. Enter maintenance dates and keep track of when your equipment needs to be serviced.
NEWS AND VIDEOS: Stay up-to-date with all the latest news and videos from the world of water sports and diving.
FIRMWARE: When you connect your dive computer to the app, you will be able to confirm if you have the latest firmware. As soon as it is outdated, you will receive a message regarding the newest firmware to download.
TABLES: Here you will find useful information such as decompression tables and emergency scenarios.
1* Currently available for MARES Sirius, Sirius L, Sirius Hunter, Horizon, Genius, Quad CI, Quad 2, Quad Air, Quad, Puck 4, Puck Pro EZ, Puck lite, Puck Pro, Puck Pro Plus, Puck Air 2, Smart, Smart Apnea, Smart Air
Terms of Use (EULA) Mares App for Apple Watch Ultra: https://my.divessi.com/published/viewhls/awu_terms_v1/2

· Solve jigsaw puzzles with cat Kiki!
· Get bouncy and collect stars with dog Fifi at the pool!

· Bake a rainbow cake with giraffe Gigi!

Help the little animals escape the bubbles and get ready for a fun party! Play cute pet care, fashion salon and cooking mini games! Dance at the coolest party, pop as many bubbles as you can and unlock sparkly collectibles!

Time to make your virtual pet friends look fabulous! Create fancy hairstyles, style party outfits and add cute accessories!

Don't forget to feed your little animals before the party! Mmm, look at all these yummies!

Play fun mini games with each of the virtual pets:
· Solve jigsaw puzzles with cat Kiki!
· Get bouncy and collect stars with dog Fifi at the pool!
· Jump on the clouds with rabbit Riri!
· Run and collect candies with tiger Lili!
· Bake a rainbow cake with giraffe Gigi!

Kiki & Fifi game series follows fun adventures of the cutest virtual pet friends. Join them and play fun pet care, beauty salon, Halloween makeover and animal hotel games for girls and boys!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

About TutoTOONS Games
TutoTOONS games foster creativity and help them learn while playing the games they love. Fun and educational TutoTOONS games strive to bring meaningful and safe mobile experience to millions of children worldwide.

Important Message
This app is free to download and play, but there are certain in-game items that may be purchased for real money. By downloading this app you agree to TutoTOONS Privacy Policy https://tutotoons.com/privacy_policy/ and Terms of Use https://tutotoons.com/terms .

Want to report an issue or share suggestions? Contact us at support@tutotoons.com

· Read our blog: https://blog.tutotoons.com

bluejetty:00088220:ios.summary: Aplikacija prikazuje spisak linija i red vožnje javnog gradskog prevoza za grad Beograd. Dostupni su podaci za sve linije gradskog i prigradskog prevoza. Za svaku liniju su dostupni red vožnje i spisak stanica sa procenjenim vremenom dolask
bluejetty:00088220:ios.description:
Aplikacija prikazuje spisak linija i red vožnje javnog gradskog prevoza za grad Beograd. Dostupni su podaci za sve linije gradskog i prigradskog prevoza. Za svaku liniju su dostupni red vožnje i spisak stanica sa procenjenim vremenom dolaska. Moguće je snimiti najčešće korišćene linije i stanice. Podržani su sledeći tipovi linija:
- autobuske linije
- tramvajske linije
- trolejbuske linije
- elektro-bus
- minibus linije
- BG voz
- SOKO voz
- noćne linije
Od svih podataka koji se prikazuju, jedino se spisak linija čuva lokalno u aplikaciji. Taj spisak je, u podašavanjima aplikacije, moguće ažurirati u bilo kom krenutku.
KARAKTERISTIKE:
- spisak linija - sve gradske i prigradske linije koje su trenutno aktivne u opštini Beograd
- omiljene linije - na početnom ekranu moguće je snimiti omiljene ili najčešće korišćene linije radi kasnijeg lakšeg pristupa
- spisak stanica sa kodovima - za svaku liniju se prikazuje spisak stanica sa kodovima, odvojeno za oba smera
- omiljene stanice - u detaljima linije moguće je odabrati omiljene ili najčešće korišćene stanice. Za svaku odabranu stanicu prikazuju se tri naredna procenjena vremena dolaska vozila na datu stanicu. Vreme dolaska se procenjuje na osnovu vremena polaska sa početne i vremena potrebnog da dođe do date stanice
- izmene na linijama - spisak aktuelnih izmena na svim linijama, sa linkom do detalja izmene
- planirane izmene na linijama - spisak planiranih izmena za sve linije
Aplikacija podržava tamnu i svetlu temu. Na onim telefonima čiji operativni sistem podržava teme, aplikacija se automatski prilagođava temi telefona. Na ostalim uređajima, u delu za podešavanje aplikacije, moguće je ručno izabrati željenu temu.
NAPOMENA: Podaci nisu dostupni ukoliko mobilni uređaj nije priključen na internet mrežu.

bluejetty:00174698:ios.description:
Fitness is about more than movement. It's about loving ourselves right now
and being inspired by who we're becoming. At Burn Boot Camp, we do it together.
With knowledge in our heads, love in our hearts, strength in our bodies, and passion in our souls…
we are #BurnNation.
We've partnered with Fit Radio to keep you motivated with mixes created by chart-topping DJs. Our mixes maintain a consistent & energetic tempo, our songs are specifically selected and arranged to help you get the most out of your sweat session, and our DJs throw in surprises along the way to keep you guessing!
This app was created for Burn Boot Camp Studio Owners and cannot be used by individuals. If you are an individual, you can find the Burn Boot Camp station inside the FITRADIO app.
- Title of service: Burn Beats Premium
- Length of subscription: 1 Month
- Price of subscription: Varies Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings in the App Store app after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
- Burn Beats allows users to share workout data with HealthKit and CareKit and helps close activity rings on the apple watch 
For more information check out our Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and Health App Information Disclosure here:
https://www.fitradio.com/tos.html
https://www.fitradio.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00126050:ios.summary: WYBORCZA to aktualności i rzetelne wiadomości, które zawsze możesz mieć w zasięgu ręki! Lubisz czytać reportaże i poznawać opinie? Wciągają Cię wywiady? Pochłaniają analizy? A może po prostu chcesz wiedzieć więcej? Dzięki aplikacji WYBORCZE
bluejetty:00126050:ios.description:
WYBORCZA to aktualności i rzetelne wiadomości, które zawsze możesz mieć w zasięgu ręki! Lubisz czytać reportaże i poznawać opinie? Wciągają Cię wywiady? Pochłaniają analizy? A może po prostu chcesz wiedzieć więcej? Dzięki aplikacji WYBORCZEJ poznasz wydarzenia z kraju i ze świata, ale też będziesz na bieżąco z tematami lokalnymi, społecznymi, zdrowotnymi, gospodarczymi oraz kulturalnymi.
ZALETY POSIADANIA APLIKACJI WYBORCZEJ
NA BIEŻĄCO O TYM, CO WAŻNE
Nasi redaktorzy wybiorą dla Ciebie najważniejsze wydarzenia z kraju i ze świata, dzięki czemu wszystko, co istotne, zobaczysz i przeczytasz zaraz po otwarciu aplikacji w sekcji JEDYNKA.
CZYTAJ TO, CO LUBISZ
Dopasuj sekcje do swoich potrzeb i zainteresowań! Dzięki konfiguracji menu w wybranej przez siebie kolejności uzyskasz dostęp do ulubionych tematów.
POSŁUCHAJ ARTYKUŁU
Każdy tekst w aplikacji wyposażony jest w funkcję odsłuchu. Dzięki niej uwalniasz ręce i dajesz odpoczynek swoim oczom.
CZYTAJ WYGODNIE
W aplikacji możesz wybrać wielkość i rodzaj czcionki, a także w prosty sposób zmieniać tryb jasny na ciemny i odwrotnie. Dopasuj ustawienia do swoich potrzeb i czytaj treści WYBORCZEJ tak, jak lubisz!
BĄDŹ NA CZASIE
Wybierz rodzaj powiadomień, które chcesz od nas otrzymywać. Znajdziesz je wszystkie w zakładce ZAPISANE.
OSZCZĘDZAJ CZAS
Swoje ulubione teksty dodawaj do SCHOWKA. Będą zawsze pod ręką, gdy tylko zechcesz do nich wrócić lub podzielić się nimi z przyjaciółmi.
WIADOMOŚCI Z REGIONÓW
Wybierz lokalizacje, które Cię interesują ­- jesteśmy już w 30 miastach!
PODCASTY
Interesujące rozmowy na bieżące tematy z ciekawymi gośćmi. Słuchaj codziennie o 8:10.
WYDANIA PDF
W każdej chwili z archiwum wydań możesz pobrać nowe oraz archiwalne wydania WYBORCZEJ. Udostępniamy je również w formacie PDF.
JAKO SUBSKRYBENT TREŚCI WYBORCZEJ W APLIKACJI MASZ BIEŻĄCY DOSTĘP DO:
• Aktualności z serwisu Wyborcza.pl
W tym do informacji oraz aktualnych wydarzeń z kraju i ze świata oraz do 33 kategorii tematycznych, m.in.: kultura, nauka, biznes, polityka, sport, klimat i zdrowie.
• Wiadomości z Twojego regionu
Mamy już 30 serwisów lokalnych, wszystko, by być bliżej Ciebie!
• Treści z magazynów:
ALE HISTORIA
Teksty o wojnach, wynalazkach, zdradach, romansach, wizjonerach i szaleńcach. Słuchamy wybitnych historyków, przypominamy ważne daty.
DUŻY FORMAT
Najlepsze reportaże, felietony i wywiady. Odważne tematy, wybitni autorzy, reporterskie śledztwa.
WOLNA SOBOTA
Treści, w których podważamy prawdy oczywiste, weryfikujemy podziały, sprawdzamy, czy świat naprawdę się wali, i szukamy ludzi, którzy wiedzą, jak go naprawić.
WYSOKIE OBCASY
Przedstawiamy sylwetki niebanalnych bohaterek, poruszamy tematy z zakresu psychologii, mody, związków, zdrowego stylu życia i wychowania.
TYLKO ZDROWIE
Treści dla tych, którzy szukają porad najlepszych specjalistów, informacji o zdrowiu, diecie i stylu życia.
GAZETA TELEWIZYJNA
Telewizja w najlepszym wydaniu. Podpowiadamy wartościowe programy i filmy.
KSIĄŻKI. MAGAZYN DO CZYTANIA
Pokazujemy różnorodność świata literatury. Mądrze i wciągająco piszemy o książkach. Przedstawiamy bestsellery, mistrzów pióra, wydarzenia z rynku wydawniczego.
SŁÓWKA. MAGAZYN O JĘZYKU
Zagwozdki językowe, błędy i gafy u tych, którym się przytrafić nie powinny, poprawność językowa i wszystko, co wpływa na to, że język polski jest tak piękny i trudny zarazem.
NASZA EUROPA
To prawdziwe dziennikarstwo bez granic, bo przeczytasz w niej nie tylko teksty naszych reporterów, ale również naszych zagranicznych kolegów z „Die Welt”, „El País”, „La Repubblica”, „Le Figaro”, „Le Soir”. A wszystko przetłumaczone na język polski.
INFORMACJE DODATKOWE
Administratorem danych osobowych przetwarzanych w związku z korzystaniem z aplikacji jest Wyborcza Sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie (Czerska 8/10 00-732 Warszawa).
Regulamin: https://wyborcza.pl/r
Warunki użycia (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The most popular and The most admired Adhan time application which is used by muslims from all over the world. The most accurate islamic application.

• You can calculate the accurate prayer time based on the calculation at the location, or you can see the prayer times by choosing your city.
• You can get visual and audio notifications before each Prayer Time and Prayer Time with a large selection of sounds.
• You can easily change the city by entering a different city or using GPS mode directly.
• With the Community of Prayer, you can pray with other users or you can ask other users to pray for your prayers.
• You can personalize apps by using many Islamic wallpapers in the Multimedia section. You can also share beautiful greeting cards at special moments.
• With Khatam Online, you can join one of the many Muslims to participate by choosing Ayat, Surah, Halaman, and Juz. You can easily read the tasks you have selected in the app.
• Hijriah calendar converter and see Hijri calendar through the main screen
• You can follow the big day, you can see how much time is left.
• You can search Qibla direction with compass or map, you can see the direction of Qibla in the most accurate way.
• With the features of the Nearest Mosque you can find the mosque nearest to your location and get directions.
• With the reminder feature you can set reminders and get notifications for Monday morning wake - Thursday's fasting reminder, Friday prayer reminders, Sholat Tahajud at all times.
• Feature library with Holy Qur'an, Yasin, Popular Surah & Ayat, Khatam, and many other books.
• You can register daily deeds in your Charity Book, so you can check them out.
• With many different widgets, you can see Prayer Times anytime.
• You can see Asma-ul Husna with 99 names of Allah SWT and its explanation.
• You can see the time of prayer on the calendar with the calendar feature and you can make your plan according to the time of prayer.
• With Quran Radio feature, you can listen to the 24 hour non-stop Quran.
• You can join the Zikir Online with the Zikir World, you can add more Zikr for yourself in the Zikirmatik feature.

• With some font support, you can change the font size and text as desired.
• You can read more conveniently with horizontal screen support.
• You can choose a lot of Hafidz, listen to the sound and change the speed of reading.
• You can read translations in many languages.
• By coloring Tajwid you can read the Qur'an more accurately.
• The quick access screen lets you easily navigate to the sections you want.
• You can easily follow the read paragraph with auto-focus when reading the sound.

• Weather forecast.

bluejetty:00100133:ios.description:
GLPeak is the daily companion for your GLP-1 journey, from first dose to goal weight and everything after.
Log doses, weight, food, symptoms, and progress in seconds. See estimated medication levels between injections. And when questions come up, ask Peako, your AI companion built for GLP-1 life.
One fast, reliable place to track what matters, spot patterns, and stay motivated between appointments.
— NEW: AI FOOD LOGGING —
Describe your meal, dictate it, or snap a photo and GLPeak fills in the rest. Or scan a barcode straight off the package. Follow calorie and protein targets built for eating less on a GLP-1, and let meals logged in other apps sync in through Apple Health and Health Connect.
— NEW: APPLE WATCH & WEAR OS —
Your next dose, your streak, and quick weight logging on your wrist. Glance, log, move on.
— MEET PEAKO, YOUR AI COMPANION —
Side effects, plateaus, food choices, what to expect next. Ask Peako anything about your GLP-1 journey and get clear, supportive answers. Optionally share a summary of your own logs so Peako can spot patterns in your data, and see exactly what is shared.
— LEARN AS YOU GO WITH PEAKOQUEST —
Short daily lessons on living well with GLP-1s, led by Peako. Earn XP, build your streak, and turn the things nobody explains at your appointment into something you actually understand. Unit 2, Nutrition Foundations, is here.
— SEE YOUR WHOLE JOURNEY —
My Journey brings your insights, progress photos, weight trends, and body measurements together in one place, so you can see how far you have come, not just what the scale said today.
— KEEP IT OFF —
Goal weight is not the finish line. GLPeak is built for maintenance too, with stability metrics, dose-taper support, and drift alerts that catch small changes before they become setbacks.
— EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO TRACK —
• Fast dose, weight, symptom, and journal logging
• Estimated medication level charts using PK + step models
• Weight trends, goals, and progress tracking
• Symptom, side effect, mood, and activity journaling

• Progress photos and body measurements

• Progress reports on your journey
• Home screen and lock screen widgets
• Designed for iPad, including Split View
• Achievements, streaks, and coins for motivation
• Simple, clean design without the clutter
• Free core tracking with no ads
— BUILT FOR GLP-1 MEDICATIONS —
Track Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound, Rybelsus, Saxenda, Trulicity, Foundayo (first app to support it), semaglutide, tirzepatide, all compounded GLP-1s, and more.
We add medications fast based on real user feedback. If yours is not listed, ask us.
— GLPEAK+: THE FULL EXPERIENCE —
Core tracking is free forever, with no ads and no paywall on the basics. GLPeak+ unlocks:
• Food & nutrition logging: AI meal logging, barcode scanning, and daily targets
• Peako, unlimited: ask your AI companion anything, anytime, with no coins and no caps
• PeakoQuest, all units: keep going after the first unit
• My Journey, in full: every insight, photo, and measurement connected
• Keep it off: stability metrics, dose-taper support, and drift alerts for life after goal weight
• Plus every recipe, unlimited reports, premium widgets, and full journal history
Free for 7 days, then $39.99/year (about $3.33/month) or $4.99/month. Cancel anytime.
— BUILT BY PEOPLE WHO GET IT —
Built by GLP-1 users and co-created with clinicians and dietitians for the tracking, education, and motivation that happens between appointments.
GLPeak is for tracking and educational purposes only. It does not provide medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider.

bluejetty:00135054:ios.summary:
Explore 118 elements with a periodic table made for everyday chemistry study. Find an element, inspect its properties and see how it compares with the rest of the table.
1. EXPLORE THE TABLE
Pinch to zoom, pan across the table or fit the w
bluejetty:00135054:ios.description:
Explore 118 elements with a periodic table made for everyday chemistry study. Find an element, inspect its properties and see how it compares with the rest of the table.
1. EXPLORE THE TABLE
Pinch to zoom, pan across the table or fit the whole table on screen. Filter by category to focus on metals, noble gases, halogens and other element groups.
2. FIND AN ELEMENT
Search by name, symbol, atomic number or category. Use localized or English element names. Open a result to explore its details.
3. LOOK CLOSER
Browse Overview, Chemistry, Atomic and More sections. View atomic weight, density, melting and boiling points, protons, neutrons, electrons and electron configuration. Tap an element image to enlarge it and pinch to zoom. Move to neighboring elements with the previous and next buttons.
4. COMPARE PROPERTIES
Switch between heat maps for atomic weight, electronegativity, atomic radius, melting point and boiling point. In List view, choose a property and sort from low to high or high to low.
5. KEEP LEARNING
Look up terms in the A–Z chemistry glossary and browse articles about transition metals. Choose light or dark mode and your preferred color theme. Use the app on iPhone and iPad without creating an account.
OFFLINE REFERENCE
The bundled element data and reference content work offline. External websites, ads and App Store purchases require an internet connection.
LANGUAGE OPTIONS
English, German and Spanish (Mexico) interfaces include localized element names, categories and property labels. Some descriptive chemistry text, glossary definitions and articles remain in English and are marked in the app.
FREE CONTENT, OPTIONAL PREMIUM
The table, element details, comparisons, glossary, articles and themes are available for free. The free version includes ads. Premium removes ads, with weekly, yearly and lifetime options where available. Prices and eligible offers are shown before purchase.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID settings. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Restore previous purchases from the Premium screen.
Privacy Policy: https://owlspeak.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://owlspeak.web.app/terms

Partner with family or friends to solve puzzles together, adding a new layer of fun and connection to the classic game. Whether you’re bonding over challenges or working as a team, Two-player Mode brings people closer through shared gameplay.
Download Koi Mahjong today and embark on a unique tile-matching journey with your loved ones!

bluejetty:00064335:ios.name: VideoLUT
bluejetty:00064335:ios.summary: Transform your videos and images into cinematic masterpieces with VideoLUT, the ultimate color-grading app! With over 6000 presets, you can easily import, edit, and apply LUTs to create stunning videos and photos. Plus, VideoLUT allows you
bluejetty:00064335:ios.description:
Transform your videos and images into cinematic masterpieces with VideoLUT, the ultimate color-grading app! With over 6000 presets, you can easily import, edit, and apply LUTs to create stunning videos and photos. Plus, VideoLUT allows you to record videos and take photos with your imported LUTs, giving you the ultimate creative control.
217 film emulations — Kodak Portra, Kodachrome, Ektar, Fuji Velvia, Provia, Ilford HP5, Tri-X and more.
Import 20+ LUT formats — .cube, .3dl, .look, .csp, .clf, .spi3d, .icc, CDL, Hald PNG, Lightroom .xmp/.lrtemplate — and export float .cube, .3dl, .look.
Whether you're a professional filmmaker or a casual iPhone photographer, VideoLUT is the perfect app for you. It comes with powerful editing tools that allow you to color grade your videos and images with ease. You can even create your own LUTs and share them with other users via QR codes or apps like Lumafusion. 
VideoLUT supports a variety of LUT formats, including DaVinci Resolve 3D Cube LUT (.cube) and Autodesk 3D LUT (.3dl). You can import .cube, .3dl, and 512x512 .png LUT tables, and save or import cube files to iCloud, Dropbox, and other storage apps. It also converts Adobe Lightroom preset files (`.xmp` and `.lrtemplate`) into LUTs during import. This feature is currently in beta; only supported colour adjustments and processing versions can be converted.
But that's not all – VideoLUT also lets you visualize LUTs in 3D, export them as LUT images (.png), and share them as .cube 16, 32, or 33 (DaVinci Resolve 3D Cube LUT) with other apps or your desktop. You can also match colors from images and build new LUTs from the result, and use RGB, HSL, CMYK, LAB, and Skin Masks and Curves for added control.
With VideoLUT's auto white balance, Macbeth table detection and correction, split toning, color wheels, and other adjust tools, you have everything you need to perfect your videos and images. Mix multiple LUTs to create new ones, convert Filmic Pro LUTS, and even preprocess RAW photos for added flexibility.
Download VideoLUT today and transform your videos and images into true works of art!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
