bluejetty:00159238:ios.description:
Croissant is the wallet for luxury fashion. Earn credit when you shop, get credit drops from the brands you love, and sell what you own at a guaranteed price. New members start with $100.
SHOP AND EARN 10% BACK
Choose Croissant at checkout with partner brands, online or in store, and 10% of what you pay comes back as credit for next time. Your credit comes straight off the total, with no codes to track.
CREDIT DROPS FROM BRANDS
Brands including SIMKHAI, Johanna Ortiz, Mansur Gavriel and Altuzarra drop credit into your wallet before you shop. Claim a drop, then spend it at checkout alongside the rest of your credit.
SELL WHAT YOU OWN IN ONE TAP
Connect Gmail and your collection builds itself: every receipt imported, every eligible piece priced, across 200+ brands. When you are ready to sell, tap the piece, ship it with the prepaid label, and get paid in credit once it is verified. There are no photos or listings to make.
KNOW WHAT IT IS WORTH BEFORE YOU BUY
Turn on the Safari extension and product pages show what you will earn back and what Croissant will pay if you sell later. It earns you credit as you shop at retailers including Saks Fifth Avenue, Nordstrom and Revolve.
ONE WALLET FOR ALL OF IT
Your welcome credit, your 10% back, your credit drops and your resale payouts land in one place. Spend it with partner brands, or turn it into gift cards at Revolve and FWRD.
CROISSANT PREMIUM
Optional. $100 in credit every month (or a $50 gift card), 15% back on every purchase, and shipping covered on every sale. $30 a month or $300 a year. Cancel anytime.
Joining Croissant costs nothing. A $15 shipping fee applies when you sell, and Premium members do not pay it.

Privacy: croissant.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00079240:ios.description:
● Game overview
Following on from the Aladdin X projector and Nintendo Switch versions, as the third step, we have now officially released a smartphone version.
The rules are simple. It's a game where you combine two small fruits to make a bigger one and work towards making a watermelon. You must be careful that the fruits do not overflow from the box as you keep scoring points and aim to get a high score. When two fruits of the same type hit each other, the fruit type “evolves.” Then, when you hit two watermelons against each other...!? 
The ranking is updated every day! Have fun aiming for the top ranking!
● How to play the game
1. When fruits of the same type hit each other, they “evolve” into the next size of fruit and the score increases.
2. Use your finger to move Poppy to the left and right and then take your finger off the screen to drop the fruit. You can also tap anywhere in the box to drop the fruit to that specific location.
3. The game ends if the fruit overflows from the box.
● Notice
Official information on the Suika Game is available here.
Official Suika Game Website: https://suikagame.jp/
Official X: https://x.com/SuikaGame_jp
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/MWUHZEuRnx

bluejetty:00186594:ios.name: Hand Talk: Learn Sign Language
bluejetty:00186594:ios.summary:
Practice Sign Language in a fun and free way with Hugo and Maya, our virtual translators, through the Hand Talk App, elected by the UN as the best social app in the world!
Developed by experts, the app not only works as a pocket dictionary
bluejetty:00186594:ios.description:
Practice Sign Language in a fun and free way with Hugo and Maya, our virtual translators, through the Hand Talk App, elected by the UN as the best social app in the world!
Developed by experts, the app not only works as a pocket dictionary, but also helps you learn and practice Libras (Brazilian Sign Language), ASL (American Sign Language), and BSL (British Sign Language), whether to communicate with those you love, to connect with deaf people in your daily life, to reinforce your vocabulary, or to develop in a new language.
Why use the Hand Talk App?
Translate text or voice into Sign Languages anywhere and anytime, for free.
Practice Libras, ASL, and BSL in a fun and efficient way, with the support of characters designed to facilitate your learning.
Consult thousands of signs to expand your vocabulary, even offline, through updated dictionaries and educational videos.
Translations are performed automatically through artificial intelligence, trained with more than 38,000 words validated by specialists.
Personalize your experience and adapt the app to your needs! Adjust the translation speed, view the signs in 360 degrees, consult your history, create a favorites list, and customize Hugo and Maya with exclusive items!
If you like the Hand Talk App, try becoming a subscriber! Practice Libras, ASL, and BSL without ads, translate text contained in images, earn coins, and get exclusive access to new features. In addition, you also support our mission to keep education free for thousands of people!
Download now and start learning a new language today! Hugo and Maya are already super excited to meet you!
Frequently Asked Questions:
Who is the app recommended for?
The app can be used by anyone interested in learning and practicing Libras, ASL, or BSL in an effective and fun way!
What are the available languages?
Hugo and Maya master Libras, ASL, and BSL! They translate content searched in Portuguese into Brazilian Sign Language and in English into American Sign Language. To access the ASL version of the app, just click on the arrow next to the Brazilian flag in the lower-left corner and select the ASL option, identified by the design of the United States flag. To access BSL, select the British flag.
How to use the Hand Talk App?
Using the Hand Talk App is super easy. bluejetty:00115643:ios.description:
A management simulation in which you take an old, run-down castle and turn it into a dastardly demon stronghold! Recruit unique monsters as your minions and vanquish adventurers who dare to enter your realm!
Install gargoyles, ritual altars, and other devilish decor to boost your castle's mystique and attract more monsters your way. Gift them food and other items to help them grow, and garner their support to fend off pesky adventurers.
You can also send your monster minions out to explore nearby dungeons and towns. They'll bring you back items and other loot, and maybe even some new allies!
As you progress, you can also start merging monsters together to make new ones.
And don't forget traps—essential equipment for proper castle defense! Develop a range of traps like sleep-inducing gas and heavy washbowls to thwart any who cross the threshold of your demonic haven! By placing and combining traps in imaginative ways, you can make your fortress of fiendishness virtually impregnable!
Fend off attacks from mighty adventurers and keep your minions sweet to become the biggest and baddest demon overlord of all time!
Search "Kairosoft" to see our other games. https://kairopark.jp
We've got a whole range of free and one-time-purchase games to enjoy, many of which might feel familiar!
This is the Kairosoft 2D pixel art game series.

bluejetty:00073823:ios.description:
knitCompanion is a pattern tracking app for knitters and fibers artists. Our patented* tools make tracking easy so you can enjoy the fabric you are creating, make fewer mistakes, and tackle new techniques. Join the knitCompanion group on Ravelry for ongoing fun KALs and community.
**** Works with ANY PATTERN ****
Doesn't require internet so you can knit what you want, anywhere, anytime.
Free Basics: 
* TRACK your row and progress along the row
* COUNTERS for every project
* LINK to Ravelry & Dropbox
* SYNC with iCloud
* Supports iOS multi-tasking & Dark Mode
Setup+Essentials (enable with in-app purchase):
* CUSTOMIZE settings and use our popular inverted marker.
* SCRIBBLE all over your patterns.
* MAGIC MARKERS to count, highlight, and color stitches.
* KEY always visible.
* REMINDERS for "at the same time" instructions and repeats so you never miss a step. 
* HIGHLIGHT your pattern.
* Add NOTES to your pattern.
* VIDEO links to easily learn new techniques.
* Add PDF (great for mystery knit-a-longs).
* HANDS FREE with voice commands so you can keep your hands on your knitting.
* INTELLIGENT CHART RECOGNITION makes chart setup a breeze.

bluejetty:00060666:ios.description:
The Latin Vulgate Bible is the translation of the Holy Scriptures into the Latin language and has greatly influenced Western Christianity for centuries. When it was first introduced, it became an important milestone that made the Christian faith more accessible to Latin-speaking people and helped them connect deeply with the message of the Scriptures.
Over the years, it has been revised several times to remain meaningful for newer generations. Even today, the Latin Vulgate Bible continues to inspire and guide millions of people around the world.

bluejetty:00152770:ios.description:
Ever wanted to rewrite history or build a fantasy empire from the ground up? Welcome to A+ World Map Editor Sandbox, where you have the power to reshape the real world!
A+ World Map Editor Sandbox is the ultimate creative tool for mappers, world-builders, and alternate history fans. Our powerful sandbox gives you complete control to design, customise, and explore your very own version of Earth, starting from a detailed and accurate real-world map. Create, experiment, and play without ever needing an internet connection.
What can you do with A+ World Map Editor Sandbox?
·Start with Reality: Use a high-quality, real-world map as your starting point for any project.
·Full Offline Access: Perfect for travel or brainstorming, the entire app is designed to work without an internet connection.
·Total Control: Rename countries, provinces, cities, and oceans. Your world, your names.

·Explore in 2D & 3D: Seamlessly switch between a detailed flat map and a stunning, fully rotatable globe.
·Bring Your World to Life: Add animated stickers, set national capitals, track stats, and design a world with its own lore and rankings.
·Unleash Your Creativity: This is a true sandbox. Create new civilizations, simulate "what if" scenarios, or just have fun making fantasy maps.
You can save your projects to continue your masterpiece anytime.
Ready to become a world-builder? Install A+ World Map Editor Sandbox now and start your adventure!

bluejetty:00037073:ios.description:
Health Monitor is an app focused on health monitoring. With this app, you can easily measure your heart rate, stress levels, record daily blood pressure, and track blood sugar. It also tracks long-term trends of key health indicators to help you manage your health comprehensively.
- Record Blood Pressure: Easily record your daily blood pressure readings. The blood pressure monitor automatically calculates and shows whether your readings are within the normal range. Over time, you can view detailed blood pressure charts.
- Monitor Blood Sugar: With just a few taps, you can record your blood sugar levels and understand your trends over time. Blood sugar trends are visualized with intuitive charts and graphs.
- Measure Heart Rate: Using your smartphone’s camera and advanced PPG (Photoplethysmogram) technology, Health Monitor provides accurate heart rate measurements. It can calculate HRV (Heart Rate Variability) and provide personalized results to assess stress levels based on pulse signals.
- AI Health Advisor: With integrated AI technology, users can consult the AI Health Advisor for various health-related questions or concerns about health management, receiving relevant advice. However, the advice is for reference only and is intended to help users make more informed health decisions.
- Medication & Health Reminders: Set medication reminders to ensure timely medication intake and regularly record key health indicators such as blood pressure, blood sugar, and heart rate.
Disclaimer:
- Blood pressure monitor: Health Monitor is not a medical device and is for general health maintenance only.
- If you have any health concerns or are worried about your health or heart condition, please consult a doctor.
- On some devices, the app may cause the LED flashlight to become very hot.

bluejetty:00126759:ios.name: Continuous .NET C# and F# IDE
bluejetty:00126759:ios.summary:
Continuous is a fast and powerful .NET C# and F# IDE that runs directly on the iPad and iPhone (no network needed!). With it, you can write apps and games using your favorite languages on your favorite devices.
Continuous is always buildin
bluejetty:00126759:ios.description:
Continuous is a fast and powerful .NET C# and F# IDE that runs directly on the iPad and iPhone (no network needed!). With it, you can write apps and games using your favorite languages on your favorite devices.
Continuous is always building and running your code so you can see changes as you type. Writing interactive apps in Continuous is a pleasure compared to the traditional code-build-run cycle. It frees you to make lots of small changes and see their effects immediately - no more waiting for builds or deployments and no more clicking around trying to get to the screen you're trying to code.
Continuous looks and works in many of the same ways as traditional .NET IDEs so you'll feel right at home, but it also strives to advance the state of the art in IDEs with these features:
>>> Full C# 8 and F# 4.7 compilers so you can use the latest tech
>>> Xamarin.Forms Live XAML Editing
>>> Automatic compiling and running so you can focus on the code and the results
>>> Fancy text editor with tabs, semantic highlighting, inline error bubbles, and inline values that are updated as you type
>>> Watch window enables you to view graphical objects in your app (UI and images), inspect live objects as your app runs, create instances of new objects, and call methods
>>> Code completion with inline type info and documentation makes learning new APIs fun
>>> Uses standard .NET file and project formats so you can share code with other IDEs
>>> Includes Xamarin.Forms and UIKit to build apps and SpriteKit and SceneKit to build games. You can access many iOS APIs including CoreMotion, the Social framework, and HealthKit to read data.
>>> Split screen support so you can keep documentation by your side
>>> Execution powered by a new IL interpreter
If you're new to .NET or iOS coding, you will love the code completion with integrated documentation and the fun examples that come with the app.
If you're a .NET pro, then you will love the support for projects and the ability to inspect objects as you code them - whether they're in a script or just a normal project file.
If you're new to programming, C# is an great language to learn: it's powerful yet friendly language, example code is all over the internet, and there are plenty of jobs out there waiting for you.
If you enjoy thinking a little differently, then you will love that F# is included and fully supported. This amazing programming language will teach you to write better code and will arm you to solve problems that you thought were too big or hard to solve - like writing an IDE.

listings.description:
Continuous is a fast and powerful .NET C# and F# IDE that runs directly on the iPad and iPhone (no network needed!). With it, you can write apps and games using your favorite languages on your favorite devices.

Continuous is always building and running your code so you can see changes as you type. Writing interactive apps in Continuous is a pleasure compared to the traditional code-build-run cycle. It frees you to make lots of small changes and see their effects immediately - no more waiting for builds or deployments and no more clicking around trying to get to the screen you're trying to code.

Continuous looks and works in many of the same ways as traditional .NET IDEs so you'll feel right at home, but it also strives to advance the state of the art in IDEs with these features:

>>> Full C# 8 and F# 4.7 compilers so you can use the latest tech
>>> Xamarin.Forms Live XAML Editing
>>> Automatic compiling and running so you can focus on the code and the results
>>> Fancy text editor with tabs, semantic highlighting, inline error bubbles, and inline values that are updated as you type
>>> Watch window enables you to view graphical objects in your app (UI and images), inspect live objects as your app runs, create instances of new objects, and call methods
>>> Code completion with inline type info and documentation makes learning new APIs fun
>>> Uses standard .NET file and project formats so you can share code with other IDEs
>>> Includes Xamarin.Forms and UIKit to build apps and SpriteKit and SceneKit to build games. You can access many iOS APIs including CoreMotion, the Social framework, and HealthKit to read data.
>>> Split screen support so you can keep documentation by your side
>>> Execution powered by a new IL interpreter

If you're new to .NET or iOS coding, you will love the code completion with integrated documentation and the fun examples that come with the app.

If you're a .NET pro, then you will love the support for projects and the ability to inspect objects as you code them - whether they're in a script or just a normal project file.

If you're new to programming, C# is an great language to learn: it's powerful yet friendly language, example code is all over the internet, and there are plenty of jobs out there waiting for you.

If you enjoy thinking a little differently, then you will love that F# is included and fully supported. This amazing programming language will teach you to write better code and will arm you to solve problems that you thought were too big or hard to solve - like writing an IDE.

bluejetty:00061568:ios.summary: Aim at text. Shoot. It's yours! Prizmo Go lets you quickly grab text with the camera. After text is recognized in a blink of an eye, you can interact with it in many useful ways. Or just send it to other apps. And if you've got a Mac, you c
bluejetty:00061568:ios.description:
Aim at text. Shoot. It's yours! Prizmo Go lets you quickly grab text with the camera. After text is recognized in a blink of an eye, you can interact with it in many useful ways. Or just send it to other apps. And if you've got a Mac, you can even copy/paste it there. No more retyping. Feels like magic, just at your fingertips.
Additionally, Prizmo Go provides rich interactions with the captured text. After shooting, text from the original picture is revealed, and swiping through it allows fast and accurate text selection directly from the image. Selected text can then be read aloud, or you can tap to browse to any printed website address, call phone numbers, trigger Mail app from an email address, or even reveal physical address in Apple Maps and initiate navigation to that place.
Prizmo Go comes with enhancements specifically built for VoiceOver, in addition to spoken guidance prior to shooting. That, combined with its text-to-speech capabilities, make it a great companion in case you need help reading printed documents.
"Prizmo Go is the perfect example of how an app category can be reinvented with fresh approaches and modern tech."
— Federico Viticci (MacStories)
"By far this app is hands-down the most culturally inclusive app for individuals with visual deficits AND typical vision."
— Bridging Apps
"Prizmo Go does a fantastic job of recognizing text, specifically now with new machine learning features where the app better understands the gutter of a physical book."
— Josh Ginter (The Sweet Setup)
PHOTO CAPTURE
- Camera-based text capture for iPhone & iPad
- Real-time text highlighting in camera preview
- Flash and device orientation detection
- Innovative image stabilization
TEXT RECOGNITION
- Advanced image preprocessing
- Orientation detection (machine learning)
- Curved text handling
- Robust neural network-based on-device OCR (works without internet connection) + Apple OCR
- Accurate Cloud OCR (*) option (Internet connection required)
- Handwritten text recognition (*)
- QR code recognition
TEXT INTERACTION
- Text selection by swiping through the picture
- Copy/paste to other apps or to the Mac (*)
- Interaction with detected information: phone numbers, email addresses, physical addresses, websites (*)
- Audio (text-to-speech) reader with word highlighting
- Translation into many languages (*)
ACCESSIBILITY
- Full support of VoiceOver and improved workflow for low vision and blind users
- Text-to-speech output
- Spoken guidance prior to actual shooting
- Deep integration with Dynamic Type for improved & customisable text appearance
OTHER FEATURES & AUTOMATION
- Copy to the Mac with Universal Clipboard
- 3D Touch Quick Actions
- iPad Multitasking: support for Slide Over/Split View
- Supports Action Extension and 'Open In'
- URL scheme mechanism (x-callback-url) to trigger Prizmo Go from other apps like Shortcuts, and retrieve recognized text.
- Siri Shortcuts
- iOS: Dark Mode, Core ML, Apple OCR, Shortcuts Actions, SF Symbols, Voice Control (Accessibility)
(*) Requires a purchase, see app for available options.
Full list of OCR languages available on https://creaceed.com/prizmogo
Volume Purchase (VPP): see Prizmo Go (Volume Ed.)
Terms of Use: https://creaceed.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://creaceed.com/privacy
Feedback: prizmo@creaceed.com

bluejetty:00069704:ios.description:
Rekola - bikesharing for quick rides around the city
Get on the pink bikes and enjoy a ride in different cities of the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Estonia. It's easy, fast and comfortable. Every time you ride a bike, you change the city for the better, because it is an efficient, sustainable and often the fastest way of urban transport.
Bikes are available 24/7, whenever you need them. You can find out their location directly in the app, and most often find them parked in bike racks and designated areas.
It literally takes a minute to register. Then just scan the QR code on your bike and you're good to go. 
For up-to-date info on prices and tariffs, visit www.rekola.cz/en.
Add a Lítačka to your account and get 2 free 15-minute rides per day. You can also load your MultiSport card. It gives you 2 extra hourly rides every day.
Got a question? Email us at info@rekola.cz.
Disclaimer:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00145564:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00145564:ios.description:
## How does Distill work?
Distill checks webpages in cloud using servers or locally on your computer using browser extensions. Whenever there is a change, Distill will notify you of the change. The iOS app lets you get push notifications from local and cloud monitors instantly. The Watchlist and history view lets you view the changes with great detail.
Note that Distill doesn't check the webpages on your phone, so it doesn't affect your phone's battery. The app is a client to view and mange your Watchlist and get push notifications.
## Check Intervals
Local monitors support a minimum check interval of 5 seconds for all plans.
Cloud monitors support 10 minutes check interval in Starter plan, 5 minutes in the Professional plan and 2 minutes in the Flexi plan.
## Alert Actions
Get alerts in the following ways once you set them as actions.
- Push notification on phones
- Email
- SMS
- Discord, Slack and Webhook
You can use conditions to receive alerts only on important changes matching the conditions.
## Subscription
The app needs a paid subscription. You can purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase.
- 1 month Starter($14.99) and 1 month Professional($34.99). A 7-day free trial is available for Starter plan.
- Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase
## Questions/Feedback
We are constantly improving the app and would love to hear from you. Please email to support@distill.io.

listings.name: Distill Web Monitor
listings.description:
## How does Distill work?

Distill checks webpages in cloud using servers or locally on your computer using browser extensions. Whenever there is a change, Distill will notify you of the change. The iOS app lets you get push notifications from local and cloud monitors instantly. The Watchlist and history view lets you view the changes with great detail.

Note that Distill doesn't check the webpages on your phone, so it doesn't affect your phone's battery. The app is a client to view and mange your Watchlist and get push notifications.

 
## Check Intervals

Local monitors support a minimum check interval of 5 seconds for all plans.
Cloud monitors support 10 minutes check interval in Starter plan, 5 minutes in the Professional plan and 2 minutes in the Flexi plan.

## Alert Actions

Get alerts in the following ways once you set them as actions.
- Push notification on phones
- Email
- SMS
- Discord, Slack and Webhook

You can use conditions to receive alerts only on important changes matching the conditions.

## Subscription

The app needs a paid subscription. You can purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase.

- 1 month Starter($14.99) and 1 month Professional($34.99). A 7-day free trial is available for Starter plan.
- Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase


## Questions/Feedback

We are constantly improving the app and would love to hear from you. Please email to support@distill.io.

- Privacy policy: https://distill.io/privacy-policy/

Maid of Sker is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from British folklore. Armed with only a defensive sound device, you’ll utilise stealth tactics to avoid death amongst a cult of sound-based AI enemies.

• Widget
See the current UV and your burn risk right from your home screen.

bluejetty:00162636:ios.summary:

Drivee is made for
bluejetty:00162636:ios.description:
Drivee — rides and delivery on your terms
Tired of ride prices jumping two or three times higher because of light rain or rush hour? With Drivee, you are no longer fully dependent on hidden algorithms or sudden markups.
Drivee is made for people who value comfort but also like to stay smart about their spending. Suggest your own fare and pay for the route — not for the weather.
How does it work?
Everything is simple and transparent: you suggest the fare you think is fair for your ride. Nearby drivers see your request and can either accept your fare or make a counteroffer. No forced rates — you agree on the ride directly.
Three types of requests
City rides
Get to work, the gym, the airport, or anywhere else around the city without overpaying. Travelling with a child? Just add a child seat or booster option to your request based on your child’s age.
Intercity rides
Planning a trip to another city or a weekend getaway? Travel comfortably and on your terms, even over longer distances.
Delivery
Need to send documents, a gift, or a parcel? Request door-to-door delivery — a courier will pick up the item from you and carefully deliver it to the recipient.
Choose your driver
After creating a request, you receive offers from several drivers. Choose the option that suits you by car, rating, and arrival time. If you prefer a higher level of service, choose a driver marked “Comfort” — a well-maintained car will arrive for your ride.
Convenient payment
Pay the way that works for you: by bank card, in cash, or by transfer.
Safety
We care about helping every ride feel calm and secure.
Our support team is available 24/7 and ready to help in any situation.
During your ride, you can share your location with family or friends so they can follow your trip on the map.
The app also includes a built-in button to contact emergency services.
Drivee is a smart choice for people who do not want to overpay for nothing. Download the app and order familiar services on your own terms.

bluejetty:00070338:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00070338:ios.description:
A simple but interesting block puzzle game! Come to exercise your brain! 
Block Puzzle is our new gem-style cube puzzle game published in 2021. The goal is to lay and destroy jeweled blocks and solve block puzzles, and if one or more horizontal or vertical lines are filled, the gem blocks in the lines will be broken and eliminated with your pressure released together. The more you score, the more stress you free and the more excited you become.
Maybe after the end of the daily work, maybe before falling asleep at night, or in every fragmented time, the Block Puzzle game can make you no longer tired, no longer full of stress, and feel relaxed! Hope you spend a relaxing time with Block Puzzle game!
Our games are very suitable for different types of people. Anyone can have fun blasting blocks and sharpen their brains in the game, doing brain test with light and lively background music. For different players, we have different suggestions for you.
For beginners of the puzzle games, how to quickly enter the game is the first problem to solve. We have a few tips: 
1. Simply put the blocks in the 8*8 grids.
2. Move blocks to create full lines vertically or horizontally and then these lines will be cleared automatically.
3. The jewel blocks must be placed properly, which is even more challenging! BTW, blocks cannot be rotated.
4. When the jewel squares cannot be placed in the grids, game is over, so you must clear the filled squares as soon as possible!
For a master player of a block puzzle game or someone who wants to become a master, how to challenge yourself to get a higher score is very important. Here are also some tips: 
1. Carefully consider how to place different blocks, because each step may lead to different eliminate results, and may even directly end the game process.
2. Try to keep the streak continuously, because the continuous streak and combo will get higher scores and more room.
3. There is no time limit. You can spend more time carefully considering the placement and timing of each jewel cube to get a higher score.
4. Quickly download our Block Puzzle game to explore more high score methods. Welcome to share your high score secrets with us!
Why download the Block Puzzle game?
-Colorful jewel blocks are in the deep-colored background square grid, and the vivid color contrast makes game experience excellent.
-The game mode without props and time limit is to let you play entirely on your brain, which is an exercise of the brain and intelligence;
-The sound effects are comfortable and extremely real, especially when jewels are broken. And you can hear the sound of birds from time to time, giving you a natural experience.
-Easy to play, but getting high scores is not as easy as imagined.
If you have any suggestions or questions for us, please contact us in time and we are looking forward to your game feedback!
Challenge this simple, addictive and fun free Jewel Block Puzzle Game and get a higher score now!

bluejetty:00083924:ios.description:
**WeAM**———An authentic American short video community.
From nostalgic cars, to everything created by hand, to touching videos of realizing the AMERICAN DREAM.
We will show you the true American spirit, and we support all your expressions!
Why WeAM? Because It’s Real Life, Unfiltered
Here, you'll find a unique mix of handmade crafts, stories from rural America, and unfiltered realtalk that resonates with anyone who values the simpler side of life.
Whether you’re all about farming, restoring classic trucks, or sharing honest stories of life in the country, WeAM is where you can be yourself and connect with people who appreciate the genuine American spirit.
This is a space where you can share real life moments, from tending to crops and livestock to celebrating the joy of a hard day’s work. Every video highlights the grit, pride, and joy of farmlife and the values of the country boy way of living.
If it’s handmade, it belongs on WeAM. Whether you’re a carpenter, a crafter, or someone who just loves the DIY life, we celebrate the creativity and dedication it takes to make things with your own two hands. WeAM is all about bringing the artistry of handmade creations to a community that appreciates authenticity.
On WeAM, you’ll find honest conversations about everything from the challenges of rural life to the joys of family and community. This platform values voices that speak the truth, sharing thoughts and stories that represent the real side of the American experience.
Farm Life, All the Way
Life on the farm isn’t just a lifestyle; it’s a commitment, and WeAM captures it all. From sunrise to sunset, our community shares the essence of farmlife—the sweat, the pride, the beauty of the fields. Here, you’ll find people who understand the value of hard work, the importance of family, and the joy of a simple, honest life.
Community of Real People: Connect with country boys, farmers, crafters, and folks who live for the real life moments that make America special.
Expression without Filters: Say it how you mean it. WeAM supports the freedom to share your voice, your values, and your unique story without judgment.
Why Join WeAM?
For the Love of the Land: Our videos celebrate the beauty of farmlife and the pride of living off the land. If you love the countryside, this is where you’ll find others who feel the same.
This is a platform built for real people who live real lives. We aren’t here for perfection; we’re here for authenticity, and our community values the stories that reflect who they truly are.
Download WeAM and Join the Community!
WeAM is more than just a platform; it’s a place where you’re free to be yourself. Download WeAM today and join a community where every video is a celebration of real people, real life, and the enduring American spirit. Here, you’re not just a viewer; you’re a part of something real.
Use of this app constitutes acceptance of the Apple Standard EULA:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
We welcome you to **WeAM**, where we spread love, truth, and freedom to everyone. Let's create a dynamic world together! 
Any feedback? Contact us at support@weamapp.net."

bluejetty:00152953:ios.summary: Print anything from your iPhone or iPad—instantly. Smart Printer - Auto AirPrint finds compatible printers on your Wi-Fi network and lets you print documents, photos, emails, web pages, and more in just a few taps. No drivers. No setup head
bluejetty:00152953:ios.description:
Print anything from your iPhone or iPad—instantly. Smart Printer - Auto AirPrint finds compatible printers on your Wi-Fi network and lets you print documents, photos, emails, web pages, and more in just a few taps. No drivers. No setup headaches. Just open, detect, and print.
Why you’ll love it
* Auto-Detect Printers: Seamless discovery of AirPrint-enabled printers on your Wi-Fi.
* One-Tap Printing: Send PDFs, photos, Word/Excel files, emails, and web pages straight to your printer.
* Built-In Scanner: Turn your camera into a fast document scanner with auto-crop and adjustable filters, then print or save as PDF.
* Print Options You Need: Choose paper size (A4, Letter, Legal), color or B&W, copies, duplex* and orientation—if your printer supports it.
* Photo Layouts: Quickly print standard photo sizes like 4x6, 5x7, 8x10.
* Share Sheet Support: Print from Files, Photos, Mail, Safari, Notes, and your favorite apps via the iOS share menu.
* PDF Tools: Reorder pages, add multiple pages from scans, and preview before you print.
* Clipboard & Camera: Paste content from the clipboard or snap a photo and print right away.
* On-Device Privacy: Your documents stay on your device and local network; printing uses Apple’s AirPrint protocols.
How it works
1. Connect your iPhone/iPad and printer to the same Wi-Fi.
2. Open the app—your AirPrint printer is detected automatically.
3. Pick what to print (Files, Photos, Scan, Web), tweak options, and tap Print.
Works with popular printers
Compatible with AirPrint-enabled printers from leading brands like HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, and more. Features such as duplex, borderless, or specialty paper depend on your specific printer model.
Perfect for
* Tickets, receipts, boarding passes, and invoices
* Homework, handouts, and meeting notes
* Photos, IDs, and scanned documents
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
Please note, you will need a subscription in order to get access to some features of the app. The subscription will be automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Your iTunes account will be automatically charged at the same price for renewal within a 24-hour period prior to the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your iTunes Account Settings. When a subscription is canceled, access to the features will expire at the end of the current payment period.
Terms of Use: https://evolly.app/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://evolly.app/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00144791:ios.name: Letter Lattice
bluejetty:00144791:ios.summary:
Letter Lattice combines the best parts of anagrams and crosswords into challenging word-weaving madness!
How do DOG and CAT relate to each other? What about GUITAR and MELODY? I made this game as an appreciation for the intertwining nature
bluejetty:00144791:ios.description:
Letter Lattice combines the best parts of anagrams and crosswords into challenging word-weaving madness!
How do DOG and CAT relate to each other? What about GUITAR and MELODY? I made this game as an appreciation for the intertwining nature of words in the English language. 
Most word games have you searching for anagrams within a single word. In Letter Lattice, puzzles use anagrams as connectors to morph from one word to another, each word you find being essential for solving the rest of the puzzle.
— SOMETHING FOR EVERYONE —
Whether you’re better at anagramming or solving crosswords, there’s something that suits you in Letter Lattice. With hundreds of handmade puzzles, beginners can become experts, climbing their way up from “Easy Threes” to the dreaded Super-Skull puzzles.
— SOMETHING FOR COMPETITORS —
“Arcade Mode” pits you against procedurally-generated puzzles of increasing difficulty until the clock runs out. Race to solve as many puzzles as you can, gaining bonus points for finding rare words. Can you reach Milestone 5? What about Milestone 10?!
— SOMETHING FOR ACHIEVERS —
Unlock achievements by completing daily puzzles, solving clues, and zooming through Arcade Mode. As you progress, earn vibrant, hand-crafted color palettes that change the look of the entire game. From the earthy greens of the “Sequoia” palette to the rich pastels of “Coral,” there’s something here you’ll love.
—ALL FEATURES (for FREE!) —
- 20 Puzzle Packs (with 400+ crafted puzzles)
- Infinte Procedural Puzzles in Arcade Mode
- New Puzzles Daily!
- Statistics and Achievements to track progress
- 8 Beautiful Color Palettes
— FULL VERSION 
- 10 More Puzzle Packs
- More Arcade Plays
- Access to the ever-growing Daily Archive
- 4 Additional Color Palettes
- Day/Night Palettes, effectively adding 12 palettes!
~ A note from me ~
— I started developing Letter Lattice after playing these puzzles in a notebook on New York subway commutes. I enjoyed the paper puzzles so much, I spent over a year building the optimal digital interface for the puzzles to exist within.
Along the way, I discovered so much about the English language becoming entranced by the similarities between words I had once thought were very different. I began to appreciate even the simplest of words and how they relate to others. If you have read this far, I hope playing Letter Lattice will help you find this same magic that made me passionate to develop this game.
~ Ethan

bluejetty:00116298:android.description:
🦑 Squid Cleaner Ultimate Pro: Your Smart Device Guardian
Tired of slow performance, cluttered storage, and hidden security risks? Squid Cleaner Ultimate Pro is your all-in-one solution to clean, secure, and enhance your device. We focus on real threats, unnecessary files, and privacy protection — empowering you to take control without compromise.
🔹 Why Choose Us?
✔ Deep Cleaning: Remove cache, redundant files, and duplicates.
✔ Smart Security: Detect risky apps and permissions.
✔ Effortless Management: Control apps, storage, and notifications in one place.
✔ Privacy-First: No data collection, ever.
🔍 Threat Scan
Scan installed apps for security risks by analyzing permissions. We categorize potential issues (e.g., data access, ad spam) so you can secure your phone with confidence. No false alarms — just actionable insights.
🎥 Media Cleaner
Reclaim storage by deleting unnecessary media files (videos, images, audio) in bulk. Our advanced scan highlights duplicates, unused files, and large files — clean your phone without losing important memories.
🔬 Dead Pixels Detector
Run a quick display test to find dead or stuck pixels — perfect for gamers, photographers, and anyone who cares about screen quality.
📸 Photo Duplicate Remover
Free up memory by removing identical photos. Our tool checks pixel-by-pixel matches, ensuring your storage stays tidy while preserving your favourite moments.
🔒 Apps Manager
Uninstall potentially harmful apps, disable pre-installed bloatware, and manage permissions. Every app is assessed for security risks, so you keep only what’s safe.
🔔 Notification Manager
Block unwanted push notifications from intrusive apps. Focus on what matters — a clean and secure communication space.
⚙️ Permissions & Privacy
- QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: Required to list apps for security checks.
- WRITE_SETTINGS (optional): For brightness adjustments (can be skipped).
- Zero data collection: Your app list, media, and browsing history stay on your device.
🔒 Transparency Promise
- We don’t access personal data.
- We don’t sell your information.
- Full compliance with Android security standards.
⚠️ Important Note
Squid Cleaner Ultimate Pro is not a security scanner but a proactive privacy guard. We help you identify risks (e.g., unnecessary files, over-permissioned apps) so you can act first. For maximum protection, pair us with Google Play Protect.
✨ Ready for a Faster, Safer Phone?
Install now and clean your phone like a pro! 🚀

bluejetty:00144530:ios.description:
A Drogasil quer trazer a experiência de compra de nossas lojas para a palma da sua mão. Além dos melhores descontos, nosso app oferece promoções exclusivas que você só vai encontrar aqui.
Você pede no conforto da sua casa e recebe de maneira rápida ou retira na loja mais próxima
Queremos facilitar e para isso, oferecemos um app com navegação simples para que você consiga encontrar tudo o que precisa. Não é apenas um serviço farmacêutico, é a possibilidade de cuidado integrado com a saúde em apenas um clique.
Confira as vantagens que você só encontra baixando o app Drogasil
- Suas ofertas
Queremos sempre oferecer os os produtos que você mais gosta e, por isso, preparamos ofertas exclusivas para você. Basta entrar em "Suas ofertas" e aproveitar seus descontos.
Baixe agora o app Drogasil e aproveite o melhor que a farmácia online pode oferecer! 
- Entrega rápida
Ao comprar no nosso app você não precisa se preocupar, seus produtos podem ser entregues em 90 minutos, consulte a disponibilidade da sua região no app. Tudo isso com um frete que cabe no seu bolso.
Se não quiser esperar pelo delivery, você pode optar pelo "Compre e Retire". Basta escolher a loja mais próxima e retirar seu produto quando estiver disponível, é rápido e simples.
- Benefícios exclusivos
A Drogasil acredita em cuidado integrado com a saúde e, por isso, oferece uma série de benefícios que estão na palma da sua mão. Aqui você pode juntar pontos stix e trocar por prêmios ou até mesmo agendar o seu teste de COVID-19 de maneira rápida.
- Programas de laboratório (PBM)
Em parceria com a indústria, conseguimos oferecer os descontos de laboratório. São cosméticos, produtos para o dia a dia ou medicamentos com os melhores preços para você. Aproveite!
- Perfumaria e dermocosméticos
Aqui você cuida da sua saúde, bem-estar e beleza. A Drogasil oferece uma extensa seleção de cosméticos e dermocosméticos para serem entregues na sua casa ou para retirada na loja mais próxima de você.
- Univers
A Univers é um programa para aquisição de medicamentos para empresas e operadoras de saúde. Desta forma, consegue oferecer remédios com descontos para seus beneficiários
- Os melhores medicamentos genéricos
É aqui na Drogasil que você encontra a melhor seleção de medicamentos genéricos. Temos parceria com os melhores laboratórios para conseguir encontrar o menor preço para nossos clientes.
- Lembretes
Não somos apenas uma farmácia delivery, a Drogasil cuida de você mesmo depois da compra. No nosso app, você adiciona lembretes para saber quando tomar seus medicamentos e quando chega a hora de comprá-los novamente.

Follow me into the wonderful world of Harvest Solitaire Tripeaks for a surprising adventure! Imagine yourself as a free fish, and write legends in the ocean with all kinds of fish! Harvest Solitaire Tripeaks is a fun and challenging solitaire card game for all types of players. Play challenging card games online that will train your brain and keep you sharp or kick back and relax as you enjoy Harvest Solitaire Tripeaks's beautiful game graphics!

* Easy and Fun, you will pick up quick!
* 10,000+ amazing levels – with more on the way!
* Great graphics and amazing beautiful themes.
* Undersea Journey, unlock new adventures and free bonuses.
* Global Leaderboard - you can compete with players around the world.

* Enjoy fun mini-games to win grand treasures.
* Collect ocean fish and gradually unlock the secrets of the sea!

- Train your braind and eliminate your boredom through playing solitaire cards
- Unlock more unique aquariums for your lovely fish friends in Solitaire Ocean

- Design your own decoration and show it to other online players
- Play challenging solitaire cards anywhere without internet conection nor wifi
- Classic klondike card games with creative ways to have endless fun

bluejetty:00014922:ios.summary: e-Sword® — the world's most popular PC Bible study software is now available on the world's most advanced mobile operating system! e-Sword LT is the little brother of e-Sword HD for the iPad, but has many of the same powerful features in a
bluejetty:00014922:ios.description:
e-Sword® — the world's most popular PC Bible study software is now available on the world's most advanced mobile operating system! e-Sword LT is the little brother of e-Sword HD for the iPad, but has many of the same powerful features in a slimmer design for the iPhone. e-Sword LT is feature rich and user friendly. As your Biblical library grows you will appreciate the intuitive layout and synchronization of resources. e-Sword LT is so easy to use you may never need to read the Tutorial!
EVERYTHING NEEDED to study the Bible in an enjoyable and enriching manner. All Bibles, commentaries, dictionaries, … everything is just a tap away!
POWERFUL SEARCHES that are simple to use. Enter as many words you want to search for and select the settings.  You can even search on Strong numbers!
STRONG'S DEFINITIONS are just a tap away and presented in a popover.
SCRIPTURE REFERENCES too are just a tap away and presented in a popover.
COMPARE BIBLES quickly to see how the different versions translate a verse.
LOCATION MAPS pin-point Biblical places on live modern maps to help bring the narrative to life!
READING PLANS designed to help you grow in your knowledge of the Bible.
FORMATTED EMAILS of any selection of any text. Perfect for sharing with others.
No Internet connection is required to use e-Sword LT.
e-Sword LT initially installs with the King James Bible and the King James with Strong's numbers study Bible, the Strong's Lexicon, Smith's Bible dictionary, Meyer's devotional commentary, and the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge cross references. There are over one hundred additional Bibles, commentaries, dictionaries, reference books and devotionals that you can download and add to your library absolutely free!
Also available are some "locked" resources which must be purchased from their publisher. These are copyright and licensing requirements which are unavoidable.
Please note that e-Sword LT is an *ENGLISH* release (but does include Spanish, Portuguese and French UI localization.) There are dozens of non-English Bibles available, but all other content is in English.
The perfect app on the perfect device. What are you waiting for? Download e-Sword LT today and get to studying the Bible!

bluejetty:00161284:ios.name: The Lyrics App
bluejetty:00161284:ios.summary: If you're a songwriter, you probably recognize that melody is usually at least just as important as the lyrics they belong to. If you're a human, you've probably experienced what we like to call "forgetting." Lyrics can be forgotten as easi
bluejetty:00161284:ios.description:
If you're a songwriter, you probably recognize that melody is usually at least just as important as the lyrics they belong to. If you're a human, you've probably experienced what we like to call "forgetting." Lyrics can be forgotten as easily as they're thought of, which is why most of us (Lil Wayne excluded) choose to write them down. Melody, however, can easily be forgotten as well. To combat this, many songwriters end up going back and forth between a notes app and a voice recorder app while writing in order to preserve both their lyrics and the corresponding melodies. With The Lyrics App, there's no need to switch back and forth between apps while you're writing. You can finally write your lyrics and record your melodies in the same place.
Rhyme Generator: The Rhyme Generator provides seamless access to thousands of rhyming words and phrases at your finger tips. To use the generator, simply highlight the word you'd like to see rhymes for (which you can do quickly by double tapping the word), then tap the Rhymes button that appears just above your keyboard. A list of up to 1,000 rhyming words and phrases will then be displayed on a scrollable bar on top of your device's keyboard. Tap one of the rhyme options to replace your highlighted word with the selected option.
Thesaurus: Use the Thesaurus to gain instant access to thousands of synonyms for your lyrics. To use the Thesaurus, highlight the word you'd like to see synonyms for (which you can do quickly by double tapping a word), then tap the Thesaurus button that appears just above your keyboard. A list of up to 1,000 synonyms will then be displayed on a scrollable bar on top of your device's keyboard. Tap one of the options to replace your highlighted text with the selected option.
iCloud Backup: All of your songs, lyrics, and melodies will now be safely backed up to your iCloud (as long as you have storage available, of course). If you lose your phone or have to redownload The Lyrics App for any reason, rest assured that all of the songs you've written will still be available and will automatically be synced to your device after you open the app while you are logged in to your iCloud account on your device. This feature will also keep The Lyrics App synchronized across all of your devices that are logged in to the same iCloud account. 
iCloud Drive: All of your songs, lyrics, and melody recordings will now be backed up to your iCloud Drive. If you've ever wanted to export any of your recordings, this is the solution. From your iOS device, go to the Files app on your phone. From there, tap browse, then select iCloud Drive (if it isn't already selected). In that folder you will see a folder for The Lyrics App, which contains folders for each of your songs. Each song folder contains a text file with the lyrics of the song, as well as a folder containing all of the recordings for that song. You will also be able to access these folders from the Finder on your Mac. In order to utilize this new feature, make sure that iCloud Drive is enabled on your device.

bluejetty:00146020:ios.description:
Welcome to Points - Kids behavior tracker and household chores app that helps parents to reinforce positive behavior in their children, develop good habits, and make them responsible. Our kids' behavior tracker and family chores app came up with a points and rewards system that allows parents to easily track their children's behavior and encourage their positive behavior by awarding them points. Children can utilize these earned points to unlock the different rewards set by their parents. These rewards motivate children to continue their journey toward progress and develop positive behavior and good habits.
Our kids chores and allowance and chore chart app is a user-friendly and easy-to-use app that is specifically designed for parents to make their parenting easier. Parents can not only use our kids behavior tracker and kids chore app to track and improve their children's behavior and habits, but they can also use points - kids chores and allowance and chore chart app as a household chores app to assign different house chores to their children and track them, which include cleaning the room, making the bed, feeding pets, washing dishes, etc and they can motivate their children by rewarding them on completion of these tasks.
Along with parents, teachers can also use our kids behavior tracker and kids chore app to assign different tasks to their students like completing assignments and homework on time, participating in school activities, etc, track their progress, and motivate them by awarding points on the completion of these tasks. Points - The kids behavior tracker and kids chore app also allow teachers to arrange healthy competitions among the students, these competitions motivate them to strive harder to show good performance in the classroom. Teachers can also share children's accounts with their parents to show them their children's performance in the classroom.
Key Features of Our Kids Behavior Tracker & Kids Chore App
- Track your children's behavior with ease, encourage good behavior, and discourage poor behavior. 
- Manage your child's tasks and points conveniently from your mobile device
- Encourage healthy competition by allowing children to track and compare points with siblings and friends.
- Parents can easily award points to their children anytime and anywhere directly from their mobile device.
- Teachers can harness the power of points to motivate students.
- Access visually appealing and informative charts to monitor your child's progress on a weekly, monthly, and yearly basis.
- Customize rewards to suit your child's interests and preferences.
- Reset points effortlessly whenever needed.
- Connect with various groups your child is a part of, such as school clubs, sports teams, or language classes.
- Points specific certificates to encourage your children.
- Children can track their points, tasks, and rewards effortlessly on their devices.
- Create custom behavior or household chores tailored to your needs.
Download Kids Behavior Tracker & Kids Chore App Today!

bluejetty:00090277:ios.description:
پەروەردەکردنی منداڵان، باشترکردنی ڕەفتاریان و چاندنی بەها باڵاکان لە ڕێگەی ناوەڕۆکی هەمەچەشنی خۆشی بەخش، فێرکاری و پەروەردەیی.
ئایا دەتەوێت منداڵەکەت پەروەردەیەکی جوانی هەبێت و بەها باڵاکانی تێدا بچێنرێت؟
ئایا دەتەوێت منداڵەکەت دوور بێت لە ناوەڕۆکی نەشیاو و نا پارێزراو و نا پەروەردەیی؟
ئایا بەدوای ناوەڕۆکێکدا دەگەڕێیت بۆ منداڵەکەت کە گونجاو بێت بە تەمەنی؟
بە خێر بێیت بۆ ئەپڵیکەیشنی ئافەرین، ئەپێکی تاک و بێ وێنەیە کە بە شێوەیەکی خۆش و سەرنجڕاکێش منداڵ فێری بەها جوانەکان دەکات، ئافەرین ژینگەیەکی پارێزراو و سەرنجڕاکێش و ئامانجدار بۆ منداڵان دابین دەکات لە تەمەنی 2 ساڵییەوە تاکوو هەرزەکاری، ئەپەکە هەزاران پارچە کارتۆن و گۆرانی و سروود و چیرۆک بە زمانی کوردی لە خۆ دەگرێت کە گونجاوە بە تەمەنە جیاوازەکانی منداڵان.
سوودەکانی ئەپەکە:
هەموو ئەوەی بە دوایدا دەگەڕێیت بۆ منداڵەکەت، بەردەستە و لە خۆی دەگرێت.
دەروونت ئاسوودەیە بەوەی ئەپێکی پارێزراوە و دوورە لە هەر ناوەڕۆکێکی نەشیاو و نا پەروەردەیی.
 منداڵەکەت فێری بەها باڵاکانی ئایینی پیرۆزی ئیسلام و کۆمەڵگەی ڕەسەنی کوردی دەبێت.
 تەنیا کات بە فیڕۆدان نییە، بەڵکوو هەزاران پارچە ناوەڕۆکی فێرکاری سوود بەخش لە خۆ دەگرێت.
تەواوی ناوەڕۆکی ئەپەکە بە زمانی کوردییە و ئەمەش بەسوودە بۆ گەشەکردنی زمانی منداڵەکەت.
 دەتوانرێت بە پێی تەمەنی منداڵەکەت ناوەڕۆکی ئەپەکە کۆنترۆڵ بکرێت.
 دەتوانرێت ماوەی بەکارهێنانی ئەپەکە سنووردار و کۆنترۆڵ بکرێت.

bluejetty:00099278:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00099278:ios.description:
Hear the World in Perfect Clarity with Our Smart Hearing Companion
In our sound-filled lives, missing important details shouldn't be inevitable. 
Our intelligent hearing enhancement app bridges the gap between you and crystal-clear audio, using advanced technology to personalize every listening experience. 
Designed for both occasional and daily hearing challenges, this app brings professional-grade sound adjustment to your smartphone in an intuitive package.
At the heart of the experience is our precision dual-ear calibration that analyzes and adjusts sound separately for each ear, compensating for hearing differences to deliver perfectly balanced audio. 
Whether you're enjoying music, following conversations, or watching media, you'll notice new depth and clarity. 
The app goes further by automatically detecting your environment - whether you're in a bustling restaurant, outdoors, or a quiet space - and instantly optimizes audio settings without requiring manual adjustments.
For those moments when you need extra help, our amplification feature delivers up to 30dB of clean boost with wired headphones, perfect for situations where every word matters. 
You can gain valuable insights about your hearing through our professional in-app evaluation, which provides personalized recommendations in just minutes.
Challenging listening environments become easier with our speech enhancement technology that isolates voices while reducing background chatter, and our dynamic range optimization that makes soft sounds audible without making loud noises uncomfortable.
The app gives you complete control with features like customizable recording playback - ideal for lectures and meetings - and the ability to save unlimited preset profiles for all your regular environments.
It works seamlessly with both wired headphones and Bluetooth devices, adapting to your preferred way of listening.
Start with our free version that includes basic adjustment tools and hearing guides, or upgrade to premium for enhanced amplification, professional-grade noise reduction, and advanced audio recording features. 
Whether you're looking to enhance occasional listening or need daily hearing support, our app delivers sophisticated sound personalization that helps you rediscover the joy of clear, comfortable hearing in every situation.
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to your Apple ID upon purchase confirmation.
-Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
-Renewal charges occur within 24 hours before the current period ends.
-Manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
-If a free trial is offered, unused portions will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.
Terms and Conditions - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00138621:ios.description:
Accede a análisis político, económico y cultural sin censura de la mano de César Vidal y su equipo. Una plataforma de contenidos creada para combatir las noticias falsas y la desinformación, ofreciendo contexto, rigor histórico y libertad de criterio frente al ruido informativo dominante.
César Vidal TV se ha consolidado como una referencia internacional en geopolítica y geoeconomía, con programas seguidos a diario por una audiencia global que busca comprender los grandes movimientos políticos, económicos y estratégicos que configuran el mundo actual.
Suscribiéndote a César Vidal TV tendrás acceso sin publicidad y de forma anticipada al programa de radio La Voz de César Vidal, así como a una amplia oferta de contenidos exclusivos para suscriptores, entre los que se incluyen programas de televisión como:
• El Gran Reseteo, con César Vidal y Lorenzo Ramírez, referencia en análisis geopolítico y geoeconómico
• Camino del Sur, el espacio musical presentado por César Vidal
• La Mafia Feminista, con César Vidal y Cristina Seguí
• Documentales, especiales y programas de análisis histórico, político y económico
Desde la app de César Vidal TV podrás:
• Ver todo el contenido desde tu móvil o tablet
• Descargar vídeos para verlos sin conexión a Internet
• Crear listas de reproducción con tus programas favoritos
• Enviar los contenidos a tu televisor mediante Chromecast o AirPlay (según dispositivo)
Todo el contenido está diseñado para ofrecer una experiencia cómoda, estable y pensada tanto para el consumo diario como para el análisis en profundidad.
Puedes suscribirte directamente desde la app, utilizando el método de pago asociado a tu dispositivo, de forma rápida y segura. La suscripción te da acceso completo a todos los contenidos exclusivos disponibles en la plataforma.
▷ ¿Ya eres miembro? Inicia sesión para acceder a tu suscripción.
▷ ¿Eres nuevo? Suscríbete en la aplicación para obtener acceso instantáneo.
César Vidal TV ofrece suscripciones de renovación automática. Recibirás acceso ilimitado al contenido en todos tus dispositivos. El pago se carga a su cuenta al confirmar la compra. El precio varía según la ubicación y se confirma antes de la compra. La suscripción se renueva automáticamente a menos que se cancele al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo de facturación actual, o del periodo de prueba (cuando se ofrezca). Cancele en cualquier momento en la configuración de la cuenta.
Para más información consulte nuestro:
-Términos de servicio: https://cesarvidal.tv/terms
-Política de privacidad: https://cesarvidal.tv/privacy

As Trucker Joe, you're a self-made entrepreneur with an old truck and a burning ambition to rise to the top. Experience the thrill of owning and operating your own trucking empire in this immersive truck simulator.

Drive through sprawling landscapes, delivering cargo and completing challenging missions. Upgrade your fleet with powerful trucks and trailers, each with unique capabilities. Plan your routes strategically to maximize earnings and expand your business.

With every successful haul, you'll earn reputation and unlock new opportunities. From hauling heavy machinery to transporting delicate goods, no challenge is too great for Trucker Joe.

Key Features:

* Drive a variety of realistic trucks and trailers
* Explore vast and detailed environments
* Manage your trucking business and upgrade your fleet
* Complete challenging missions and earn rewards
* Experience the life of a real trucker

If you're a fan of truck simulators, then Trucker Joe is the perfect game for you. Download now and start building your trucking empire!

Revolutionize how you watch your favorite content with Screen Mirroring. 
• Enhance the way you mirror your iPhone screen and stream your favorite content to your Smart TV. Whether you want to watch videos, share photos, play games, or display apps on a larger screen, everything works smoothly and wirelessly.

• Stream videos from apps like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more
• Cast photos and videos from your gallery to the big screen
• Watch movies and TV shows in high definition
• Play mobile games on your TV for a bigger experience
• Share presentations, documents, and work materials

• No additional hardware or software needed
• Built-in easy-to-use IPTV player
• Clean, intuitive interface for effortless control
Easy Setup – Start in Seconds
Getting started is simple:
• Connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network
• Select your TV from the list of available devices

bluejetty:00029287:ios.description:

Whether you want to read Scripture, listen to the audio Bible, or grow in your faith, this app helps you stay connected to God’s Word anywhere, anytime.
The NLT is one of the world’s most loved translations, known for its clarity and accuracy. Now you can enjoy it with powerful features that make Bible reading simple, meaningful, and consistent.
Key Features:
- NLT Holy Bible: Access the full New Living Translation - trusted for its readability and faithful meaning.
- Audio Bible: Stay close to Scripture even when your hands are busy. Perfect for driving, exercising, or quiet reflection.

- Dark Mode: Read Scripture easily at night with a beautiful, comfortable dark theme.
- Share Bible Verses: Send encouraging Scripture to friends and family with a single tap.
- Bible Trivia & Quizzes: Test your Bible knowledge and learn in a fun, engaging way.

A Bible App Designed for Your Daily Walk with God

* Learn more through quizzes and notes

Grow Your Faith. Build Your Daily Habit. Stay Rooted in God’s Word.
Download the NLT Bible app today and begin a daily habit of reading and listening to Scripture.
Let God’s Word guide your heart - every single day!

bluejetty:00010727:ios:1.summary: Join your friends and discover videos you love, only on TikTok
bluejetty:00010727:ios:1.description:
TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.
Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.
Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.
TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 
■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.
Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Learn more about our safety tools, resources, and policies at the TikTok Safety Center: https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en

bluejetty:00017167:ios.description:
A modern version of the classic: Klondike Solitaire. 
Includes large tournaments and head-to-head competitions with cash prizes (where available).
Key Features
• Klondike Solitaire: Stack cards into piles to sort them by their suit. Sound easy? It is!
• It only takes a minute or two to play a round, but it's so fun you'll want to play for hours.
• Fast animations and smooth touch controls on all devices.
• Play for free as long as you want without any ads.
No longer a solitary experience! 
• Games can be played Head to Head with other players or in large, multiplayer tournaments.
• In head to head games, both players solve the same deck and the player who finishes with the most points win.
• Challenge people around the world with Skillz®, a competition platform complete with leaderboards, trophies, physical or virtual prizes, and an amazing loyalty program that rewards you for playing!
• Prize tournaments are not enabled in the following states: AR, CT, DE, IN, LA, ME, and SD. If you don't live in a real prize-enabled region, you can still play for fun with our virtual currency.
If you have any questions feel free to reach us at info@tetherstudios.com
If you have any questions about the Skillz® system or cash tournaments please contact: support@skillz.com

**Featured by Apple in Adventure and Role Playing game categories**
Blindscape is a piece of experimental storytelling that takes place entirely through sound, . The narrative is told from the point of view of a man in an authoritarian society who wants to escape his life intolerable life by ending it.
"A whole new take on puzzles . . . emotional and heartfelt." - Playboard.me
"Games like Blindscape are a testament to the fact that even mobile gaming should be considered an art form, especially when done like this." - 148apps.com
Features:
• Stunning Retina-ready HD graphics
• Up to ten minutes of gameplay
• Some guy talking at you
• No In-App Purchases, ratings nagging, or other interruptions
• No badges, achievements, or integration with gamecenter
• Makes you feel like a sophisticated patron of the arts
• A serious, emotionally involving plot line
• Look silly while you poke at the screen trying to find things
Get the soundtrack: music.blindscapegame.com
Sign up for the newsletter: blindscapegame.com
Contact: gavin@gavinbrown.com

bluejetty:00089462:ios.name: Corner
bluejetty:00089462:ios.summary: Want to improve your boxing, lose weight or just get fitter? Bring the boxing studio to your living room with on-demand boxing classes where every punch counts. Stay motivated with real-time leaderboards and track punch stats, calories burn
bluejetty:00089462:ios.description:
Want to improve your boxing, lose weight or just get fitter? Bring the boxing studio to your living room with on-demand boxing classes where every punch counts. Stay motivated with real-time leaderboards and track punch stats, calories burned & more using Corners trackers. Start your 14 day FREE trial today!
Corner Premium membership gives you unlimited access to all of our classes, with the world's best boxing coaches.
CLASSES FOR EVERYONE
Get started with the class that’s right for you, whether it’s your first time or you’re an experienced boxer. The classes we offer: 
- Box + HIIT
- Just Box
- Strength & Conditioning
- Academy
- Warm up and Cool down
APP FEATURES:
- Train with friends on real-time class leaderboards.
- New workouts added every week.
- Classes for everyone ranging from beginner to advanced.
- Improve your boxing technique with the world's best coaches.
- Track your Punch Count, Speed, Power, Work Rate, KO Points & more.
- Connect any bluetooth heart rate monitor to see your heart rate and calories burned.
- Set personalised goals to ensure you're always improving.
- Cast Quick Start, Interval Training or On Demand class leaderboards and live stats from your phone to your TV.
- Track your own boxing workouts anywhere with our quick start and interval timer workout modes.
- Smart boxing timers with customisable round and rest times so you never miss a punch. 
- Sync Corner with the Health app to see your boxing workout data alongside other health metrics in the Health app.
GET STARTED WITH PREMIUM
Corner Premium requires an in-app subscription, available on a monthly or yearly basis. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime from your Apple account settings. All subscriptions start with a 14 day free trial. 
Terms & Conditions: https://trainwithcorner.com/terms

bluejetty:00147437:ios.name: Chatway Live Chat & AI Chatbot
bluejetty:00147437:ios.summary:
Chat with your website customers wherever you are.
Chatway gives you the tools to manage live chat and customer support directly from your mobile device. Reply to website visitors, follow conversations handled by your AI chatbot, check vis
bluejetty:00147437:ios.description:
Chat with your website customers wherever you are.
Chatway gives you the tools to manage live chat and customer support directly from your mobile device. Reply to website visitors, follow conversations handled by your AI chatbot, check visitor activity in real time, and manage messages from multiple communication channels in one customer support app. Whether you're working from your computer or away from your desk, Chatway helps you stay available and respond to customers quickly.
Website live chat from your phone
 See active website visitors and reply to incoming live chat messages from your mobile device. View useful customer and visitor information including visited pages, device type, location, tags, and browsing history. This additional context helps your team understand customer questions and provide more relevant support. You can also access available order details, shopping cart information, and product data inside the conversation, making it easier to assist customers without switching between different tools.
AI chatbot and automated customer service
 Use the Chatway AI chatbot to provide automated customer support and help website visitors around the clock. The AI support agent can use your website content and connected knowledge sources to respond to frequently asked questions, handle repetitive customer inquiries, and provide faster answers. Your support team always remains in control. Review AI chatbot conversations, monitor customer interactions, and join any chat when a customer needs help from a human agent.
Manage multiple customer communication channels
Bring your customer conversations together in a single inbox, including:
* Website live chat
* WhatsApp
* Facebook Messenger
* Instagram
* Email
Manage customer messages without constantly moving between separate communication apps and support tools.
Understand your website visitors
Get valuable information about the people contacting your business:
* See visitors currently browsing your website
* Check the pages each visitor has viewed
* View device and location details
* Access customer tags and conversation information
* See available order, cart, and product data
* Review previous chats and visitor activity
Organize your customer support inbox
Keep your support conversations easy to manage and make sure important messages receive attention.
* View active and resolved customer chats
* Search your conversation history
* Add tags to organize customer inquiries
* Assign chats to different support agents
* Work together with other team members
* Identify conversations that still require a response
Respond to customers more efficiently
* Use saved responses for frequently asked questions
* Customize replies for individual customers
* Send screenshots, images, documents, and files through chat
Control your mobile notifications
Customize how you receive alerts for new customer messages and website visitor activity. Flexible notification settings help your team remain responsive while giving you greater control over mobile alerts.
What you can do with Chatway
* Chat with website visitors in real time from your mobile phone
* Provide 24/7 automated support using an AI chatbot
* Review AI support conversations and switch to human support when necessary
* Answer customer questions using visitor and shopping information
* Manage multiple customer messaging channels from one inbox
* Assign conversations to support team members
* Organize chats using tags and conversation statuses
* Save time with reusable replies for common customer questions
* Manage customer service and website conversations while on the go
You can also access the Chatway web application from desktop or mobile when you need additional customer support tools and account management options.
Visit https://chatway.app to learn more about Chatway and manage live chat, AI chatbot support, customer messaging, and multi-channel customer service from one platform.

bluejetty:00024323:ios.summary:
