Khám phá ngay vận mệnh với Xem Bói, Tướng Số, Tử Vi 2027 – Ứng dụng phong thủy toàn diện và chuyên sâu nhất dành riêng cho bạn.
ĐỘC QUYỀN LUẬN GIẢI NHÂN
bluejetty:00024323:ios.description:
Năm 2027 của bạn sẽ rực rỡ hay nhiều thử thách? Sự nghiệp, tình duyên có gì biến động?
Khám phá ngay vận mệnh với Xem Bói, Tướng Số, Tử Vi 2027 – Ứng dụng phong thủy toàn diện và chuyên sâu nhất dành riêng cho bạn.
ĐỘC QUYỀN LUẬN GIẢI NHÂN TƯỚNG & CHỈ TAY: BẢN THỂ ĐỘC BẢN KHÔNG AI GIỐNG AI
Bứt phá mọi giới hạn của các công cụ bói toán đại trà, ứng dụng tự hào mang đến hệ thống phân tích hình tướng tiên tiến, luận giải sâu sát dựa trên từng đặc điểm sinh học duy nhất của riêng bạn:
• Giải Mã Diện Tướng: Soi chiếu 9 huyệt đạo nhân tướng cùng thần thái ngũ quan, thấu suốt bức tranh thiên mệnh độc nhất vô nhị trên khuôn mặt bạn.
• Luận Giải Thủ Vân: Khám phá 6 đường chỉ cốt lõi và 9 gò tinh tú trong lòng bàn tay – nơi lưu giữ dấu vân thời vận của riêng bạn, tuyệt đối không trùng lặp với bất kỳ ai.
• Hợp Nhất Mệnh Vận: Kết hợp hoàn hảo giữa Diện Tướng và Thủ Vân, khải mở trọn vẹn bản đồ số mệnh mang tính cá nhân hóa cao nhất.
• Tương Hợp Nhân Tướng: Dựa trên sinh khắc ngũ hành, soi chiếu sự giao thoa độc bản giữa hai khuôn mặt để thấu suốt mức độ hòa hợp thực sự trong nhân duyên và sự nghiệp.
CÔNG NGHỆ ĐỘC QUYỀN: BẬC THẦY GIẢI MỘNG – GIẢI MÃ TIỀM THỨC CÁ NHÂN HÓA
Từ chối những cuốn "sổ mơ" dập khuôn, bởi mỗi giấc mộng là một thông điệp vũ trụ gửi gắm cho duy nhất một người. Trải nghiệm công nghệ Giải Mộng độc quyền kết hợp hoàn hảo giữa tâm linh Đông Phương và Tâm lý học Tây Phương:
• Phân Tích Điềm Báo: Lắng nghe thông điệp vũ trụ thiết kế riêng cho mệnh chủ, luận giải chi tiết điềm Cát - Hung - Bình trong sự nghiệp, tiền bạc và tình duyên của chính bạn.

bluejetty:00105222:android.summary: Know that feeling when everything is taken care of? That’s Spiir. Spiir keeps track of your money, so you don’t have to. It has already helped more than 400,000 live the life they want without stressing about money or budgets. And best of a
bluejetty:00105222:android.description:
Know that feeling when everything is taken care of? That’s Spiir. Spiir keeps track of your money, so you don’t have to. It has already helped more than 400,000 live the life they want without stressing about money or budgets. And best of all, the app is free!
Our goal is to make personal finance fun and easy, so you’re able to do the things that matter most to you – whether that’s buying a plane ticket to Paris, inviting all your friends out for drinks next Friday or just seeing your savings account skyrocket. We got your back.
Here’s how you get started in 3 easy steps:
1. Add your bank accounts 
2. Teach the app to categorize your spending
3. Try our challenges and save money in an easy and fun way 
How Spiir can help you: 
• Keep track of all your finances in one place •
Several accounts? In different banks? Not a problem. Spiir gives you one overview of all your finances. By connecting your accounts to Spiir, your transactions are automatically categorized into more than 80 categories. That’s right, you don’t have to do the work. 
• Save money with challenges •
Want to save money? Take on our challenges or create your own. We’ll help you cut your expenses on the things you buy daily. Spiir keeps track of how much money you spend and gives you a heads-up if your spending is running wild or cheer on you if you’re on the right on track. 
• Get your own personal finance assistant •
A happy money-buddy that takes care of all the boring budget stuff and helps you manage your money with ease? You got it. The Spiir assistant crunches the numbers and tells you fun facts about your money habits through quizzes, weekly overviews of your expenses and more. 
• Add important details to your transactions •
Need to save a receipt? Take a picture of it and upload it to a specific purchase. You can also add notes to your transactions or create a #tag to track your spending across different categories, like #Hawaii2020 or #TacoTuesday.
• Stay in the loop •
Always know where you stand financially without having to go through an endless list of transactions or bank statements. Spiir tells you all the important things you need to know about your money with personalized insights and clever notifications. 
• Sounds great! But what about security? •
We love our users. And there’s nothing more important to us than your trust. That’s why we use bank-level security measures to make sure that your personal data is safe. We’re also the first company in Denmark to be registered as a licensed Account Information Service Provider, and we operate under the supervision of the Danish Financial Services Authority. 
• Don’t be shy •
If you have any questions, feedback or awesome savings tips, you’re more than welcome to reach out to us at support@spiir.dk

bluejetty:00081191:ios.description:
Simulate your investments and visualize the growth of your savings through the incredible power of compound interest. 
Whether you're an adept of the FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) movement, planing to make a major purchase, or simply looking to understand how your money can grow over time to support a good retirement, this app will be a great asset in your journey for financial freedom.
This calculator is ideal for simulating fixed income investments, planning your savings, visualizing wealth evolution, and achieving retirement goals or financial independence plans.
Getting started with the "Basic Mode" is easy: Just input the initial amount of money (if any), an optional monthly deposit, the interest rate and how much time you are planing to keep your capital invested. This app will then show you all the information you need in a beautiful graph, accompanied by a detailed analysis for the selected period.
For more customization, the 'Advanced Mode' offers additional features: You can add multiple deposits and withdrawals over time, choose different compounding frequencies (such as daily or quarterly), and adjust the number of days in a year. For example, you can simulate a scenario where you make significant monthly deposits for 30 years, and then begin making annual withdrawals of a percentage of the balance. This calculator is that flexible.
Watch your money work for you, and achieve your financial goals with the magic of compound interest!
Note: This app is for informational purposes only, may contain inconsistencies, and in no way replaces personalized financial advice from a qualified advisor. Investment decisions and life-saving strategies should be based on professional guidance and not on information from unknown sources on the internet.
Terms of Use: https://codexception.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://codexception.com/privacy-policy

- CVS Pharmacy

- Kroger Pharmacy

- Vons Pharmacy
- & more
Prescriptions Up To 80% Off

- Find Rx savings when you search medications
- Check Rx pharmacy prices & redeem coupons to claim your prescription discount
- Health app with discounted meds & patient assistance programs
- Save on pet medications too!
- Healthcare professionals across the country use our app to help patients save money
- Featured by: The New York Times, PBS, ABC News, Forbes, CNN, Good Morning America, The LA Times, & more!

- Meds reminder: Get alerts with our medication reminder
- Medicine tracker: Manage medications with our free drug guide and pill tracker
Telehealth & My Health Care Tool

- Virtual care with online medical professionals

- Understand your medication list & prescriptions
- Prescription delivery & pickup

- Weight Loss management with GLP-1 medications like Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, and Zepbound

- ED: Erectile Dysfunction
- Hair Loss
- Short term medication refills

bluejetty:00120309:ios.description:
LockDown Browser is a custom browser that locks down the exam environment within specific learning and assessment systems. When LockDown Browser is used during an online exam, you are unable to go to other URLs, switch applications, take screenshots, copy questions or print. It essentially locks you into the exam until it’s submitted for grading.
Important: This application can only be used with the Respondus Monitor proctoring system if your instructor has enabled the use of an iPad for the exam. If your instructor hasn't enabled the use of an iPad for the exam, you will be unable to use this application with it.
While LockDown Browser isn’t the most exciting app available, it does make online assessments possible. And, hey, you can download it for free.
This is NOT a limited-feature version and there are NO advertisements of any type.

bluejetty:00036206:ios.description:
Meetly is a video meeting app that allows you to easily communicate with your friends, family, or colleagues. Meetly makes online meetings easier. No sign-up is required.
Meetly uses the open-source Jitsi Server in the backend to process and encrypt all user communication. Jitsi promises better quality and lower latency. 
Meetly allows up to 70 participants in a single meeting. Create a meeting and invite others to join the meeting by sharing the meeting code right from the app. You can also rejoin previous meetings by browsing the meeting history.
Features of the app:
- Easy and secure login using Google or Apple or sign up using email authentication.
- Create meetings and share the meeting link or the meeting code directly from the app.
- Join meetings easily using the meeting link or the meeting code.
- Rejoin previous meetings by browsing the meeting history.
- Password protect your meetings to make your conversations private.
- Up to 70 participants in a single call.
- Chat with other users during the meeting.
- Light & Dark theme options.
Use Meetly to quickly and easily connect with others, be it your friends and family or your colleagues while you are working from home.
We would love to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to us at support@aculix.com for feedback or any queries.
Your usage of this app is governed by the following policies:
Privacy Policy: https://getmeetly.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://getmeetly.app/terms-of-service
Everything else is governed by the terms presented under Apple's End User License Agreement.
Apple's EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Cheers! :)

bluejetty:00037093:ios.description:
Guess Monster: Voice Challenge – The Ultimate Voice Guessing Filter!
Are you ready to put your listening skills to the test? Dive into the fun and exciting world of Guess Monster: Voice Challenge, the app that challenges your ability to recognize voices and sounds in the most thrilling way possible!
In Guess Monster: Voice Challenge, your task is simple – listen to a variety of voices and sounds, and try to guess which monster, character, or creature is speaking. From eerie monster growls to quirky alien tones, the game will keep you guessing and entertained with each new level.
*** Key Feature:
- Endless Fun: Hundreds of unique voices and sounds to keep you hooked.
- Test Your Memory: Spot repeating patterns and tricky voice cues to advance.
- High-Quality Sound: Immerse yourself in vivid sound effects that bring each character to life.
- Compete with Friends: Challenge your friends to beat your scores!
*** Why You'll Love Guess Monster: Voice Challenge:
- Endless Entertainment: With new voices and monsters to guess, the fun never stops.
- Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.
- Great for Social Play: Invite friends and see who can score the highest! Whether you're competing for fun or aiming for the top of the leaderboard, there's always a reason to play again.
If you’re a fan of voice-based puzzles, sound challenges, or just love to test your memory and auditory perception, Guess Monster: Voice Challenge is the game for you! Whether you're playing solo or with friends, you'll never get bored of the amazing array of voices, characters, and challenges.
Download Guess Monster: Voice Challenge now and let the guessing begin! Can you guess every monster’s voice?
* Disclaimer:
- All image of monster not owned by us are the property of their respective owners.
- All image of monster on this app are intended for entertainment purposes only.
*** FAQ ***
How to use (this app):
Step 1: Choose a filter what you like
Step 2: Choose video length and timer
Step 3: Listen to the sound
Step 4: Choose the correct answer
Step 5: React (talk, smile, sing,...) to camera and have fun
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
• You can subscribe to all features within Guess Monster for unlimited access.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly or yearly at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
• You can cancel your subscription via this URL: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://cemsoftwareltd.com/term.html
https://cemsoftwareltd.com/privacyPolicy.html

bluejetty:00060976:ios.summary:
Capptions - EHS Management Your Way
Trusted by companies like Bosch and BP, Capptions is like a blank sheet of (digital) paper. It enables you to digitise your entire safety management process without changing it one bit. From audits and o
bluejetty:00060976:ios.description:
Capptions - EHS Management Your Way
Trusted by companies like Bosch and BP, Capptions is like a blank sheet of (digital) paper. It enables you to digitise your entire safety management process without changing it one bit. From audits and observations to workflow triggers and task assignment, you can manage all things safety, on the go. 
Here are 7 reasons why Safety professionals use Capptions ...
GO PAPERLESS. Create shareable digital forms in minutes and capture all types of safety data, including GPS info and photos.
ENGAGE WORKERS. With an easy-to-use mobile app, employees will be more likely to report near misses, unsafe conditions and other observations.
GET INSIGHTS. See real-time analytics based on your data and track custom metrics.
INSPECT ON THE GO. Do inspections and audits anywhere and submit the data to your office in real time. You can even notify specific people if you want.
AUTOMATE. Trigger predefined actions when you receive an observation. For example, you notice faulty equipment during an inspection. Snap a photo and your team’s admin will receive a notification that something has to be fixed. They can easily assign a to-do to the appropriate worker directly from the Capptions platform. 
IMPROVE REPORTING. Visualise your data with various tools such as bar graphs and pie charts. Generate beautiful, easy-to-read reports in seconds.
PROTECT YOUR DATA. We use SSL256 to encrypt your data, in the air as well as in the database. You own all the data, always. Capptions is 100% GDPR compliant, which means we will never share your data with 3rd parties. 
Say goodbye to spreadsheets, lost forms and endless email threads. Capptions brings safety management wherever you are, making it easier and faster for your entire team.
Download Capptions for free!

Exciting battles in a grand fantasy world brought to you by IGG!
Mobile Royale is a real-time global game for online strategy battle fans.
Develop your city, trade with different clans across the land, train a variety of troops to form your very own army, join a Guild, form alliances, and engage in exhilarating wars!
[Unique Game Features]
*Real-time translations allow battle with players from other countries. Conquer and rule the world with the help of your allies!
*Immerse yourself in beautifully detailed 3D graphics, grand battlefields, and a breathtaking fantasy world!
*Dreamy Airships and a floating fort are part and parcel of your battle strategies and trade affairs. Different troop types and army formations add layers of intrigue to warfare!
*The Heroes you command include humans, elves, dwarves, and beastkin! Be entertained by their fascinating background stories in the grand Hall of Heroes!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MobileRoyaleGlobal

1. Subscription Fees and Subscription Cycle
You can subscribe to the "Value Subscription" within the game for $1.99. Subscription lasts for one week (7 days). (Prices may change based on your region.)
2. Subscription Content
Players who have bought the subscription get to enjoy the perks during the subscription period.

Subscriptions will be automatically renewed on the App Store, and the fee will be charged to your iTunes Account. Automatic renewal settings must be manually changed on your iTunes/Apple ID settings. Terms of Service https://policies.igg.com/terms_of_service

Follow these steps on your Apple device if you would like to cancel your subscription: Settings→iTunes and App Store→Tap on your Apple ID→Check Apple ID→Account Settings→Subscriptions→Manage→Select the corresponding subscription for "Mobile Royale"

vLunar brings the Vietnamese lunisolar calendar into a modern, elegant experience designed for everyday use. Quickly check lunar dates, explore traditional zodiac hours, manage important events, and stay connected to Vietnamese cultural dates — all from one beautifully simple app.
Built for the Apple ecosystem, vLunar delivers a seamless experience across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, with a growing collection of widgets that put essential lunar information exactly where you need it.

- Beautifully redesigned home screen with a clean, modern interface

- Apple Watch support for instant lunar date tracking
- Location-based daylight time for more accurate zodiac hours
- Traditional Vietnamese zodiac hour information for any date
- Infinite calendar navigation combining Gregorian and lunar dates
- Month view with quick year navigation

- Sync events with your device calendars
- Notifications for vLunar services and your private calendar events
- Keep track of Tết, traditional holidays, anniversaries, and important dates
- Designed with privacy in mind — vLunar collects no personal user data
Whether you need a quick glance at today’s lunar date, want to find a suitable zodiac hour, or simply want to keep track of important Vietnamese cultural dates, vLunar makes the lunar calendar feel effortless.

bluejetty:00151789:ios.description:
Transform Your Look with Piercing AI!
Thinking about a new piercing but not sure how it will look or where it should go? Want to try multiple styles without the commitment? Piercing AI: Piercing Filter brings your ideas to life by letting you preview realistic piercings on your own photos in seconds.
Upload a photo, pick a style, and let our advanced AI place jewelry naturally with accurate lighting and shadows. From subtle nostril studs to statement helix stacks, explore limitless combinations and design your perfect look before you visit the studio.
Key Features:
Instant Try-On:
Upload a photo and see ultra-realistic results in moments. The AI aligns to your features, blends lighting and skin tones, and delivers a photo-real finish no manual masking required.
Explore Styles:
Browse curated categories like Helix, Daith, Tragus, Conch, Septum, Nostril, Medusa/Labret, Eyebrow, and more. Each tile opens a clean style page (no before/after clutter) with a clear reference of how that piercing typically sits.
Style Screen:
At the top, upload your photo; below, review the style reference. Tap Apply with AI to place the selected piercing instantly. Fine-tune size, position, angle, and jewelry type (studs, hoops, rings).
Describe Mode:
Prefer full control? Type exactly what you want piercing type, side/placement, quantity, and jewelry details (e.g., “double helix, small hoops, left ear” or “septum, thin ring, subtle look”) and generate a custom design.
History & Sharing:
Save every look, compare variations, rename favorites, and share with friends or your piercer for feedback.
Natural Results:
Smart lighting, shadow matching, and anatomy-aware placement make your mockups look believable at a glance so you can focus on style, not editing.
Disclaimer: Visualisation only. Piercing AI does not provide medical advice or replace professional consultation. Always follow professional guidance for placement, jewelry, and aftercare.

bluejetty:00183075:ios.name: Bridge Constructor Stunts!
bluejetty:00183075:ios.summary:
The successful Bridge Constructor series – number 1 in the AppStore in over 60 countries, with over 30 million players worldwide – treads new paths with Bridge Constructor Stunts! 
Stuntman and engineer in one? No problem with Bridge Const
bluejetty:00183075:ios.description:
The successful Bridge Constructor series – number 1 in the AppStore in over 60 countries, with over 30 million players worldwide – treads new paths with Bridge Constructor Stunts! 
Stuntman and engineer in one? No problem with Bridge Constructor Stunts!
Build imposing ramps and loops to reach your goal in the diverse stages. But building structures alone isn't enough this time: you sit behind the wheel of the vehicles yourself and have to maneuver them skillfully to the goal. Collect stars, complete daredevil jumps, flips and spectacular stunts, leaving behind a trail of destruction across the entire level to beat the high score. But you can only do all that with perfectly constructed bridges and ramps.
Join the huge Let's Play community
To ensure none of your jumps are forgotten, you can save your runs as videos, upload them via the sharing feature and share them with your friends. Let the world be part of your most outrageous jumps!
Improved Construction Mode
Once again you have access to a variety of building materials with different properties. Numerous improvements make building even easier: simply tap to convert a beam you have built into road, and vice-versa. Tap and hold on a part of the construction and you now have the option to reposition your structures without having to build them from scratch. 
Loose Screw!
We have hidden some hard-to-reach screws in some of the levels. Find and collect them, and you might be able to put these screws to good use in the future...
FEATURES: 
- The latest instalment in the internationally successful Bridge Constructor series!
- Improved and simplified Construction Mode
 - Build ramps and drive vehicles across them yourself
 - Diverse levels with different objectives: collect stars, score target, reach the goal… 
- Delivery vans and dump trucks with cargo that wreaks havoc when coming loose, but is also useful to help you collect items
 - Various building materials
 - Spectacular stunts and rampages of destruction
 - Achievements and rankings
 - Replay feature and video sharing: save your best bridge crossings and stunts and share them with your friends
Follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram: 
www.facebook.com/BridgeConstructor
www.twitter.com/headupgames
www.instagram.com/headupgames
If you have any problems with the game or would like to share feedback or suggestions for improvements, please send us an email: support@headupgames.com

bluejetty:00103912:android.description:
“Welcome to your own personal FirstBank branch.”
Download our free app and bank securely from your mobile device 24/7. Now, every waiting room and living room can be your private FirstBank. Just enroll in Online Banking and you’re ready to start!
MANAGE YOUR ACCOUNT:
• Fingerprint Login: With just the touch of a button you can have access to your account. Fingerprint Login allows you to login quickly and securely using the fingerprint scanner on your device.
• FirstGlance: Spin the cube! Quickly view balances and eBills due without logging in. Simply enroll and set up the accounts you would like to view (up to 3) by selecting “FirstGlance” within the main menu. After enrolled, spin the FirstBank cube before login to access FirstGlance.
• Mobile Deposit: Deposit your check through the app. Anywhere you have a phone you have a personal FirstBank branch. Simply take a picture of the front and back of the check and submit your deposit.
• Zelle®: With Zelle® you can quickly send, receive and request money to friends and family using only their email address or mobile phone number and name. This is how money moves®
• Pay Now: Receive a notification on the Account Summary page when your FirstBank credit card, cash reserve, or loan is due. Rest your weary fingers and save time by clicking the Pay Now button to transfer the funds.
• Bill Pay: Receive your bills electronically and schedule your bill payments all in one location. Bill Pay can be used to pay anyone in the United States that you would normally pay by check, automatic debit, or cash.
• Account Details: Check balances on your accounts and loans, transfer money between FirstBank accounts, and schedule a payment on an existing FirstBank loan.
• Communication Center: Bank mail allows you to communicate securely with the bank and receive messages and tasks related to your loan requests. Setup Alerts to get notified by text message, email, or push notification.
*FirstBank is a regional bank found in Colorado and Arizona. If you don’t see an orange cube on your bank statements, you’re probably a member of a different First Bank, and this app will not work for you.

bluejetty:00086686:ios.description:

With its blend of simplicity, depth, and challenge, Connections Puzzle Word Game is poised to become your new favorite pastime.

bluejetty:00026402:ios.description:
Solitaire Master is an incredibly popular solitaire game that offers you a fantastic way to have fun and keep your mind sharp! Whether you're looking to challenge your brain or just unwind and have a good time, this solitaire game has got you covered! The classic solitaire challenge immerses you in a world of puzzles, allowing you to engage your mind and solve card puzzles anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. 
The gameplay of Solitaire: Card Games Master is simple and easy to get the hang of, you only need to drag the cards to the destination to win. Whether you are a Solitaire game expert or a beginner, this classic Solitaire game is guaranteed to be an enjoyable experience!
How to Play :
Setup: Deal 28 cards from the deck into 7 tableau piles, with the number of cards increasing from left to right, starting with one card and ending with seven.
Foundations piles: The goal of the game is to move all the cards to 4 foundation piles. The foundation piles are built in ascending order, starting with an Ace and ending with a King. 
Tableau piles: You should stack the cards in descending order, alternating between red and black suits. A King or a group of cards starting with a King can be moved to an empty tableau pile. 
Moving cards: You can move face-up cards between tableau piles as long as they are in descending order and alternate in color. You can also move the entire sequence of cards by clicking on the topmost card in that sequence.
Stock pile: If you have no cards to move, you can click on the stock pile to deal more cards. If the stock pile is exhausted, you can click on the empty space to deal again.
Solitaire features:
Completely free to enjoy Klondike solitaire games anytime. 
Daily puzzles - unlock new solitaire challenges every day. 
Play offline with no wifi - a great puzzle game for killing time. 
Unlimited card hints and undo options to increase your chances of solving card puzzles.
Customize your Solitaire game with various backgrounds and card designs. 
Enhance comfort with left-hand mode while playing solitaire games. 
Card statistics to help you surpass yourself in the Solitaire game. 
Classic Solitaire also allows you to experience the fun of sorting games.
If you're looking for a free brain training game, Solitaire: Card Games Master is an absolute must-try! This game will bring you endless fun and intellectual challenges that'll keep you hooked! Take on different difficulty levels, tackle a variety of puzzles, and watch as your logical thinking and memory skills soar to new heights without you even realizing it.So, what are you waiting for? Play now!

listings.description:
Solitaire Master is an incredibly popular solitaire game that offers you a fantastic way to have fun and keep your mind sharp! Whether you're looking to challenge your brain or just unwind and have a good time, this solitaire game has got you covered! The classic solitaire challenge immerses you in a world of puzzles, allowing you to engage your mind and solve card puzzles anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. 

The gameplay of Solitaire: Card Games Master is simple and easy to get the hang of, you only need to drag the cards to the destination to win. Whether you are a Solitaire game expert or a beginner, this classic Solitaire game is guaranteed to be an enjoyable experience!

How to Play :
Setup: Deal 28 cards from the deck into 7 tableau piles, with the number of cards increasing from left to right, starting with one card and ending with seven.
Foundations piles: The goal of the game is to move all the cards to 4 foundation piles. The foundation piles are built in ascending order, starting with an Ace and ending with a King. 
Tableau piles: You should stack the cards in descending order, alternating between red and black suits. A King or a group of cards starting with a King can be moved to an empty tableau pile. 
Moving cards: You can move face-up cards between tableau piles as long as they are in descending order and alternate in color. You can also move the entire sequence of cards by clicking on the topmost card in that sequence.
Stock pile: If you have no cards to move, you can click on the stock pile to deal more cards. If the stock pile is exhausted, you can click on the empty space to deal again.

Solitaire features:
Completely free to enjoy Klondike solitaire games anytime. 
Daily puzzles - unlock new solitaire challenges every day. 
Play offline with no wifi - a great puzzle game for killing time. 
Unlimited card hints and undo options to increase your chances of solving card puzzles.
Customize your Solitaire game with various backgrounds and card designs. 
Enhance comfort with left-hand mode while playing solitaire games. 
Card statistics to help you surpass yourself in the Solitaire game. 
Classic Solitaire also allows you to experience the fun of sorting games.

If you're looking for a free brain training game, Solitaire: Card Games Master is an absolute must-try! This game will bring you endless fun and intellectual challenges that'll keep you hooked! Take on different difficulty levels, tackle a variety of puzzles, and watch as your logical thinking and memory skills soar to new heights without you even realizing it.So, what are you waiting for? Play now!

bluejetty:00182783:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00182783:ios.description:
■Challenge players worldwide in multiplayer!
You can race against up to seven other players, whether they're registered as in-game friends, nearby, or scattered around the world.
Multiplayer races can be customized with a variety of rules, such as individual or team races, kart speed, and number of item slots. You can play however you want!
■ Mario Kart takes a world tour!
Mario and friends go global in this new Mario Kart as they race around courses inspired by real-world cities in addition to classic Mario Kart courses! These destinations will be featured in tours that rotate every two weeks! In addition to courses based on iconic locales, some of your favorite Mario Kart characters will get variations that incorporate the local flavor of cities featured in the game!
■ Endless Mario Kart fun at your fingertips!
The Mario Kart series known and loved by many is ready to take the world by storm – one smart device at a time! With just one finger, you can steer and drift with ease and sling devastating items as you go for the gold in cups filled with new and classic Mario Kart courses.
■ Nab 1st place with items and Frenzy mode!
In Mario Kart Tour you have access to an arsenal of powerful items that can mix things up on the racetrack! Turn up the heat by activating the new Frenzy mode, which gives an unlimited supply of a certain item and makes you invincible! Make the most of the ensuing chaos, as Frenzy mode only lasts a short time!
■ Collect drivers, karts, badges, and more!
Earn Grand Stars by racing or fire off the featured pipe to receive more drivers, karts, and gliders! You can also proudly display badges, earned by completing certain challenges, next to your in-game name!
■ Bonus challenge courses put a twist on traditional races!
In certain races, 1st place isn't always the goal. With names like "Vs. Mega Bowser" and "Goomba Takedown," these bonus challenge courses demand a different approach to gameplay and strategy!
■ Race to increase your online rank!
Boost with the best of 'em! Your high scores will determine how you compare to other players all over the world. Keep practicing and trying out different combinations of drivers, karts, and gliders to increase your score and rise to the top!
Note: A Nintendo Account is required to play Mario Kart Tour.
* Free-to-start; optional in-game purchases available. Persistent Internet, compatible smartphone, and Nintendo Account required. Data charges may apply.
* For information about our ads, please see the “How we use your information” section of the Nintendo Privacy Policy.
* May include advertising.
© 2019 Nintendo
Mario Kart is a trademark of Nintendo.

bluejetty:00174357:ios.description:
Fight with "Hero Dino", a captivating epic Idle RPG game. Lead legendary Dino, use powerful skills, and collect powerful items. Defeat enemies with devastating attacks and earn abundant rewards. Team up with strong friends, conquer raid bosses, and level up quickly. Progress even when you're not playing through idle gameplay.
Endless contents are waiting for you! Power up your epic Hero Dino and challenge all the special quests. With strong epic Dino friends and powerful skills, hunt the strong Boss of the enemies and treasure of them. You will get plentiful rewards and gold!
1. COLLECT POWERFUL HEROES 
-Assemble a team of mighty Dino’s friends to aid you in your quest. 
-Unlock and recruit more legendary heroes with unique abilities to form the ultimate dinosaur dream team.
2.TRAIN AND UPGRADE YOUR HEROES 
-Unleash the power and upgrade Dino’s abilities by fighting the enemies to save the Dino town. 
-Collect powerful equipment and gear to enhance their stats and optimize their performance in the fight. 
-With each level gained, Dino will become the hero of the war.
3.SPECIAL QUESTS AND REWARDS 
-Conduct special quests and challenge to earn exclusive rewards. 
-Upgrade your Dino and Play all the contents in the game to get plentiful rewards. 
-These rewards will help to upgrade Dino’s power rapidly.
4.Roll the dice and get epic items 
-Roll the dice to move forward and acquire various items. 
-Use the items to enhance the weapons and armor of Dino and friends.
5.Enjoy RPG action and auto Idle battle 
-Create your own powerful Avengers team and become an action hero! 
-Even when your phone is resting, even when you’re offline, your heroes engage in the battle!
-Your idle heroes will defeat the diligent villains!
- Experience the thrill of an AFK gaming adventure!
=====================================

Composed by DongDongDong Trio
Piano Dongwook Kim, Dongyeon Kim, 
Bass Donghwi Kim

ALL THE SOCCER IN THE WORLD AT THE CLICK OF A BUTTON 
BeSoccer is the best live soccer app with news, results and football stats.
We cover more than 2,000 competitions: you will be able to follow all games live, receive notifications of goals, line-ups, news, signings and today’s televised matches. 
Discover the best database in the world of soccer with all the stats on your teams, favourite players from across the world, comparisons, team’s form and the latest transfer rumours.
----------------------------------- 
LOOK NO FURTHER FOR SOCCER APPS, BESOCCER IS THE BEST SOCCER LIVE SCORES APP 
----------------------------------- 
• All the kick off times of today’s matches 
• Find out which channels your favourite matches are on 
• Latest soccer news and transfer rumours 
• Follow all matches live from across the world
• Large number of stats on players and teams 
• Minute by minute commentary on the main matches. 
• Analysis and prediction of the results of matches based on our users' opinion. 
• Videos with stats on your favourite teams and players. 
• Elegant interface which is easy to use
• Save energy with night mode
PERSONALISE THE APP BASED ON YOUR INTERESTS 
Receive and personalise live notifications or on your favourite teams, players or competitions: all goals, results, tables, squad lists, lineups, cards, injuries, transfer moves, etc. 
STANDINGS, RESULTS, STATS AND MUCH MORE 
All stats, news and results from all leagues and competitions in the world: La Liga, Premier League, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, MLS, Liga MX, and other competitions like Champions League, Europa League, Concacaf Champions League, Gold Cup, Eurocup, World Cup, etc. Also women’s football
THE LARGEST SOCCER DATABASE IN THE WORLD 
We have the most in depth information, stats and news from all the clubs in the world: Real Madrid, Barcelona, Man United, Man City, Arsenal, Liverpool, Chelsea, Tottenham, PSG, Juventus, Bayern Munich and all of your favourite players: Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Haaland, Mbappe, Mo Salah, Sterling, Lewandowski...
SEARCH FOR PLAYERS, COMPETITIONS AND PLAYERS 
Search for as many things as you want as there is no limit. You can compare stats between players and see who has played more matches, scored more goals, got more assists, compare players’ attributes, trophies and responds to questions like: Who has more trophies, Messi or Ronaldo? Hazard or Salah? Mbappe or Neymar? Which player has scored more goals? Who has played more matches, Haaland or Benzema? Which team has the most league titles?

Ever forgot names, numbers, dates, or places that were mentioned during the call?
Don't always have a notebook to write important details that come up in a phone conversation?
Tired of people denying their own words? Wouldn't it be nice to have a phone call recording to resolve any dispute?
Call Recorder for iPhone - a must-have app for personal as well as business calls. Hiring managers, journalists, lawyers, businessmen, other professionals, and anyone wanting to record phone calls will enjoy using the call recorder app.
Get Call Recorder for iPhone now to:
- Save every detail of each personal or business call
- Access and listen to your recordings anytime, anywhere
- Share phone calls with other people and apps

- No limits on the recording of incoming and outgoing calls;
- Enjoy clear calls with a high-quality recording;

bluejetty:00070127:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00070127:ios.description:
**An Apple Best of 2019 Game**
Spread Chaos across the Old World! Command a horde as you build a fortress capable of conquering the Empire of Man – and any other Chaos warbands that stand in your way. With enough power, you will prove your worth to the Chaos Gods by conquering Altdorf and becoming the Everchosen!
Set in the Warhammer Fantasy universe, Warhammer: Chaos & Conquest is real time massively multiplayer strategy game where players compete for the resources of the Old World and battle for control of the Old World.
COMMAND A TERRIFYING WARBAND 
• Collect Warlords to be your most powerful soldiers in the war against the Empire
• Over 20 Daemons of Chaos & 10 warriors of Chaos to collect 
• Use your strategy to assemble a diverse warband capable of smashing the defenses of your foes
• Daily challenges to complete with guaranteed rewards & bonuses based on leaderboards!
BUILD A CHAOS FORTRESS POWERFUL ENOUGH TO MARCH ON ALTDORF
• Raise a Champion worthy of the title of Everchosen
• Research Skills to expand your military, battle, & unholy might
• Increase your power by building structures including the Chaos Temple, Sorcerer’s Citadel, Fortress Walls, Watchtower, Warlord Conclave, Workshop, Daemonic Forge, Hell Cannons, Dungeons, Training Grounds, & more. 
• Collect more resources by upgrading your Lumber Mill, Blast Furnace, Slaughter Pens, & Quarry
ATTACK YOUR ADVERSARIES FOR THE GLORY OF CHAOS
• Vanquish roaming beasts to send them to their final resting place 
• Send your warriors on marches throughout the realm to pillage goods from the land
• Siege other players fortresses to muck up their plans of conquest in favor of your own 
• World chat for discussing the battle results with your enemies!
WORK TOGETHER WITH TRUSTED ALLIES
• Join an alliance to coordinate the conquest of landmarks important to the Empire 
• share the spoils with your alliance! As your alliance collects resources, your allies automatically earn additional spoils 
• Assist your allies by speeding up their construction of their Chaos Fortress 
• Send your troops to assist your alliance in defense, or receive warriors from your allies to make your fortress unbeatable
• Complete Trials, both solo & with your alliance, to make your army more powerful
• Gather with your Alliance to take over the major landmarks of the Old World
DEVOTE YOURSELF TO CHAOS
• Pledge your alliance to the Chaos Gods – Khorne, Nurgle, Tzeentch, & Slaanesh! Bring the chaos they desire to the Old World!
• Build a temple to Nurgle, the Plague Lord and god of disease, decay, and death!
• Build a Temple to the Dark Prince Slaanesh, the God of lust, pride, and decadence! 
• Build a temple to the changer of Ways, Tzeentch, the god of magic, change, and sorcery!
• Construct a temple to the blood God Khorne! The god of violence, carnage, and anger is eager for the spill of blood.
IMMERSE YOURSELF IN THE CLASSIC LORE OF WARHAMMER FANTASY
• Special events to conquer roaming warbands of other Warhammer Fantasy factions, including greenskins, beastmen, & dwarfs! 
• Iconic Warhammer Fantasy locations, including: Chaos Wastes, Norsca, Troll Country, & the Empire of Man
• Iconic Warhammer creatures to housing in your dungeons, including Chaos Spawn, Slaughter Brutes, mutalith vortex beasts, & dragon ogres
• Iconic Warhammer infantry available for training, including Marauders, Forsaken, Chaos Warriors, & Chaos Chosen
• Iconic Warhammer beasts to corral, including: Warhounds, Chimera, Gorebeasts
• Collect warpstone through daily quests
Carve your own legend in the Warhammer Fantasy Old World. Become the Everchosen of Chaos.
Spread Chaos & Join the Chaos Community:
https://www.facebook.com/ChaosConquest
www.chaosandconquest.com 
Terms of Use: http://www.tiltingpoint.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: http://www.tiltingpoint.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00017232:ios.name: Supremacy 1914 - World War 1
bluejetty:00017232:ios.summary: Choose your favorite nation during WWI and assume the highest office in your empire. Balance the production of materials, troops and weaponry with the resources your land has to offer. Form alliances, do important trade deals or fight by yo
bluejetty:00017232:ios.description:
Choose your favorite nation during WWI and assume the highest office in your empire. Balance the production of materials, troops and weaponry with the resources your land has to offer. Form alliances, do important trade deals or fight by yourself through the a 1st World War scenario of your chosing.
Take your strategy to the next level with Heroes. Deploy iconic leaders like T.E. Lawrence and Viscount Allenby, each with unique abilities that enhance your armies and tactics. Heroes bring powerful boosts, from improving troop efficiency to amplifying combat effectiveness, giving you a decisive edge on the battlefield. Upgrade and position them strategically to turn the tide of war and secure victory.
This period demands a valiant leader like you. Ensure your people's survival, train them to join their brothers in arms on the battlefields on foot, as cavalry or even place them into the first experimental tank. Develop your country and slowly conquer the world. 
 “Immersive Strategy – This is not a game that you play once and forget; the world map is huge, and the options available are vast. Your game may go on for months at a time!” 9.3/10 – MMO Games
 “Supremacy 1914 seems pretty interesting and will definitely be one of your favorites if you like this genre. There is also role playing going on which will make you feel at home.” 8.6/10 – OMGSpider
Veteran grand strategy players will see their strategic skills be put to use on the battlefields in this huge World War I game, battling with economy, armies and the ever growing threat presented by your opponents. Play as Wilhelm II or change history however you want. In Supremacy your imagination and skill are your only limits! Up to 500 players can compete in real time on historical and fictional scenarios.
FEATURES
- Real Time Multiplayer
- Up to 500 real opponents per map
- Realistic distances and unit movement
- Multiple maps and scenarios to play
- Historically accurate troops and vehicles
- Experimental weapons and units of the time
- Deploy and upgrade Heroes with unique abilities
- Frequent updates and new content
- Forge alliances with other players
- Win together in coalitions
- Play on all of your devices
S1914 is free to download and play. Some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you do not want to use this feature, please set up password protection for purchases in the settings of your App.

bluejetty:00015515:ios.name: My Town : Museum
bluejetty:00015515:ios.summary: At My Town's Museum, there is something fun and exciting in every room and something to play with behind every corner. Get your tickets ready and take the grand tour. Awaken the ancient mummies of Egypt, visit our prehistoric exhibition and
bluejetty:00015515:ios.description:
At My Town's Museum, there is something fun and exciting in every room and something to play with behind every corner. Get your tickets ready and take the grand tour. Awaken the ancient mummies of Egypt, visit our prehistoric exhibition and dig for dinosaur bones, put your armor on and ride your horse in a jousting tournament and even go to space. My Town museum is a both fun and educational.
WHY DO KIDS AND PARENTS LOVE MY TOWN GAMES?
That is an easy one to answer! My Town games are the digital version of the good old dollhouse. Our games promote imagination and they are completely stress free. No winning or losing, no Start and no end. Kids can literally invent a new game or adventure each time they play. Kids can play our dollhouse games alone or with parents. Create your own town by checking out our other My Town games.
PLAY, IMAGINE, DISCOVER
Play inside the huge museum and visit the various exhibitions: Space, Prehistoric, Medieval, Egyptian and Arts. Imagine visiting the cave man's house, visit far away planets and learn about the solar system. Have fun putting together the museum's picture collection starring the Mona Lisa. With cool costumes and playing instruments from the Egyptian era to fun shopping at the souvenir gift shop your imagination can go wild. 
FEATURES:
1. NEW - Save game mode. If you exit the game, it will not reset the elements.
2. NEW - Multi Touch function. You can now play together with your parent or friend on a single Tablet or phone
3. NEW - Menu redesigned 
4. 5 different Exhibition shows - Prehistoric, Arts, Medieval, Space and Egyptian 
5. 14 Characters to play with including kings Mummies, knights and a cave man!
6. Exciting clothing and costumes addition: Cave man, princess, knight, queen and many many more
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP:
Girls and Boys of all ages. Young kids age 4 can play with their parents or alone since our games are easy to pick up. Older kids can play alone in a safe parental control environment. No ads or in-app purchases. Extra Long play-ability and great educational value.
WE MAKE THE GAMES THAT KIDS WANT TO PLAY
Keep sending us cool ideas for new and exciting locations you would like us to create. We promise to read each and every request or message you send at our Tweeter, YouTube or Facebook page.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter: https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Website: Http://www.my-Town.com

bluejetty:00071678:ios.description:
Centuries after a meteor impact nearly wipes out mankind, two factions evolve - one biological, the other mechanical. Now, both are locked in a desperate war for survival. Choose your hero, summon an unstoppable army, unleash devastating powers, and wipe out the enemy in this action-packed real-time strategy game.
--------------------------------------------
REAL TIME STRATEGY (RTS) OR THIRD-PERSON-SHOOTER (TPS)
Choose your faction, choose your hero, and go to war. Play with one hand while commanding above the battlefield, or join the battle in an action-packed third-person shooter - the choice is yours!
MASSIVE CAMPAIGN
Wage war across a post-apocalyptic world as you attack and defend in a massive single-player campaign.
POWERFUL SPELLS & HEROES
Choose from six unique heroes, each with dozens of powerful spells to bring into battle. Crush your enemies with the Berserker, disintegrate them with the Nova, overwhelm them with the armies of the Necromancer, and more!
CRAFT POWERFUL ITEMS
Collect items and use them to craft rare and powerful artifacts that supercharge your heroes, spells, and troops!
GRAPHICS
Experience incredible 3D graphics, dynamic lighting, and detailed particle effects. You'll be immersed in this dark and war-torn fantasy world!
FANTASY MEETS SCI-FI
Summon fantasy creatures, or build sci-fi war machines. Cast spells, or unleash firepower. Use magic or technology to win the war - the choice is yours in this unique merging of genres!
SOCIAL MEDIA
Find us (@FoursakenMedia) on Discord, Twitter, or Facebook for the latest news and updates!

bluejetty:00086141:ios.name: Baby Milestone Tracker Sprouty
bluejetty:00086141:ios.summary:
Sprouty is your companion through the tough and lovely moments of parenting. Understand your baby's leaps, find your rhythm with sleep and feeding, and feel more confident and supported along the way.
Trusted by 2,500,000+ moms and dads.
bluejetty:00086141:ios.description:
Sprouty is your companion through the tough and lovely moments of parenting. Understand your baby's leaps, find your rhythm with sleep and feeding, and feel more confident and supported along the way.
Trusted by 2,500,000+ moms and dads.
BABY LEAPS CALENDAR
Be ready for your baby's next leap and understand why sleep, feeding, and mood may change, or why your little one may be fussier than usual. Our calendar covers 11 baby leaps, with explanations developed together with pediatricians to help you understand what's happening as your baby learns new skills. Get a personalized heads-up about upcoming leaps based on data from your baby's trackers, so you can prepare for changes in their everyday routine.
PERSONALIZED SLEEP SCHEDULE
Plan naps and bedtime around your baby's age and sleep patterns, with a schedule that adjusts as you track sleep. Know when it may be time for your baby to wind down, fall asleep, and rest — and find moments to rest yourself.
SLEEP, FEEDING, AND EVERYDAY ROUTINES
Track sleep, breastfeeding, bottle feeds, diaper changes, pumping, and your baby's mood in one place. Set reminders for everyday care, so there's less to remember on busy parenting days. Keep sleep and feeding timers close and check them right from your lock screen.
HEIGHT, WEIGHT, AND HEAD CIRCUMFERENCE
Track your baby's measurements over time and compare them with World Health Organization growth standards.
230+ DEVELOPMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Enjoy a ready-made daily set of short, playful activities suited to your baby's stage of development. Spend time discovering new things together, with a handy checklist to keep track of the activities you've completed.
PRECIOUS MOMENTS JOURNAL
First smile, first tooth, first step — save the moments you want to remember and share them with family and friends.
FAMILY SHARING
Share access with your partner or other caregivers so everyone can keep up with your baby's routine and help with everyday care.
SUPPORT WHILE YOU'RE EXPECTING
Still waiting to welcome your baby? Explore pregnancy mode and helpful articles for this part of your parenting journey.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
A subscription unlocks additional features and content. Find available plans, prices, and what's included in the app.
– Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase.
– Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
– Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings.
More details: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
FROM THE APP'S CREATOR
Hello! I'm Dima, dad to Elli. When she was born, my whole world turned upside down. I learned about baby leaps and how challenging they can be for babies and parents, so I created an app to keep track of them. Other parents started using it too, and today Sprouty supports millions of families. It means so much to me that an app I built for my daughter now helps other parents too. Thank you for being here.
Privacy Policy: https://sprouty.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sprouty.app/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00121485:ios.name: Jambl: DJ Band & Beat Maker
bluejetty:00121485:ios.summary:
Compose tasty beats in seconds and share them with the world. Tap, swipe, and play while JAMBL's smart engine keeps everything in key, in groove, and on point. No experience needed. You can create even with your eyes closed.
▶ Turn Gesture
bluejetty:00121485:ios.description:
Compose tasty beats in seconds and share them with the world. Tap, swipe, and play while JAMBL's smart engine keeps everything in key, in groove, and on point. No experience needed. You can create even with your eyes closed.
▶ Turn Gestures Into Tracks
Our smart algorithm keeps your taps in scale and on beat. Create endless beats, basslines, and melodies on the fly. No premade loops. Everything you make is truly yours, 100% original with all rights belonging to you. Use your creations however you want. JAMBL users actively distribute their music on streaming platforms and beyond.
▶ Record Your Voice
Add vocals to your tracks with built-in recording. Use auto-tune to polish your sound. Earpiece preview when headphones aren't handy.
▶ 1000+ Sounds That Grow With You
Start fast, then go deep. Choose from over 1000 high-quality samples across many genres, organized into curated Jam Packs. Import your own sounds, tweak any pack to shape your signature style, and discover new sounds added regularly.
▶ Explore Any Style
Create in any genre: EDM, Electrofunk, Trap, Vaporwave, Old School Hip Hop, Analog Techno, Classical, 8-bit, Chiptune, VGM, and traditional music from around the world. Mash up styles and invent your own.
▶ Master Your Sound
Polish your beats with a built-in mastering chain. Shape your mix with EQ, compressor, limiter, and side-chain bass ducking.
▶ Make It Look Like It Sounds
Every beat gets its own visual identity. A full-screen visualizer reacts to your music in real time with customizable backgrounds, ring effects, and waveform displays that move with the sound. Watch full screen or right in the beat cell. Browse tons of premade presets or fully tweak your own look. Save your favorites, share them with the community, and get inspired by other creators' visual styles. See a look you love? Remix the beat and the visuals together.
▶ Auto-Edited Music Videos
When your beat is ready, record a short video. JAMBL auto-edits with cuts, loops, and reverses perfectly synced to your rhythm. Ready to share on social media.
▶ Create Together
Build your musical identity with a profile. Follow creators, like and comment on beats, and remix other users' work into something new.
▶ Jam In Real Life
Sync multiple devices over WiFi using Ableton Link. Jam live with friends for real-time, real-world sessions.
▶ Key Features
• Smart looper system
• Customizable Jam Packs
• Import your own sounds
• Earpiece preview mode
• Vocal recording with auto-tune
• Gyroscope motion tracking for filter and volume automation
• Full-screen reactive visualizer with shareable presets
• Mastering chain (EQ, compressor, limiter, side chain)
• Auto-edited music videos
• Social profiles, feeds & remixing
• Local multiplayer with Ableton Link
▶ Connect With Us
Discord: discord.gg/HZmzbJyfqV
Email: gad@jambl.app
Instagram: @jambl_beats
Facebook: facebook.com/jamblitup
▶ Free to Create
JAMBL is free to download and use. 
Make beats, record, and share with no paywall. 
JAMBL Pro unlocks premium sound packs, full visualizer customization, mastering chain, and more. 
Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: jambl.app/subscription-terms

bluejetty:00024059:ios.name: World Travel Stories - Airport
bluejetty:00024059:ios.summary: Attention all passengers, please fasten your seatbelts and prepare to land in an all-new adventure with World Travel Stories™. Stow your belongings and get ready to EXPLORE! Tour the all-new exciting locations, chock full of crazy interacti
bluejetty:00024059:ios.description:
Attention all passengers, please fasten your seatbelts and prepare to land in an all-new adventure with World Travel Stories™. Stow your belongings and get ready to EXPLORE! Tour the all-new exciting locations, chock full of crazy interactions with your favorite characters!
World Travel Stories™ will drop you off in a packed airport, and what happens next is completely up to you. You are in charge of creating your own traveling stories. There are no rules. No limits. Drag and drop your characters anywhere, dress them in any way, and interact with loads of exciting objects in lively new environments across the globe.
The world is yours! Use your imagination to create the most amazing stories yet. Hit up the airport and travel to exotic new locations, all around the world. Imagine being a jetsetter, or maybe a jungle explorer in mystic ruins? What wondrous things will you discover in these remote destinations? With new locations waiting for you on frequent updates, the possibilities are limitless.
Uncover the mysteries of an ancient temple, marvel in the majestic waterfalls, or just chill out in the pool of a tropical eco-resort with a juicy tropical cocktail. Find out for yourself in this extraordinary adventure today!
**Features**
- Free play mode you’ll love. Your world, your rules.
- Exotic new locations full of charming customizable characters.
- Lightning-fast traveling from one location to another.
- Game progress is auto-saved. Continue your amazing story the next day.
- Capture the most magical moments during your adventures with the Camera mode.
- New updates will just roll in, with additional destinations, characters, and an insane amount of things to do.
The first free destination includes a vibrant city, a cozy travelers’ home, and a cutting-edge international airport, with thousands of interactions and 19 cool characters. A great beginning to start your journey.
**SUBARA for everyone**
We build digital experiences that are filled with fun and creativity, that spark the imagination of millions of players, of any age, from any corner of the world.
Our ethos is underpinned by the quest of being the best humans, and company, we can be. Whether this is through planting trees to help rebuild the world, or by producing great games to entertain, educate, and enlighten players while inspiring them to be the best version of themselves.

Think you're smart? Let's delete a part!
In Delete Puzzle, Erase Brain Fun Game, you will play as a famous detective, your finger is the eraser to erase part of the image. Use your mind, imagination and artistic talent to solve puzzles. You can never be sure what surprises you will find and the results will make you smile.
Delete one part
Playing is easy! Just touch the screen and drag your finger to erase part of the drawing and see what lies behind it. Delete Puzzle, Erase Brain Fun is a fun puzzle game that challenges your brain.
Attractive game
Enjoy hundreds of colorful and fun exciting images and scenarios. With smooth graphics and captivating animations, you won't be able to take your eyes off this game! It will challenge your thinking skills. Test your brain by clearing part of the puzzle to get the correct result!
Many Challenging Levels
Explore hundreds of entertaining levels full of tricky puzzles inside Delete Puzzle. No two puzzles are the same! Each level will stimulate your brain to approach problems in a new way. Let's see how smart you are!
For everyone
Delete Puzzle offers hours of fun for teens, seniors, and anyone who wants to keep their brain sharp!
Funny music

bluejetty:00022522:ios.summary:
The management RPG where your heroes keep fighting even when you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental Wizard to Cannon Pirate, and level up 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and even Construction!
GAME
bluejetty:00022522:ios.description:
The management RPG where your heroes keep fighting even when you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental Wizard to Cannon Pirate, and level up 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and even Construction!
GAME FEATURES 
• 19 unique classes to specialize into! Will you max out idle gains, or go for max loot drop chance?
• 250 skill perks to play with! A minmax dream!
• More content than any other idle game, and rarely found in other RPG games! Complete Post Office Orders, collect and upgrade Stamps, deposit Statues, hunt rare monster for special crafting recipes, pray at the Obol Altar, compete in minigames, build a factory, command pet battles, do research, and more! What other idle games even have half as cool of features? None of them of course!
• Unlimited idle gains, unlike most idle Games that cap you at 12 hours. Ew, right?
• Level up 12 unique skills in true RPG fashion: Mining, Smithing, Alchemy, Fishing, Woodcutting, Construction, Breeding, Cooking, and more!
• Talk to 50+ NPC's, all with hand-drawn pixel art animations
• Witness the mental decline of the developer who made this game all by themselves! They've gone so insane that they speak of themselves in the 3rd person!
• 200+ unique Equipment, like Helmets, Rings, uh, weapons... you know, all the normal stuff in an MMO
• Talk with other REAL people! Kind of like how I'm talking to you right now, except you'll get to talk back!
• Get HYPED for new content coming in the future by joining my discord at: Discord.gg/idleon
• Yo man, life is too short to be reading entire game descriptions. You got this far, so you either REALLY need to go download the game, or you just scrolled to the bottom to see what's here. If so, there's nothing here except a smiley face with a nose :-)

bluejetty:00119760:ios.name: Winmail Reader
bluejetty:00119760:ios.summary:
Winmail Reader is ultimate tool for reading "winmail.dat" attachment files on iPhones, iPads and iPod touch. Winmail Reader decodes "winmail.dat" file, and allows any attachments contained in them to be opened, read, saved or e-mailed.
* *
bluejetty:00119760:ios.description:
Winmail Reader is ultimate tool for reading "winmail.dat" attachment files on iPhones, iPads and iPod touch. Winmail Reader decodes "winmail.dat" file, and allows any attachments contained in them to be opened, read, saved or e-mailed.
* * * Winmail Reader for Mac is also available on the Mac App Store. * * *
Winmail.dat files are in fact TNEF format (Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format). Microsoft Outlook e-mail program for Windows send e-mails as TNEF. Most other e-mail programs, including Mail, do not understand TNEF. If your e-mail program doesn't understand TNEF, you may only see an attachment named "winmail.dat" that you cannot open. The easy-to-use solution to circumvent this problem is provided by Winmail Reader.
FEATURES:
◆ Decodes "winmail.dat" files and list all attachments contained in it including email message.
◆ Inbuilt quick-look preview to view attachments. Tap on attachment button to popup quick-look preview.
◆ Allows attachments files to Copy to… another application, Save to Files, Copy, Print, share file to nearby iOS devices via AirDrop and more... Long press on attachment button to show share action options.
◆ Resend entire decoded email as it is with message and extracted attachments.
◆ Creates, edit and adds Microsoft Outlook Appointment and Meeting to iOS Calendar. It also reads embedded note.
◆ Creates and adds contact address card into iOS Contacts.
◆ Reads nested message in full RTF format as separate file.

bluejetty:00094894:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00094894:ios.description:
Younger is your AI health coach for Apple Watch and Apple Health data.
With your permission, Younger brings together body signals from Apple Watch and Apple Health, along with your daily logs for food, mindfulness, mood, and habits. It turns scattered health data into four clear scores, a Body Age estimate, and practical daily tasks that help you understand your body and build better routines over time.
Younger connects Nutrition, Fitness, Sleep & Recovery, and Mindfulness in one daily view. See how your body is doing, what may be influencing your health today, and which habits can help you improve over time.
WHY YOUNGER?
• Connect health and activity data through Health Connect
• Understand your health through Nutrition, Fitness, Sleep & Recovery, and Mindfulness scores
• Track Body Age based on your current health patterns
• Understand the relationship between workouts, fatigue, fitness, and recovery
• Get AI-powered explanations and next steps from Healo
• Follow daily tasks designed around your available health data
• Explore nutrition, activity, sleep, recovery, mood, stress, body signals, cycle insights, notes, reminders, and rewards in one place
FEATURES
• Health Connect
Sync health and activity data such as heart rate, HRV, sleep, steps, workouts, VO₂ Max, respiratory rate, and more, depending on the data available from your connected apps and devices.
• Four Daily Health Scores
Understand your daily health through four connected scores: Nutrition, Fitness, Sleep & Recovery, and Mindfulness.
• Body Age
Compare your Body Age with your actual age, track how it changes over time, and see the health and lifestyle factors that may be influencing it.
• Healo AI Companion
Talk with Healo, your AI health companion. Get explanations based on the health information available in Younger, ask questions about your meals, workouts, sleep, mood, stress, and Body Age, and receive clear next steps for your day.
• Nutrition
Snap food photos, estimate calories and macros, log meals, and review nutrition details. Track calories, protein, carbohydrates, fats, fiber, vitamins, and minerals—and better understand how your food choices support your goals.
• Fitness & Training Load
Review steps, workouts, exercise intensity, heart rate, and health trends in one place.
Training Load helps you understand recent fatigue, longer-term fitness, and training balance, so you can make more informed choices about training, lighter activity, and recovery.
• Sleep & Recovery
Review sleep duration, sleep quality, sleep stages, HRV, resting heart rate, restorative sleep, and Sleep Bank to better understand your recovery and how sleep connects with your daily health.
• Mindfulness & Stress
Log your mood, record emotions, and track mindfulness habits over time. Explore emotional patterns alongside HRV-based stress insights when available.
• Tasks & Insights
Get personalized health tasks, reminders, reports, and encouragement designed to help healthy habits feel more manageable and sustainable.
Younger helps you understand what your body is telling you, how your habits connect, and how your health changes over time.
Younger is designed for general wellness and habit building, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
Download Younger and start seeing your whole health more clearly.
Privacy Policy: http://doc.hea-ai.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: http://doc.hea-ai.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00063911:ios.description:
Run, jump and do amazing tricks as you flee from the aliens!
The most fun and exciting racing game is here!
Pocoyo Run & Fun is a fast and casual game to play for free, whenever and wherever you want, with one hand.
Jump with your shopping cart at full speed down the mountainside and don't let the avalanche of little green aliens catch you.
Use the advantages you can get with the extra characters to go even faster, avoid obstacles and discover new tricks and powerups.

Run to collect the coins and redeem them for upgrades and get even further!
- "Endless run" game based on fluid physics.
- Land generated procedurally. There will not be two equal matches!
- Simple controls, easy to play but with depth of gameplay.
- System of tricks and pirouettes, fun and challenging.
- Colorful and fun visual design.
- Wide variety of objectives and missions that will unlock achievements and rewards.
- Hundreds of hours of speed, laughter and fun!
A game for players of all ages: fun and challenging for kids and adults.

bluejetty:00116063:ios.name: Coffee Sort: Perfect Jam
bluejetty:00116063:ios.summary:
Coffee Sort: Perfect Jam – A Puzzle Journey Infused with Rich Coffee Flavor
Step away from the noise of the outside world and immerse yourself in the cozy ambiance of a coffeehouse with Coffee Sort: Perfect Jam – a relaxing, clever, and ad
bluejetty:00116063:ios.description:
Coffee Sort: Perfect Jam – A Puzzle Journey Infused with Rich Coffee Flavor
Step away from the noise of the outside world and immerse yourself in the cozy ambiance of a coffeehouse with Coffee Sort: Perfect Jam – a relaxing, clever, and addictive puzzle game. It’s the perfect blend of tranquil coffee moments and gently challenging color puzzles.
In this game, you'll delight in sorting colorful coffee cups into perfect combinations. Every movement is designed to be smooth and satisfying – from pouring coffee visuals to soothing sound effects. It's not just a game; it's a mindful escape where entertainment meets mental stimulation, all wrapped in the warmth of a familiar café.
Simple Yet Captivating Gameplay:
Tap to move a coffee cup to another tray – the rules are simple, but mastering them is a real challenge.
Ensure each tray contains only cups of the same color – a rewarding logic puzzle awaits.
Enjoy satisfying animations as each cup slides perfectly into place.
Progress through increasingly complex levels that test your logic and strategic thinking.
Why You’ll Love Coffee Sort:
Perfect for all ages – from students to professionals, coffee lovers to puzzle fans.
Great for short breaks, evening wind-downs, or simply passing time productively.
Enhances observation, logical reasoning, and focus – brain training without boredom.
Highlighted Features:
Easy to learn, relaxing to play – pick it up in seconds.
Hundreds of handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty and artistic design.
Flexible hint and undo options to support you through tougher challenges.
Pleasant visuals with a modern coffee-themed aesthetic and a cozy café vibe.
Ambient background music and café-inspired sound effects for total immersion.
Play offline anytime – no internet required.
Completely free to play, with optional in-game boosters for enhanced experience.
Who Is It For?
Coffee enthusiasts seeking a chill café-style experience in a game.
Puzzle lovers who enjoy colorful, logic-based challenges.
Anyone in search of a pressure-free, no-combat, no-countdown gaming journey.
Start Your Coffee-Fueled Puzzle Adventure!
Whether you’re sipping your morning brew or unwinding at night, Coffee Sort: Perfect Jam brings a cozy coffee shop experience straight to your phone. It’s not just a puzzle game – it’s a refined experience for both the mind and soul.
Download now and savor the rich flavor of coffee in every delightful puzzle!

Run Your Card
bluejetty:00081830:ios.description:
Become the owner of your own trading card business and build your empire in CCG Trading Card Park! Manage your business, trade rare cards, and create an impressive collection of powerful creatures from the Beast Lords series.
Run Your Card Shop:
Fill your store with booster packs and individual cards, carefully organizing them and setting competitive prices to attract customers. Your goal isn’t just to sell cards but to grow your personal collection, balancing your time between customer service and hunting for rare finds.

- Stock your shop with collectible trading cards.
- Buy, sell, and trade Beast Lords cards.
- Customize and expand your store as your business grows.
- Engage in exciting card battles to prove your skill.
Ready to build the ultimate trading card empire?

bluejetty:00098984:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00098984:ios.description:
Identify seashells from a photo and turn your beach finds into a personal collection. ShellLens combines an AI shell identifier, a seashell guide, and collection folders to help you discover what you found and learn more about it.
Whether you're beachcombing on vacation, sorting shells at home, or exploring marine life with your family, start with a photo and follow your curiosity.
IDENTIFY SHELLS FROM PHOTOS
Take a picture or choose one from your library. ShellLens' updated AI model analyzes the shell's visible features and suggests an identification, with common and scientific names when a match is found.
GET TO KNOW YOUR FIND
Explore identifying features, taxonomy, habitats, geographic distribution, and rarity where available. Learn what makes a shell distinctive and how it differs from similar species.
BUILD YOUR SHELL COLLECTION
Keep your favorite finds together in a visual collection. Create folders for different beaches, trips, or shell types, add folder notes, and choose cover photos. Give every beach day's discoveries a place of their own.
EXPLORE WIKIPEDIA AND SPECIES REFERENCES
Go deeper with Wikipedia articles and photographs where available. Explore additional names, classification, and recorded regions from the World Register of Marine Species, with links to the original sources.
TAKE A SECOND LOOK
Think your shell could be something else? For eligible results, choose a suggested alternative or enter the name you suspect and ask the AI to reconsider the photo. When the image doesn't show enough detail, photo guidance helps you prepare another shot.
REVISIT YOUR DISCOVERIES
Browse your identification history and saved collection. Previously saved shell photos and identification details remain available offline; new identifications and online reference content require an internet connection.
From your first beach find to a growing interest in conchology—the study of shells—ShellLens helps you keep exploring.
Download ShellLens and discover the story behind your next shell.
AI identifications are suggestions and may be incorrect. Available details and reference material vary by result.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
- Choose from Weekly, Yearly plans
- Charges applied to your iTunes Account at purchase
- Auto-renewal unless disabled 24 hours before expiration
- Accounts charged for renewal 24 hours prior to period end at the rate chosen
- Manage auto-renewals in Account Settings
- Active subscriptions last for their full term
- No refunds for active subscription periods
- Unused trial time forfeited with subscription purchase

App Permissions Install Settings Note: 
• We do not collect or use any personal information. There are, however, some permissions necessary for the app to function properly.
1. Photos/Media/Files – This allows the app to store the medical content and multimedia for offline use without requiring the user to reload all the large content when the app updates.
2. Device and App History – This is used only to keep the app and content up to date.
The amount of clinical information currently doubles every 18 months and the pace is only getting faster. Stay up-to-date with the MSD Manual Professional App.
The MSD Manual Professional App provides health care practitioners and students with clear, practical explanations for thousands of conditions in all major medical and surgical specialties. It covers etiology, pathophysiology, and options for evaluation and treatment. 
The trusted MSD Manual Professional medical app offers:
• Thousands of topics written and updated regularly by more than 350 academic physicians 
• Photos and Illustrations on thousands of disorders and diseases
• “How to” Videos on numerous outpatient procedures and physical examinations. Concise instructional videos by medical experts on these key topics:
 - Casting and splinting techniques
 - Orthopedic examinations
 - Neurologic examinations
 - Obstetric procedures
 - Outpatient procedures (including IV lines, tubes, catheters, dislocation reductions and more)
• Quizzes* check knowledge of medical disorders, symptoms, and treatments 
• Medical News and Commentary* covering the most current and important medical topics 
• Editorials* written by top medical experts 
*Internet access needed. 
About MSD Manuals
Our mission is simple: 
We believe that health information is a universal right and that every person is entitled to accurate, accessible and usable medical information. We have a responsibility to protect, preserve and share the best current medical information to enable more informed decisions, enhance relationships between patients and professionals, and improve health care outcomes around the world. 
That’s why we are making the MSD Manuals available for free in digital form to professionals and patients around the world. No registration or subscription required, and no ads.

This mobile application is intended for Healthcare Professionals.
For more information please read the End User License Agreement at 
https://www.msd.com/policy/terms-of-use/home.html.
For more information about our privacy practices, please see our privacy commitment at http://www.msdprivacy.com. 
Adverse Event Reporting: In a country outside the United States, there may be specific procedures in place to address reports of adverse events. Please contact your local MSD office or local health authority for more information.
For questions or help with the app, please contact msdmanualsinfo@msd.com
