*** Downloading this app is a 2-step process: the first step is a download of the app template, and the second step is a full download of app content. This can take 5 to 10 minutes. Please do not navigate away from the app until both steps have been completed. ***

App Permissions Install Settings Note: 
• We do not collect or use any personal information. There are, however, some permissions necessary for the app to function properly.
1. Photos/Media/Files – This allows the app to store the medical content and multimedia for offline use without requiring the user to reload all the large content when the app updates.
2. Device and App History – This is used only to keep the app and content up to date.

The amount of clinical information currently doubles every 18 months and the pace is only getting faster. Stay up-to-date with the MSD Manual Professional App.

The MSD Manual Professional App provides health care practitioners and students with clear, practical explanations for thousands of conditions in all major medical and surgical specialties. It covers etiology, pathophysiology, and options for evaluation and treatment. 



The trusted MSD Manual Professional medical app offers:

• Thousands of topics written and updated regularly by more than 350 academic physicians 
• Photos and Illustrations on thousands of disorders and diseases
• “How to” Videos on numerous outpatient procedures and physical examinations. Concise instructional videos by medical experts on these key topics:
     - Casting and splinting techniques
     - Orthopedic examinations
     - Neurologic examinations
     - Obstetric procedures
     - Outpatient procedures (including IV lines, tubes, catheters, dislocation reductions and more)
• Quizzes* check knowledge of medical disorders, symptoms, and treatments 
• Medical News and Commentary* covering the most current and important medical topics 
• Editorials* written by top medical experts 

*Internet access needed. 

About MSD Manuals
Our mission is simple: 
We believe that health information is a universal right and that every person is entitled to accurate, accessible and usable medical information. We have a responsibility to protect, preserve and share the best current medical information to enable more informed decisions, enhance relationships between patients and professionals, and improve health care outcomes around the world. 
That’s why we are making the MSD Manuals available for free in digital form to professionals and patients around the world. No registration or subscription required, and no ads.

This mobile application is intended for Healthcare Professionals.
For more information please read the End User License Agreement at 
https://www.msd.com/policy/terms-of-use/home.html.

For more information about our privacy practices, please see our privacy commitment at http://www.msdprivacy.com. 

Adverse Event Reporting:  In a country outside the United States, there may be specific procedures in place to address reports of adverse events. Please contact your local MSD office or local health authority for more information.

For questions or help with the app, please contact msdmanualsinfo@msd.com

It is probably the most dynamic turn-based strategy in the spirit of the old school. Less covers, more action! Land on a lost planet and show the mutants what you are made of. Shoot, kick, blow up and destroy. You will put together the most reckless team of fighters and unravel the mysteries of the mystical planet following the best traditions of science fiction.
• The game is inspired by the best turn-based strategies of the old school
• A unique system of dynamic turn-based battles lasting 10–15 minutes
• A squad of space rangers made up of 6 fighters with a unique fighting style
• A story about the mysterious planet in the spirit of the golden age of science fiction
• A hand-drawn map of the game world
• Assault rifles, machine guns, plasma guns, grenade launchers and a lot of other equipment to make your fighters even stronger
• More than 20 different enemies from alien animals to dangerous monsters
• Futuristic upgradable equipment which gives your fighters unique abilities
• Intense dialogs between team members, which reveal unexpected plot twists
• Colorful special effects that transform a turn-based combat into an exciting action movie
• And, of course, the party headliners are dangerous bosses that show up at the end of each chapter of the adventure

bluejetty:00163746:ios.summary:
3D scanning has never been simpler with KIRI Engine: create high-quality 3D models on your phone within minutes. Dive into 3D scanning and modeling tailored for artists, designers, engineers, and 3D printing enthusiasts.
Unleash the Power
bluejetty:00163746:ios.description:
3D scanning has never been simpler with KIRI Engine: create high-quality 3D models on your phone within minutes. Dive into 3D scanning and modeling tailored for artists, designers, engineers, and 3D printing enthusiasts.
Unleash the Power of 3D Scanning:
• Photogrammetry: 3D scan with Photo Scan to transform your photos into high-quality 3D models.
• NSR (Neural Surface Reconstruction): 3D Scan featureless/shiny objects with a video processed by Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) integrated Featureless Object Scan.
• 3D Gaussian Splatting: Obtain full 3D visualizations with a video, scan and capture all elements in your scene, including reflections.
Create Your Own 3D Model through a Delightful Experience:
• Capturing: Snapping photos replaces your 3D modeling process, obtain a detailed 3D mesh in just minutes from scanning to generating.
• Functional Free Version: Dive into the world of photogrammetry without paying a cent for subscriptions, a LiDAR sensor, or an expensive 3D Scanner. Upload unlimited 3D scans and export at least 3 times per week.
Edit, Refine, and Personalize Your Creations:
• Edit: Refine 3D models with editing tools; adjust your files in Photo Scan, Featureless Object Scan, and 3D gaussian splats.
• Precision: Choose specific photos for processing to ensure detailed, high-quality 3D models.
• Cleanup: Auto Object Masking for noise-free, clean models during capture by eliminating background elements. This feature also allows the object to be moved during the capture.
• Preview: Employ the 3D viewer and augmented reality panels to directly visualize and adjust your completed 3D model.
Share, Export, and Make Use of Your 3D Models:
• For Free: free registration and unlimited scanning, with at least 3 exports weekly.
• Share: On various platforms such as Sketchfab, Thingiverse, GeoScan, and more.
• Formats: Export in OBJ, STL, FBX, GLTF, GLB, USDZ, PLY, XYZ, compatible with Blender 3D, Unreal Engine, Autodesk Maya, etc.
• Wide usage: For game development, VFX, VR/AR 3D content creation, 3D printing, 3D visualization, and many more.
• Precision Without LiDAR: KIRI’s advanced algorithms provide scanning quality that is on par with LiDAR sensors.
KIRI Engine Pro – For Those Who Demand More:
• Upload: Pro users can leverage camera rolls, ensuring a flexible 3D scanning experience.
• Quad-Mesh Retopology: Refine scanned 3D models with automatic quad-mesh adjustment.
• AI PBR Material Generation: Attain lifelike textures with AI-generated PBR materials.
• Advanced Camera System: Perfect each shot with fine-tuned camera settings for impeccable 3D scans.
• Featureless Object Scan: Utilizes Neural Surface Reconstruction (NSR) for scanning shiny/reflective surfaces, a first in practical 3D scanning with KIRI Engine.
• 3D Gaussian Splatting: Experience the future of 3D scanning and capture accurate 3D scenes with a short video; edit using tools like sphere/plane cutters and brushes. Export in native format or OBJ.
• WEB Version Access: KIRI Engine WEB offers professional-grade model creation from DSLR photo sets or drone scans, enhancing accuracy in mappings and drone-based 3D surveys.
Engage with Our Caring Community:
Join our Discord community for sharing, feature voting, giveaways, and engaging with fellow enthusiasts.
Dive into 3D Scanning with KIRI Engine Today!
Download the KIRI Engine 3D Scanner app and embark on your 3D scanning journey with your device.

bluejetty:00128628:ios.description:
Introducing Ampere Battery Check - your ultimate companion for everything battery, charging, and power on your device.
Ampere gives you a fast, accurate way to measure real charging speed, compare chargers and cables, and understand exactly how your battery is performing right now. Whether you want to find the fastest charger in your home, test a new USB-C cable, or check if a wireless pad is really delivering the watts it promises, Ampere puts the numbers in your hand in seconds.
KEY FEATURES
- Accurate charging speed test: measure real-time charging current (mA) from any charger, cable, or wireless pad.
- Charger comparison: benchmark wall adapters, car chargers, power banks, and wireless chargers side by side.
- Cable & wire testing: instantly spot slow, damaged, or low-quality USB, Lightning, and USB-C cables.
- Wireless charging check: verify that your Qi or MagSafe pad delivers the speed it advertises.
- Battery health insights: track capacity, voltage, temperature, and overall condition over time.
- Remaining usage time: see how long your battery will last for browsing, calls, video, music, gaming, and standby.
- Charging history & logs: review past charging sessions to find the best charger for daily use.
- Smart notifications: get alerts when charging is complete or when a slow charger is detected.
- Clean, simple interface: clear readouts, no clutter, no confusing jargon.
WHY AMPERE
- Save time by always picking the fastest working charger.
- Save money by identifying bad cables before you replace your device.
- Protect your battery by avoiding weak or unstable power sources.
- Travel smart by testing hotel, airport, and car chargers on the go.
PERFECT FOR
- Anyone frustrated by slow charging.
- Users comparing new chargers, power banks, or MagSafe accessories.
- Tech enthusiasts who want real data about their device's power.
- Travelers, students, gamers, and heavy phone users.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Ampere Battery Check.
2. Plug in your charger or place your device on a wireless pad.
3. Watch live charging speed, voltage, and battery status update in real time.
4. Compare results and choose the best charger and cable for you.
Stop guessing which charger or cable is actually fast. Download Ampere Battery Check today and take full control of your battery, charging speed, and device power - all from one beautifully simple app.

Ampere gives you a fast, accurate way to measure real charging speed, compare chargers and cables, and understand exactly how your battery is performing right now. Whether you want to find the fastest charger in your home, test a new USB-C cable, or check if a wireless pad is really delivering the watts it promises, Ampere puts the numbers in your hand in seconds.

KEY FEATURES

- Accurate charging speed test: measure real-time charging current (mA) from any charger, cable, or wireless pad.
- Charger comparison: benchmark wall adapters, car chargers, power banks, and wireless chargers side by side.
- Cable & wire testing: instantly spot slow, damaged, or low-quality USB, Lightning, and USB-C cables.
- Wireless charging check: verify that your Qi or MagSafe pad delivers the speed it advertises.
- Battery health insights: track capacity, voltage, temperature, and overall condition over time.
- Remaining usage time: see how long your battery will last for browsing, calls, video, music, gaming, and standby.
- Charging history & logs: review past charging sessions to find the best charger for daily use.
- Smart notifications: get alerts when charging is complete or when a slow charger is detected.
- Clean, simple interface: clear readouts, no clutter, no confusing jargon.

WHY AMPERE

- Save time by always picking the fastest working charger.
- Save money by identifying bad cables before you replace your device.
- Protect your battery by avoiding weak or unstable power sources.
- Travel smart by testing hotel, airport, and car chargers on the go.

PERFECT FOR

- Anyone frustrated by slow charging.
- Users comparing new chargers, power banks, or MagSafe accessories.
- Tech enthusiasts who want real data about their device's power.
- Travelers, students, gamers, and heavy phone users.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Open Ampere Battery Check.
2. Plug in your charger or place your device on a wireless pad.
3. Watch live charging speed, voltage, and battery status update in real time.
4. Compare results and choose the best charger and cable for you.

Stop guessing which charger or cable is actually fast. Download Ampere Battery Check today and take full control of your battery, charging speed, and device power - all from one beautifully simple app.

ProximiT is a real time personal assistant for all your bus and subway needs in and around Boston.
Ever arrived at the station right as the bus or train pulled away? You could have walked faster but now you’re stuck waiting.
How about spending an eternity in a crowded underground station when you could have been enjoying the outdoors?
Download ProximiT and never waste your time or money again.

• Locate nearby stations in a new part of town. Stations are sorted by distance and show upcoming arrival times, so you can decide which is your best bet. 
• Find out about service alerts such as delays, construction, and elevator outages. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
ProximiT is not affiliated with the MBTA.

Family owned and operated since 1982, Epic Wings, formerly known as Wings N’ Things, was the first to bring Buffalo Wings to the West Coast. bluejetty:00074118:ios.description:
The Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT Companion App is the essential supplement for your new Wahoo ELEMNT Bike Computer. Wahoo has reinvented the way you setup and interact with your bike computer using the ELEMNT Companion App. Using the companion app, you automatically pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT via a QR code and then you can set up sensors and configure all of your workout pages using the easy interface of your iPhone. 
Simple Bike Computer Set Up
Automatically pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT via QR code to your iPhone using the ELEMNT Companion App, and then use the easy interface of your iPhone to set up your profile, configure workout pages, and pair sensors faster than ever before. To build your personalized workout pages, simply drag and drop the order of your favorite data fields to suit your riding goals. Once you are configured, close the app and you are ready to ride!
Simple to Navigate
In the app, connect your Strava and Ride with GPS accounts so that your saved routes wirelessly download to your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike Computer to keep you on track.
Simple to Track
Use the app to send a link that corresponds to your GPS coordinates to friends and family so that they can track you in real time. Or, you can keep the app open to see other riders with a Wahoo ELEMNT bike computer on the road to find your friends.
Simple to Share
The Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT Companion App automatically backs up your workouts to the free Wahoo Fitness Cloud account for storage and sharing. Upload your workouts to all of your favorite training apps or websites. The Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT Companion App integrates with TrainingPeaks, Strava, RidewithGPS, Komoot, HealthKit, MapMyFitness and many others!
Visit https://www.wahoofitness.com/devices/elemnt.html for more information on the Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT bike computers. 
Features:
Set up and configure your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT Bike Computer
Receive messages, phone calls, emails on your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT
Upload workouts to your favorite training websites including TrainingPeaks, Strava, RidewithGPS, Komoot, HealthKit and many more
Authorize Strava, RWGPS and Komoot to sync your routes to the ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike computers
Connect to wifi on ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike computers
Review workout data
Live track
Pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike Computer with Wahoo Fitness devices including KICKR family, TICKR family, BlueSC, RPM, and more!
Pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike Computer with other BTLE and ANT+™ heartrate and bike speed/cadence/power devices.
Please Note: Continued use of BTLE running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Wahoo has reinvented the way you setup and interact with your bike computer using the ELEMNT Companion App. Using the companion app, you automatically pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT via a QR code and then you can set up sensors and configure all of your workout pages using the easy interface of your iPhone. 

Simple Bike Computer Set Up
Automatically pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT via QR code to your iPhone using the ELEMNT Companion App, and then use the easy interface of your iPhone to set up your profile, configure workout pages, and pair sensors faster than ever before. To build your personalized workout pages, simply drag and drop the order of your favorite data fields to suit your riding goals. Once you are configured, close the app and you are ready to ride!

Simple to Navigate
In the app, connect your Strava and Ride with GPS accounts so that your saved routes wirelessly download to your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike Computer to keep you on track.

Simple to Track
Use the app to send a link that corresponds to your GPS coordinates to friends and family so that they can track you in real time. Or, you can keep the app open to see other riders with a Wahoo ELEMNT bike computer on the road to find your friends.

Simple to Share
The Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT Companion App automatically backs up your workouts to the free Wahoo Fitness Cloud account for storage and sharing. Upload your workouts to all of your favorite training apps or websites. The Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT Companion App integrates with TrainingPeaks, Strava, RidewithGPS, Komoot, HealthKit, MapMyFitness and many others!

Visit https://www.wahoofitness.com/devices/elemnt.html for more information on the Wahoo Fitness ELEMNT bike computers. 

Features:
Set up and configure your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT Bike Computer
Receive messages, phone calls, emails on your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT
Upload workouts to your favorite training websites including TrainingPeaks, Strava, RidewithGPS, Komoot, HealthKit and many more
Authorize Strava, RWGPS and Komoot to sync your routes to the ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike computers
Connect to wifi on ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike computers
Review workout data

Live track
Pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike Computer with Wahoo Fitness devices including KICKR family, TICKR family, BlueSC, RPM, and more!
Pair your ELEMNT or ELEMNT BOLT GPS Bike Computer with other BTLE and ANT+™ heartrate and bike speed/cadence/power devices.
Please Note: Continued use of BTLE running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00188040:ios.description:
Audio Memos is a voice recorder for the iPhone and iPad. What you'll really like about Audio Memos, is that you can actually HEAR your recordings (try it and compare, you'll hear what we mean). It's also easy to use, with a simple and intuitive interface. Yet with many advanced features as volume boost, volume normalizing, editing of recordings and more. Most of these features are exclusive to this program, which makes it one of the most advanced recorder.
This is a great recorder, don't just take our word for it: Audio Memos Free has been featured by Apple in the "What's hot" section.
Your recordings are stored on your device but can be backed up to your computer using a simple web browser (or by email). See our website for more details.
FEATURES
• Send recordings by email.
• High quality recordings up to 44100 Hz. Three levels of quality are available: 11025 Hz, 22050 Hz and 44100 Hz.
• Professionally engineered audio normalizing filter, which enables you to have a constant average volume on all your recordings. This feature does not modify your recordings, so you can turn it on even if you intend to post process your audio files on a computer.
• Wide range volume control using a volume boost. While listening to a recording, volume can be increased using your device's volume keys. If you find this insufficiently loud, you can adjust the volume boost in the application's settings.
• Normalizing and boosting filters use dynamic compression with a non linear function to prevent clipping and minimize distortions. Note however that eventual clipping and distortion created by the microphone are not suppressed. If you care about quality, use the headset's microphone instead of the built in one.
• Records even when your device is in sleep mode; and pauses automatically in the event of an incoming phone call.
• Advanced listing of your recordings, which displays name, date, length and size information. A detailed view is also available for each recording. This view gives extra information such as quality and download status of a recording.
• Must have controls as pause record, pause play, slider, quality control.
• Uses widespread wav format to store recordings, so you can transfer and read them on any device.
SUBSCRIPTION
All features listed above can be used without an in app purchase. Some advanced features require an active subscription. These include:
• Voice activated rec. - stop recording silence.
• Upload to Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, Evernote, FTP or WebDAV.
• Insert audio - insert comments easily.
• Position markers - easy navigation.
• Audio compression - email hours of recordings.
• Memo alert dates / reminders.
• Adjustable reading speed.
• Add pictures to a memo.
• Send or delete multiple recordings at a time.
• Edit your recordings (trim, overwrite, merge).
• Transcription - transform your memos into text.
• Stereo recording using the builtin microphones (requires a compatible device and a «Pro +» subscription).
Duration and price of each subscription are displayed in our storefront. All subscription costs will be charged to your Apple ID account, starting at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. It is not possible to cancel a subscription period once you have been charged for it. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited as soon as a subscription is purchased. You can manage subscriptions and disable auto renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of Service: https://imesart.com/legal/terms-of-service.php

bluejetty:00187060:ios.description:
Get your perfect daily planner today! Join millions of users worldwide.
Looking for a reliable partner to keep your life and work organized? Our digital daily planner is the ideal replacement for your paper organizer, featuring a weekly view plus one, two, and four-day options. It brings together simplicity and powerful functionality, giving you all the tools you need to plan effectively and achieve your goals: daily planner, notes, calendar, diary, scheduler, notebook, and to-do list.
Visually, it captures the charm of a classic paper organizer. We've preserved everything you love about traditional planners and brought it into the digital world. Now you can easily create your plans, track your progress, and stay on top of everything with just your smartphone or tablet.
Straightforward, intuitive, and familiar. All your records, notes, calendar, important tasks, lists, and plans are always at your fingertips – right on your device.
Key features of our digital daily planner:
• Multiple views (weekly, four-day, two-day, one-day): see all your plans at a glance or switch between different time periods to plan ahead, review past weeks, or look forward to what's coming.
• Authentic paper planner design: enjoy the familiar feel of a paper planner with our thoughtfully designed weekly view that looks like a classic organizer. Timeless style! Pick from various design templates, customize background colors and fonts to match your preferences.
• Simple to use: no clutter, no complicated forms. Enter your plans and tasks in seconds, edit or delete them whenever you need to.
• Rich formatting options: color-code your events, plans, and completed tasks. Use underlining, bold text, and other styling to highlight what matters most. Easily spot your priority tasks and track what you've accomplished.
• Seamless flexibility: switch between weeks, months, and years with a simple swipe. No worries about losing your data or carrying around a heavy planner. Everything syncs securely to your smartphone and personal cloud storage (iCloud).
• Customizable recurring events, smart reminders, hourly scheduling, and much more.
Stay organized and ready for whatever comes your way. Stop wasting time searching for the right organizer, note app, calendar, or planner. Join millions of users who already trust our digital daily planner to keep them on track.
The basic version is completely FREE, and if you want advanced features, you can upgrade to the PREMIUM version with a one-time purchase or subscription.
Download your daily planner today and organize your life the way that works best for you!
E-mail: appweeklyplanner@gmail.com

bluejetty:00184631:ios.description:
Skate like a pro in the most realistic multi-touch skateboarding game ever!
Just like in real skateboarding or fingerboarding, Touchgrind Skate 2 is a game of skill that takes 10 minutes to understand but a lifetime to master. Learn the tricks, complete challenges, and unlock new skateboard parts.
Get the highest score in time-limited Competition mode, rip freely and complete challenges in Jam Session mode, challenge your friends in the turn-based multiplayer Game of S.K.A.T.E or export video clips and show off your best lines.
True innovative finger controls together with real physics simulation let you pull off tricks like ollies, pop shuvits, kickflips, heelflips, impossibles, powerslides, lip tricks, stalls, drops, 5-0’s, 50-50’s, crooks, tailslides, bluntslides, darkslides etc in endless combinations, or why not do them in nollie, fakie or switch? - Only your skill and imagination set the limit!
Get a maximized experience with a real skateboarding feeling - Skate like in real life on your iOS device!
FEATURES
- Realistic physics and stunning 3D graphics
- 4 free roam game modes: Training, Competition, Jam Session, Game of S.K.A.T.E turn-based multiplayer
- Tutorial videos - watch and try yourself!
- Natural multi-touch controls, evolved from Touchgrind and Touchgrind BMX
- Tilted camera view, similar to Touchgrind BMX
- Six different skateparks with bowls, ramps, curbs, boxes and over 2.000 meters of rails
- Complete the 250 challenges to unlock all skateparks, game modes, decks, wheels, grip tapes and stickers
- Record your runs and create replay videos to impress your friends
- True skating experience 
- Game Center achievements and leaderboards
- Trick name detection
Follow @illusionlabs on Twitter
Like us at www.facebook.com/illusionlabs1

bluejetty:00132322:ios.description:
Hypnotherapy makes you 10 times more likely to stop smoking for 1+ year than stopping without any support.
If you’ve tried stopping before, you’ll know how hard it is to remain a non-smoker. That’s where Finito comes in. 
Finito is a self-hypnosis program that addresses the underlying reasons that cause you to smoke, providing hypnotic suggestions to the subconscious to manage cravings, emotions, and habits.
Backed by science:
Our breakthrough program is designed by Dr. Gary Elkins, a world-leading neuroscientist and director of the Mind-Body Medicine Research Laboratory at Baylor University.
With Finito, you can:
Say goodbye to weak moments
Learn to self-manage cravings symptoms
Address the underlying reasons you smoke
Manage anxious feelings and irritability
Create healthier habits
Stop smoking for good, without relying on pills or patches 
Will it work?
Stop smoking hypnotherapy has been clinically proven to be 10 times more effective than stopping without support. 
Neurobiological brain studies show that hypnotherapy sessions activate areas of the brain associated with attention, sensitivity, motivation, and a positive sense of well-being.
This means that as you listen to positive suggestions given to you through hypnotherapy you are more likely to put these suggestions into action, making long lasting changes to your health and well-being. 
How does it work?
Hypnosis for stop smoking works by reducing stress through a series of relaxing visualizations, and empowering suggestions that will reduce your fear of quitting, and increase your ability to manage cravings. Through daily calming hypnotherapy sessions you can be motivated to stay free from smoking. 
Our team is with you every step of the way, through in-app chat, education, and on-demand stop-craving exercises.
What you get:
Evidence-based hypnotherapy program
Relaxing 15-minute daily sessions that fit easily into your schedule 
Supportive reinforcement program to help you maintain results 
Craving Toolkit with short sessions you can use on the go
Cigarette Tracker to record your progress in reducing cigarettes to zero
Daily educational readings with tips for navigating cravings and building new habits
In-app chat support from real people
Take your step forward to a smoke-free life with Finito.
Disclaimer:
This is a self-management tool designed to help people manage their smoking behaviour. It is not designed to treat nicotine addiction. The program does not replace the care of a medical provider or the patient’s medication. Always consult your healthcare professional before making medical decisions.
If you subscribe through iTunes, the credit card associated with your iTunes account will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. If you do not cancel, your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
To manage your Finito subscription from iTunes:
1) On your iOS device, go to your device Settings and the 'iTunes & App Stores'
2) Tap on your Apple ID
3) Tap to 'View Apple ID'. (You may need to sign in or use Touch ID.)
4) Tap on 'Subscriptions'
5) Choose Finito Subscription'
6) Tap 'Cancel Subscription'
For more information, please see our Terms and Conditions of Use: https://www.mindsethealth.com/legal/finito-privacy-policy, https://www.mindsethealth.com/legal/finito-terms-conditions
References
Clinical Hypnosis for Smoking Cessation: Preliminary Results of a Three-Session Intervention (2005) by Gary R Elkins and M. Hasan Rajab
Jensen MP, Adachi T, Tomé-Pires C, Lee J, Osman ZJ, Miró J. Mechanisms of hypnosis: toward the development of a biopsychosocial model [published correction appears in Int J Clin Exp Hypn. 2015;63(2):247]. Int J Clin Exp Hypn. 2015;63(1):34-75. doi:10.1080/00207144.2014.961875

bluejetty:00167968:ios.summary:

How does Wheels2U work?
Wheels2U is a new concept in public transportat
bluejetty:00167968:ios.description:
Wheels2U is an on-demand shuttle service that picks you up at your location and takes you where you want to go within certain “Service Areas” in Norwalk and Westport.
How does Wheels2U work?
Wheels2U is a new concept in public transportation. The service takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Once you request a ride with the Wheels2U app, our computer algorithm matches you in real-time with a shuttle that will pick you up at your location and get you to your destination as quickly as possible. Typically, the trip time is comparable to other ride services.
For Service Area maps, Hours of Operation and Fares in:
Norwalk: visit Wheels2UNorwalk.com
Westport: visit Wheels2UWestport.com 
How long will I wait?
You will always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up time before booking. You can also track your vehicle in real time in the app.
How many passengers will I share a vehicle with?
The number of passengers varies based on your trip and the requests of other riders at that time. Our shuttles are spacious and can easily accommodate up to 12 people.
What else do I need to know about using the service?
If you require the use of a wheelchair space, you can note this in the app under your rider profile. 
Download the free app and we will pick you up in minutes.
Questions? Email us at wheels2u@norwalktransit.com

bluejetty:00100235:ios.description:
In this game, your friend comes to you and asks for a tour because he is tired of his daily routine. You both sit in your car and drive toward a famous lake for a relaxing trip. Your friend is very excited and wants to reach the lake fast, so he keeps asking, “Have we reached?” The journey starts peacefully, but soon you face different problems. The car suddenly stops working, and you must choose either to find a repairman or collect the right tools to fix the car yourself.
As you continue the trip, you also need to stop and fill air in the tires. If you run out of money, you can do a fun online job where you click on circles to earn cash. With this money, you can buy tools and food items to keep your energy up. The journey becomes an adventure full of small challenges while your friend keeps waiting excitedly for the lake. So, are you ready to take a tour with your friend and see if you can reach the lake?

bluejetty:00089145:ios.name: GroupSpot
bluejetty:00089145:ios.summary: GroupSpot is the free, private, ad-free group management and team communication app for sports teams, clubs, schools, PTOs, PTAs, booster clubs, nonprofits, businesses, bands, scouts, Greek organizations, HOAs, families, and community group
bluejetty:00089145:ios.description:
GroupSpot is the free, private, ad-free group management and team communication app for sports teams, clubs, schools, PTOs, PTAs, booster clubs, nonprofits, businesses, bands, scouts, Greek organizations, HOAs, families, and community groups. Replace scattered group texts, email chains, calendars, signup tools, forms, and payment apps with one organized place for communication, scheduling, membership, registration, and payments.
COMMUNICATE WITHOUT THE NOISE
Keep important updates in a real-time group feed and everyday conversations in personal, small-group, or full-group chat. Send push notifications, in-app alerts, and email announcements; pin key posts; target subgroups; share across related sister groups; and see post engagement. Members can set notification preferences for each group.
PLAN EVENTS AND KNOW WHO'S COMING
Create shared calendars for meetings, practices, games, fundraisers, performances, trips, and recurring events. Add locations, directions, weather forecasts, status changes, and automated reminders. Collect RSVPs and availability, manage waitlists, track attendance, and sync events to personal calendars.
TURN POSTS INTO ACTION
Add volunteer signups, custom forms, polls, links, files, videos, shared photo albums, carpools, attendance, registrations, or payments to a post. Organize shifts and tasks, gather feedback, collect digital signatures and waivers, and keep results easy to review and export.
REGISTRATION, DUES, DONATIONS, AND PAYMENTS
Combine registration forms and secure in-app payments in one seamless flow. Collect membership dues, team fees, donations, event tickets, merchandise purchases, and more. Track paid and unpaid members, inventory, receipts, refunds, and transaction history. Premium tools add installment plans, discount and access codes, offline payments, conditional questions, and automated pricing.
BUILT FOR TEAMS AND ORGANIZATIONS
Manage member directories, customizable rosters, player availability, games, seasons, schedules, scores, play-by-play updates, depth charts, injury reports, and equipment. Inventory Manager tracks jerseys, instruments, uniforms, and gear from checkout through return. Role-based permissions help organizers delegate safely without granting full admin access.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
GroupSpot is built for high-trust communities, not public social media. There are no ads, no algorithms, and no public profiles. Groups are private and unsearchable, invitations are controlled, and GroupSpot never sells your data. 
ONE APP FOR EVERY GROUP
Use GroupSpot as a sports team management app, club management app, school communication app, PTO or PTA app, nonprofit management app, volunteer coordination app, band or music group app, HOA management app, scouting app, family organizer, or private community platform. Create a custom group and enable only the tools your members need.
Start a group in seconds. GroupSpot's free Starter plan includes unlimited members and essential tools for chats, events, RSVPs, signups, forms, registration, payments, subgroups, and much more. Upgrade to Premium when your organization needs additional controls and advanced workflows.
All your groups. All your people. All in one spot.
Please view the Terms of Service (EULA) here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Carousell is the leading community marketplace in Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Indonesia. Millions of people use Carousell to declutter and sell to earn money, or find great deals and trusted services. From fashion and luxury to furniture, mobile phones, cars, toys and collectibles and home services, find them all on Carousell!
LIST IN 30 SECONDS AND SELL FASTER
- Take a photo and our AI* fills in the title, description and price. Earn money selling whatever you want.
- Start your shop: Use powerful seller tools or upgrade to CarouBiz to run your business on Carousell.
- Reach more buyers: Share listings easily on Facebook, Instagram, Telegram and WeChat.
- Earn trust: Build your profile with positive reviews from happy buyers.

- Best prices, trusted sellers: Compare prices, ratings, and reviews
- Safe, simple transactions: Chat, deal, and review — all in one app 
- Trusted home services: Book air-con servicing, repairs, renovation, cleaning, or movers directly.
- Shop Certified^ listings: Buy secondhand phones, bags, watches, and cars with Carousell Certified
- Safe checkout: Tap the Buy button to pay securely with escrow-protected Buyer Protection# 
Carousell brings great value and community together — Sell faster, buy smarter! Give preloved items a second life. Make secondhand your first choice.

bluejetty:00045794:ios.summary:

Whether you're a beginner or lookin
bluejetty:00045794:ios.description:
Need to learn French for your daily life, work, or to pass an official certification? Welcome to Frello, the reference app for mastering French as a Foreign Language (FLE) in a serious and effective way.
Whether you're a beginner or looking to improve, Frello supports you with an expert teaching methodology to promote your integration and independence in France.
WHY LEARN FRENCH WITH FRELLO?
- Official certifications: prepare calmly for your DILF, DELF A1, A2, B1, B2 and TCF exams. Our modules are designed to help you succeed.
- Professional integration: master useful work vocabulary to help your career.
- Expert method: teaching developed by FLE expert trainers, using authentic content that can be applied immediately in your daily life.
- Oral immersion: progress quickly thanks to an audio-first approach to understand and speak natural French.
YOUR COMPLETE PREPARATION FOR DELF AND TCF
Are you taking an exam for your residence permit, naturalization or studies? Frello offers you a specific pathway for each level of the European framework (CEFR):
- DELF A1 and A2 preparation: Master the basics of French for your daily life.
- DELF B1 and B2 preparation: Perfect your French to work in France or enter a university.
- TCF training: Targeted exercises to pass the French Knowledge Test. Our educational content is designed to put you in real exam conditions and guarantee your success.
A TRUSTED APP FOR YOUR SUCCESS
Frello is not just a language app, it's a real support tool:
- 4.7/5 on stores.
- Qualiopi label: recognized training quality.
- Partner of OFII, France Travail and the largest training organizations.
- More than 200,000 users are already progressing with us.
KEY FEATURES
- +1,500 hours of interactive A1, A2, B1, B2 content.
- More than 10 million modules completed each year by our learners.
- Intuitive app available everywhere, all the time.
- Personalized progress tracking to reach your goals quickly.
TESTIMONIALS
"After only three months, I started to understand spoken French much better. The strength of this method lies in the importance given to audio. This allows for real immersion in the living language."
A TOOL FOR ALL FRENCH LEARNERS
Whether you're learning independently or accompanied by a training organization, Frello adapts to your needs. Our app is proud to collaborate with major players in integration in France:
- OFII support: an ideal app for signatories of the Republican Integration Contract (CIR).
- France Travail & local missions: French as a Foreign Language in the service of your employability.
- Language schools and training centers: Frello is used by thousands of trainers to energize FLE learning.
A FLEXIBLE METHOD ADAPTED TO YOUR SCHEDULE
We know your time is precious, especially when you're working or following training. Frello has been designed to fit into your daily life:
- Mobile learning: your French app follows you everywhere. Progress on transport, during your lunch break or from home.
- Micro-learning: short modules to stay motivated and practice the language daily.
- Personalized pace: resume your French lessons where you left off. No pressure, you manage your progress.
Download Frello and start learning!
Terms of use: https://www.frello.fr/cgu-apprenants
Privacy policy: https://www.frello.fr/politique-de-confidentialite

bluejetty:00126970:ios.summary:
REMARQUE SPÉCIFIQUE SUR LE TÉLÉCHARGEMENT

bluejetty:00126970:ios.description:
REMARQUE SPÉCIFIQUE SUR LE TÉLÉCHARGEMENT
*** Le téléchargement de cette appli se fait en 2 étapes : la première consiste à télécharger le modèle d’application, la deuxième consiste à télécharger entièrement le contenu de l’application. Cela peut prendre 5 à 10 minutes en Wi-Fi. Ne quittez pas l’appli avant d’avoir terminé les deux étapes de téléchargement. *** 
Actuellement, la quantité de données médicales double tous les 18 mois et le rythme s’accélère. Restez informés grâce à l’appli du Manuel MSD, version pour les professionnels de la santé.
L’appli du Manuel MSD, version pour les professionnels de la santé, propose aux prestataires de soins de santé, au personnel infirmier et aux étudiants des informations claires et pratiques sur des milliers de pathologies dans les principales spécialités médicales et chirurgicales. Elle aborde l’étiologie, la physiopathologie, le pronostic et les options d’évaluation et de traitement. 
L’appli du Manuel MSD, version pour les professionnels de la santé, propose :
• Des milliers de sujets rédigés et régulièrement mis à jour par plus de 350 médecins enseignants
• Des photographies et illustrations de milliers d’affections et de maladies
• Des vidéos pratiques sur de nombreuses procédures ambulatoires et consultations. Vidéos pédagogiques concises réalisées par des experts médicaux sur les principaux sujets suivants :
- Techniques d’immobilisation plâtrée et de contention
- Examens orthopédiques
- Examens neurologiques
- Procédures obstétriques
- Procédures ambulatoires (notamment IV, tubes, cathéters, réductions de luxations,...)
• Des questionnaires* de contrôle de connaissances des troubles médicaux, symptômes et traitements
• Des actualités médicales et des explications* sur des sujets médicaux courants et importants
• Des éditoriaux* rédigés par des experts médicaux qualifiés
* Un accès à Internet est nécessaire.
À propos des Manuels MSD
Notre mission est simple :
Nous pensons que les informations concernant la santé constituent un droit universel et que chacun a le droit d’avoir des informations médicales exactes, accessibles et exploitables. Nous avons la responsabilité de protéger, conserver et partager les meilleures informations médicales actuelles afin de permettre des décisions plus éclairées, d’améliorer les relations entre patients et professionnels, et d’améliorer les résultats thérapeutiques.
C’est pour cela que nous proposons gratuitement les Manuels MSD au format numérique aux professionnels et aux patients du monde entier. Aucun enregistrement ni inscription n’est nécessaire et il n’y a pas de publicités.
NOND-1179303-0001 04/16
Cette application est destinée aux professionnels de santé.
Pour plus d’informations, veuillez lire le contrat de licence d’utilisateur final sur
https://www.msd.com/policy/terms-of-use/home.html
Pour en savoir plus sur la protection des données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre politique de confidentialité sur https://www.msdprivacy.com
Signalement d’événement indésirable (EI) : pour signaler un EI survenant avec un produit MSD spécifique, contactez le centre de services national au 1-800-672-6372. Les pays autres que les États-Unis peuvent avoir des procédures spécifiques de signalement des EI. Pour plus d’informations, contactez votre bureau MSD local ou les autorités sanitaires de votre pays.
Pour toute question ou pour obtenir de l’aide, contactez-nous à msdmanualsinfo@msd.com

bluejetty:00178121:ios.description:
Embark on a laid-back journey with Tile Tap.
Tile Tap not only helps you unwind your mind but also creates a serene and Zen-like atmosphere. Dive into the Tile Tap world, where matching three tiles is more than just your average matching game—it's a thoughtfully crafted daily puzzle experience. Tile Tap adds a new twist to the classic matching game, seamlessly fitting into your everyday routine or leisurely travels, offering a variety of puzzles and challenges for your enjoyment.
Exercise your brain and relax with the game. Sharpen your mind and make your thought process smoother, one match at a time.
Enhance your memory. The easygoing gaming experience will relax you and clear your memory and brain, bringing joy to your recollections. With each match, your memory will improve, creating your unique memory model and constructing your memory palace.
Take on different puzzles and test your luck. Every flipped tile is an exciting challenge—a blend of strategy and luck.
After conquering challenges, craft your world. Build amazing areas and explore different landscapes, showcasing the stunning beauty of the world.
Dive into thrilling tile-matching puzzles that offer a unique mental boost in a calming atmosphere. Focus, relax, strategize, and let luck shine with each successful match. With simple rules and an addictive gameplay loop, your downtime transforms into a relaxation paradise.
Start your Tile Tap journey now - no need to wait!
Key Features:
* Immerse yourself in a distinctive block-centric matching game.
* Boost your cognitive skills by choosing matches, smashing tiles, and solving puzzles.
* Conquer hundreds of charming and refreshing levels.
* Unlock incredible treasure chests and enjoy generous rewards.
* Create your haven and appreciate the beauty of your land.
* Explore various geographical themes and styles, embarking on a global adventure!
Take a deep breath and step into the Tile Tap world. As you watch the sunset cast its warm glow onto the calm shore, your brain, and memory will experience a profound sense of relaxation.
It's Tile Tap time: come join us for the perfect blend of excitement and calm!

bluejetty:00073733:ios.description:
MyNetDiary’s Diabetes Tracker app is the easiest and most comprehensive diabetes tracker app for the iPhone. MyNetDiary can help you better understand and control diabetes and pre-diabetes - along with improving your diet, losing weight, providing feedback, support, and motivation.
MyNetDiary was featured in the 2017 Consumer Guide of Diabetes Forecast magazine, published by the American Diabetes Association, the world’s most trusted source of diabetes information. 
Designed for diabetes type 1, type 2, pre-diabetes and gestational diabetes.
USER REVIEWS
* This App (and website) has been a tremendous help in making lifestyle changes after being newly diagnosed as Type 2.
* This is the best app for diabetics trying to recover their health - without question.
* I spent a lot of time researching diabetes apps, then chose this one over a year ago and have been using it everyday since then. It has exceeded my expectations for diet management (still can't believe how much info they have on foods, food groups, and packaged foods!), lab and exercise tracking, and especially all aspects and ease of diabetes management. It gives me good personal feedback, keeps me on track, and has helped me and my physician meet my DM treatment goals. 
WHAT MAKES MYNETDIARY THE BEST DIABETES TRACKER
* Quick and easy logging
* Comprehensive blood glucose tracking. Custom pre- and post-meal target ranges. Highlights out-of-range readings.
* The best food and carb tracking - with a great food database, built-in barcode scanner and quickest entry. THE DATABASE IS UPDATED DAILY.
* Practical BG reminders
* Optional insulin tracking
* Medication tracking
* Supports total carbs, net carbs, and diabetes carb count
* Exercise tracking with built-in GPS Tracker, keeping track of walking, running, cycling
* Tracks your water intake
* A1C, LDL, HDL, BP tracking
* Custom trackers - track anything - quality of sleep, symptoms, and more.
* Detailed daily and weekly analysis, charts and reports.
WORKS WITH SIRI
• Create shortcuts checking calories, logging meals and water.
• Start and stop walking, running, and cycling workouts with built-in GPS tracker.
HEALTH APP INTEGRATION
* Syncs BG, foods, workouts, weight, BP, and more
OTHER HIGHLIGHTS
* Optional meal reminders
* Community supported by a Registered Dietitian
MyNetDiary for Apple Watch
* Check calories, BG averages, next BG check reminder
* Log foods, water and weight
PREMIUM RECIPES
Tasty, easy, and healthy recipes using simple, wholesome ingredients and 20 minutes or less of prep time.
POWERED BY MyNetDiary
* Syncs to the "cloud" for backup and online tracking
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
**Subscription Terms
MyNetDiary Premium subscription provides: sync with fitness trackers and body scales from FitBit, Garmin and Withings, premium recipes, special analysis, charts and reports, nutrient planning, step bonus calculation, and more. 
Subscription options:
$8.99/month
$59.99/year
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mynetdiary.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.mynetdiary.com/terms.html
DISCLAIMER
Diabetes Tracker by MyNetDiary is an educational tool, it is not a medical device, it is not a substitute for a medical device or medical care, and it does not provide diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment, or prevention of any disease.

bluejetty:00183375:ios.name: EveryPlate: Cooking Simplified
bluejetty:00183375:ios.summary: The EveryPlate app makes managing your meal plan as simple as cooking an EveryPlate recipe! Check out what's coming up on the menu, select the tasty dinners you want to cook, and access your past recipes all with just a simple tap. Plus, yo
bluejetty:00183375:ios.description:
The EveryPlate app makes managing your meal plan as simple as cooking an EveryPlate recipe! Check out what's coming up on the menu, select the tasty dinners you want to cook, and access your past recipes all with just a simple tap. Plus, you can skip a week or pause your meal plan at any time. Really!
EveryPlate is the smarter meal plan, offering value for money you won’t find at the supermarket. Enjoy everything you need to cook up tasty meals delivered to your door. And with our four-step recipes, you keep your weekly menu fuss free and simple. It’s a win-win!
With up to 20 recipes on the menu each week, EveryPlate is your own personal meal planner. Cook up a new recipe every night or enjoy your favourites on repeat. And with new custom recipe features, there's more ways than ever to make EveryPlate yours!
HOW DOES EVERYPLATE WORK?
1. Choose your meal plan: Pick the perfect meal plan for you. From as little as 3 to as many as 6 recipes per week, it's simple to pick the perfect box size for your household. 
2. Select your recipes: With up to 20 recipes to choose from each week, it's easy to cook up something everyone will love. Need something fast? Try our Speedy recipes for meals ready in 20 minutes. Or pick a crowd-pleaser with our Monthly Fave recipe. Each week's menu is available in advance, so you can get your meal plan sorted ahead of time.
3. We deliver your menu: No need to do the groceries, we deliver all the ingredients you need for your chosen recipes. Everything is pre-portioned, meaning there’s no waste or fuss.
4. Get cooking: Enjoy cooking smarter with four-step recipes and minimal mess. So you can spend less time in the kitchen and more time doing what you love. Plus, you can skip a week or pause your meal plan at any time.
WHY EVERYPLATE?
EveryPlate helps you cook up tasty recipes without the fuss. So you enjoy the satisfaction of dinner - done. With simple recipes and quality ingredients delivered, you save time and money at the supermarket. Tasty cooking without the hassle.
Great Value: Cook smarter with value for money you won’t find at the supermarket. Enjoy everything you need to cook up tasty recipes, delivered to your door. Meal plans starting at just $3.98 per plate.
Simple Cooking: Who said tasty had to be complicated? Get back to basics with familiar ingredients, four-step recipes and fuss-free cooking methods. Organise your meal plan in advance and stress less about what’s for dinner.
Tasty Recipes: Enjoy up to 20 recipes on the menu each week including vegetarian and classic options. Treat yourself to an extra-fancy meal with our Premium recipe options or cook a dish up fast with our Speedy recipes. With so many menu options to choose from, it’s like having a meal planner in your pocket!
EVERYPLATE APP FEATURES
Pick your recipes: Organise your meal plan and view the weekly menu in advance. Select your favourite recipes and add any extra meals if needed.
View previous recipes: Cook up your old favourites with our in-app cookbook. View past menus, recipe ingredients and cooking steps.
Manage your meal plan: Skip a week or pause your meal plan at any time. Change the number of recipes you receive or manage your menu preferences. Edit delivery and payment settings.
So, what are you waiting for? Let’s get cooking!

bluejetty:00042431:ios.description:
Science-based mental health app for stress, journaling, habit building, and emotional clarity.
Meet Flourish, a science-based, award-winning mental health and well-being app designed by psychologists, ready to help you manage stress, overcome everyday emotional challenges, and support personal growth. Whether you’re feeling stuck, unmotivated, overwhelmed, anxious, or simply need a calm space to think things through, Flourish helps you regain clarity, calm, and motivation — often in just a few minutes.
Who is Sunnie?
Sunnie is your AI-powered mental health companion, habit coach, and accountability buddy. Trained by psychologists, Sunnie listens, asks thoughtful questions, and offers science-based insights and coping tools to help you reflect, manage emotions, take meaningful actions, and build lasting habits. With long-term memory, Sunnie gets to know you better over time and can surface helpful insights and patterns. Sunnie communicates naturally through text, voice, and images for a more engaging, supportive experience.
Features
Guided Journaling & Reflection for Mental Health
Get thoughts out of your head and onto the page. Our iconic Memory Jar helps you build emotional awareness, gain clarity, and feel lighter — in just a few minutes.
Stress & Anxiety Relief Tools
From breathing exercises to meditation, discover interactive activities designed to calm your mind, ground your body, and help you reset — anytime, anywhere.
Healthy Habit Building for Well-Being
Create small, realistic habits for well-being, social connection, and motivation. Sunnie helps you stay accountable and cheers you on along the way.
Mental Clarity & Focus Support
Feeling overwhelmed or procrastinating? Use brain dumps, task breakdowns, Pomodoro timers, and gentle nudges to turn mental chaos into clear next steps.
Community & Connection
Meet one of the warmest, most supportive online communities. With Flourish buddies and the Flourish community, you can share well-being activities, inspire each other, and move through life’s ups and downs together.
Science-Based & Trusted
Flourish is built by PhD psychologists and grounded in affective science, motivation science, and behavior change research. It is one of the highest-rated AI mental health and well-being apps, validated through scientific studies led by researchers from top universities (including Stanford and Harvard), shown to improve positive emotions, resilience, and stress levels.
Built with your privacy in mind
- Messages are protected with end-to-end encryption
- You can delete any chats at any time
- Optional biometric lock adds an extra layer of protection
- Designed for private, secure mental health support you can trust
What people say
“Flourish reminded me how to care for myself again.”
“Even on bad days, Flourish helps me see the good.”
“This app gives me peace of mind when I need it most.”
“I’ve tried so many wellness apps. This one actually stuck.”
“It gives me space to feel what I’m feeling without judgment.”
“I didn’t think anything could help with my procrastination — this did.”
“I use it when I’m spiraling. It really helps.”
“It’s like therapy, but on my own terms.”
“Sunnie has become part of my daily routine.”
Who Flourish is for
- Anyone seeking mental health support for stress or anxiety
- Students and professionals juggling busy lives
- People who journal — or want to start
- Those seeking gentle support between therapy sessions
- Anyone who wants to feel a little better, one small step at a time
Start your journey toward a happier, calmer life with Flourish — a science-based mental health app you can trust
Website: myflourish.ai
Contact Us: hello@myflourish.ai
Privacy Policy: myflourish.ai/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00166447:ios.description:
Caloric: Your Ultimate Food and Fitness Companion
Welcome to Caloric, the all-in-one app designed to help you take control of your health and wellness journey. Whether you're looking to track your food intake, monitor your physical activity, or analyze your nutritional progress, Caloric is here to support you every step of the way.
Food Tracking Made Easy
Caloric provides a comprehensive food tracking experience, allowing you to effortlessly log your daily meals and snacks. With advanced food tracking features, you can:
- Track Food Using Your Mic: 
Simply speak to log your food intake. Just say what you ate, and Caloric does the rest.
- Scan Food Labels: 
Use your phone's camera to scan food labels and instantly add items to your diary.
- Custom Food Creation: 
Create and track custom food items that aren’t in the database. Perfect for homemade dishes or unique products.
Smart Recipe Management
Take your culinary adventures to the next level with Caloric’s recipe features:
- Recipe Tracking: 
Keep a record of the recipes you prepare and how they impact your nutrition.
- Recipe Filtering: 
Find the perfect recipe based on your dietary preferences, restrictions, or nutritional goals.
- Custom Recipe Creation: 
Develop and save your recipes, and track their nutritional content effortlessly.
- Favorite Recipes: 
Mark your go-to recipes for easy access anytime.
Activity Tracking and Fitness Integration
Stay active and informed with Caloric’s robust activity tracking capabilities:
- Track Steps: 
Monitor your daily steps and overall activity level.
- Activity Tracking Using Your Mic: 
Voice-activate your activity tracking for a hands-free experience.
- HealthKit and Fitbit Integration: 
Merge data from HealthKit and Fitbit into one seamless fitness tracker connection for a comprehensive overview of your physical activity.
In-Depth Nutrition Analysis
Gain valuable insights into your nutritional intake with Caloric:
- Detailed Macro Nutrition Analysis: 
Understand the breakdown of your macronutrients (carbs, proteins, fats) to ensure balanced eating.
- Daily Progress Tracking: 
Keep tabs on your daily progress for all essential nutrients and stay aligned with your health goals.
Personalized Wellness Monitoring
Track and optimize various aspects of your health:
- Daily Water Tracking: 
Ensure you’re staying hydrated with daily water intake tracking.
- Daily Weight Tracking: 
Monitor your weight trends to stay on top of your fitness progress.
Caloric is more than just a tracker; it’s a partner in your wellness journey. Download Caloric today and start optimizing your health with ease. 
Your path to a healthier you begins here!
Caloric integrates with Apple's Health app by:
Tracks Steps: 
Caloric syncs with the Health app to monitor your daily step count, helping you stay aware of your physical activity levels.
Monitors Activity: 
It pulls detailed activity data, including workouts and movement trends, to provide insights into your fitness progress and overall health.
Caloric is not a medical app. The suggested calorie intake goal is just an estimate based on your profile. Please consult your health provider if you want to use it for medical purposes or to obtain specific diet needs.
Privacy Policy: https://pixsterstudio.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://pixsterstudio.com/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00127862:ios.description:
Start your bubble adventure in a magic forest!
Woodland Bubble Pop is a match game to relax and unwind, providing a magical escape from the hustle of everyday life. It is a perfect brain-training and fast solution-making game. Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to dive into a more extended gaming session, Woodland Bubble Pop promises a bubbly and immersive experience that enchants you.
Woodland Bubble Pop is a fun and relaxing online game designed to train your matching skills and train your brain while having your rest. In this thrilling mobile app, you find yourself in magic, where dozens of colorful bubbles await your pops.
The game's user-friendly interface allows players of all ages to dive right in and enjoy the popping excitement. Test your skills with each level as the bubbles get more challenging to match, requiring precision to succeed and careful planning.
With the help of a wise squirrel, you should aim, shoot, and pop the same-colored bubbles. Collect shining gems, stars, coins, and more. Use fewer shots to score higher and earn bonuses and boosters like rockets, bombs, etc.
Get coins and collect them in your piggy bank. Use special boosters to pass those tricky levels.
Game Features:
- Easy and Addictive Gameplay: Woodland Bubble Pop features easy and addictive gameplay suitable for players of all ages. Aim your bubble launcher, create matching combinations, tap to shoot, and pop the bubbles!
- Exciting Levels and Challenges: Start your bubble adventure through a magic forest, and unlock new levels and chests. Every level brings an unforgettable twist.
- Strategic Bubble Shooting: Strategize your moves and create bubble combos. Plan your shots carefully and discover tricky ways to complete the tasks.

bluejetty:00172149:ios.description:
Welcome to fatsecret, the easiest to use calorie counter and most effective weight loss and dieting app on the market. Best of all, fatsecret is free.
The app is customized for US foods and brands.
Keep track of your food, exercise and weight, using the world's highest quality food and nutrition database and connect with a global community of people looking to make a change for the better and start losing weight and achieve your goals the healthy way. 
The app is available on Apple Watch and supports terrific Complications for your watch faces. 
The app is fully integrated with the Health app which lets you share your data with other Health connected apps. In particular you can:
- sync your Health app calories burned and steps in fatsecret
- add all your foods and their detailed nutritional information to the Health app
- sync your weight to the Health app
fatsecret is fast, simple to use and includes integration with external tools and services to help you succeed with your diet: 
- An easy to use food diary to plan and keep track of what you're eating.
- A wonderful community that's ready to provide support and turbo charge your weight loss.
- Image recognition of foods, meals and products so you can take photos with the camera and track nutrition with pictures. 
- A barcode scanner and auto-complete functions.
- Health app, and Fitbit exercise tracking integration.
- An exercise diary to record all the calories you burn.
- A diet calendar to see your calories consumed and burned.
- A weight tracker.
- Detailed reporting and goals for all your calories and macros.
- Photo album. #Photodiet #Foodsnap #Instacalorie
- A journal to record your progress. 
- Reminders for meals, weigh-ins and journals.
- Notifications for support, comments and followers.
- Fantastic recipes and meal ideas.
- Sharing and interacting with your professional of choice.
- Sign in with Apple, Facebook and Google login.
The app syncs with fatsecret Professional, the most convenient way to share your food, exercise and weight with your preferred health professional. Your health professional will get free access to simple and powerful tools to monitor your performance and provide you with feedback, advice and support.
You can also sync your account online to access your info anywhere, any time.
Premium subscriptions are available for enhanced features to help you achieve your diet and weight management goals. Premium users get:
- Nutritional meal plans created by our dietitian specifically for different diet preferences and calorie goals (Keto Style, Balanced, Mediterranean, Intermittent Fasting, High Protein Low Carb)
- Advanced Meal Planning: plan ahead and know in advance how many calories each meal contains
- Custom Meal Headings: Six additional meal types that allow you to spread your food intake across multiple points in the day
- Water Tracking: so you can make sure you reach a daily water intake goal
If you choose to upgrade to fatsecret Premium, we offer a range of subscription options, including monthly, quarterly, or annually.
Payment will be charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period at the same price and subscription type you previously purchased. 
Subscriptions can be managed through your iTunes account after purchase. It is not possible to refund or cancel a subscription during the period.
Terms of Use: https://www.fatsecret.com/Default.aspx?pa=tnc
We hope you'll love Calorie Counter by fatsecret. We are constantly working to improve the app and welcome user feedback.

bluejetty:00200106:ios.summary:
The best AI recording hardware?
You may already own it.
Turn your Apple Watch into your all-day AI recorder. Capture the words and the life around them. Give AI more than a question. Give it the context to understand your day.
ALL DAY. ON
bluejetty:00200106:ios.description:
The best AI recording hardware?
You may already own it.
Turn your Apple Watch into your all-day AI recorder. Capture the words and the life around them. Give AI more than a question. Give it the context to understand your day.
ALL DAY. ON YOUR WRIST.
Conversations at work. Ideas on a walk. Words from someone you love. Start recording on your Watch, tap to mark a moment, and revisit it on your iPhone.
Built for long sessions: in an Auday team test, Apple Watch Series 11 recorded for 12.5 hours with 49% battery remaining.
MORE THAN A RECORDING.
When your heart raced, what were you talking about? When things got tense, what was going on?
Bring conversations together with heart rate, stress estimates, activities, sleep and places. Follow body cues back to the original words. See more of the story, not just the transcript.
YOUR PERSONAL LIFE MENTOR.
Some questions deserve more than a generic answer.
"Could I have handled that conversation better?"
"What really matters to me in this relationship?"
"What should I take away from this week?"
Explore your questions with an AI grounded in your conversations, body context and lived moments. Get an outside perspective. Notice what you missed. Follow citations back to the words behind an answer.
REFLECT ON YOUR DAY. GROW FROM IT.
Revisit your timeline, discover Highlights and let AI bring your day together in a daily reflection. Look again at your feelings and choices. Take something from today into tomorrow.
MORE REMEMBERED. MORE UNDERSTOOD.
The people you care about. Your preferences. Plans mentioned in passing. Little details that make you, you.
Saved memories give future conversations a place to begin. Review, edit or deactivate them. You decide what stays.
SEARCH THE WAY YOU REMEMBER.
Forgot the exact words? Search by meaning instead. Find the conversation, the plan, the passing idea. Choose Efficient or Accurate on-device transcription, with 100 languages and variants in Accurate mode. Use keyword and semantic search on your iPhone. Optional personal voice recognition identifies your speech during on-device transcription. Export selected hours as audio, text and AI notes.
Then go beyond the transcript. Hear the voice. Feel the atmosphere. Replay saved audio and return to that moment.
ALMOST EVERYTHING RUNS LOCALLY.
WE DON'T EVEN HAVE SERVERS.
Your devices handle recording, on-device transcription, semantic search and archive storage.
You choose the AI. Connect a compatible provider with your own API key for Highlights, summaries, daily reflections and Chat. Relevant text and context go directly to that provider, never through an Auday server. These AI features do not upload original audio.
Optional cloud or self-hosted transcription sends audio directly to your chosen service only after separate consent. On-device transcription remains available.
CONNECT YOUR MEMORIES TO DESKTOP AI
With Auday Skill, bring saved transcripts, reflections and memories to a compatible desktop AI assistant. Use encrypted local transfer on the same Wi-Fi, with a read-only scope you choose and audio fetched when needed. Keep the iPhone connection page open during transfer. A cloud AI host may receive the excerpts you ask it to use.
BUY ONCE. NO AUDAY SUBSCRIPTION.
The local edition is a one-time purchase. Recording, local transcription, search and playback incur no AI provider fees. Optional AI uses your own provider and API key; provider charges are separate.
GOOD TO KNOW
Requires iOS 18+ and a paired Apple Watch with watchOS 11+. Health and location context are optional. Stress estimates support reflection, not medical diagnosis. Recording depends on battery, storage and system conditions; the battery figure is one team test, not a runtime guarantee. Audio follows your retention settings; keep important content separately. Give notice and obtain required consent before recording others.
Privacy Policy: https://auday.ai/privacy
Terms of Service: https://auday.ai/terms

bluejetty:00066004:ios.description:
As a Sports car racing driver, you dream about winning your first race all your life. Are you desperate to know what it feels like winning your first formula race, find it out for yourself. A lot of people think Formula racing isn't a sport, why don’t you sit in the driving seat of one of this car, try to rush past your opponent to the finishing line and tell us how it felt, try the expert mode to explore all your potential as sports car driver in grand racing championship 2018. Though this is not a manual racing car game, in which you have to have one hand on the gear and the other on the steering wheel, but we have given it the maximum possible touch, so you feel like a pro sports car racing driver in these crazy circuits.
This game offers the premium digital sports car race experience, with extensive Live Timing data from all Grand Prix sessions and the opponent cars competing against you, this game keeps a very interactive driver map, showing the live position of all the cars just like in vertigo racing or top speed speed car racing game of any sports car racing championship.
Enjoy driving in all the crazy racing tracks of the world and be the ultimate champion on all the tracks.
FEATURES
- Duels with other drivers from around the world
- 3 trophies to be earned on each track, i.e bronze, silver, gold
- 20 tracks divided into 3 different difficulties and track's length
- Races during daytime, sunset and night-time, desert & rainy tracks
- Ghosts of your personal, national and world record
- 20 countries to represent in Racing
- 3 achievements for unlocking and 3 leader boards
-REAL TIME MULTIPLAYER: Play free with players from around the world in real-time
-STUNNING GRAPHICS: Enjoy the feeling of being a real Sports car driver

bluejetty:00136503:ios.name: Learn Swahili For Beginners
bluejetty:00136503:ios.summary: Learn Swahili (Kiswahili) for travel, study, work and everyday life. Build your vocabulary and practice useful greetings and phrases. Read Swahili words alongside English meanings, then listen to the recordings and repeat at your own pace.
bluejetty:00136503:ios.description:
Learn Swahili (Kiswahili) for travel, study, work and everyday life. Build your vocabulary and practice useful greetings and phrases. Read Swahili words alongside English meanings, then listen to the recordings and repeat at your own pace.
HOW YOU LEARN
1. Choose a chapter, follow 15 Smart Levels or pick a Mini Course: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, or Health & Emergency.
2. Open a lesson and move through its learning cards. Read the Swahili word and English meaning, then tap to listen.
3. Choose the Zuri or Hamidi voice and adjust playback speed. Save words to Favorites and find vocabulary with Instant Search.
4. Review with flashcards, mark words you know, and practice with multiple-choice quizzes, True/False, word matching and typed-answer writing exercises.
5. Return to your saved progress, check in each day and build a routine with streaks and a daily reminder, with notification permission.
26 CHAPTERS, 252 LESSONS
Explore these chapters, with selected lesson examples:
• Foundation: Alphabets; Referential Words; Hello, Goodbye Phrases; Basic Numbering I; Days of the Week.
• Humanity: Body Structure; Facial Features.
• Adornments: Exterior Garments; Shoes & Boots.
• Cuisine: Beverages; Prepared Meals; Eating Establishments.
• Kinship: Kin & Extended Family; Domestic Living.
• Emotions: Sentiments & Moods; Chat & Dialogue.
• Pharmaceuticals: Illnesses & Conditions; Medical Professionals.
• Living Spaces: City Transit; Retail & Purchasing; Currency & Finance.
• Dwelling: Home Furnishings; Cooking Area; Home Improvement.
• Human Endeavors: Workspace; Trade & Shipping; Telephonic Talks.
• Human Tasks II: Media Outlets; Farming & Cultivation.
• Occupations: Corporate Professionals; Customer Service Careers.
• Athletics: Fitness Center; Soccer.
• Learning: Educational Institution; International Tongues.
• Creative Expressions: Film Industry; Written Works & Verse.
• Journey: Journeys & Voyages; Lodging; Outdoor Pursuits.
• Machinery: Digital Device; Online Network & Electronic Mail.
• Vehicles: Aircraft; Rail Vehicle; Flight Terminal.
• Automobiles: Automobile Varieties; Road Symbols.
• Milestones: Festivals & Celebrations; Streets, Paths & Navigation.
• Natural World: Main Compass Points; Marine Bodies.
• Planet Earth: Climate & Atmosphere Conditions; Cold Season & Snowfall.
• Animal Kingdom: Household Pets & Livestock; Aquatic Life & Sea Creatures.
• Plant Life: Blooms & Vegetation; Grain Crops & Seeds.
• Terrains: West European Nations; Urban Areas & Metropolises.
• Varied Topics: Miscellaneous Handy Terms; Descriptive Words & Qualifiers I.
MAKE SWAHILI PART OF YOUR DAY
Explore nouns and phrases collections. See check-in and learning days on a monthly calendar. Choose light or dark mode and a color theme, including Sunset. Export a manual backup of favorites, progress and included settings, then import a compatible backup when needed. Replay the introduction without losing your learning data.
HELP IS CLOSE BY
Spotted an audio, translation or example problem? Tap the flag on a word to prepare a support email with its chapter and lesson details. For app issues, purchases or suggestions, open Settings > Feedback & Support or email support@dugloapps.app.
No account registration is required. Bundled lessons and recordings work offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support email require internet access. The app uses an English interface and English meanings.
Some learning content is available without a purchase. Access to all lessons and premium features requires an in-app subscription or one-time purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://dugloapps.app/apps/learn-swahili/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
