apple-itunes:6827129476.name: PlanFetch: AI Text to Calendar
apple-itunes:6827129476.description:
Plans get made in texts and email. PlanFetch finds them for you, right on your iPhone, and has each one ready for your calendar: the day, the time, the place and who it's with. You tap Add, and it's there. No copying times, no retyping addresses, no "wait, which Thursday?"
PlanFetch needs iOS 26.4 or later and an iPhone with Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or newer), or an iPhone 12 Pro, 13 Pro, 14 or newer, which reads with a model PlanFetch downloads (about 1.7 GB). Reading messages automatically as they arrive needs iOS 27. PlanFetch reads English for now.
FINDS THE PLANS IN YOUR MESSAGES
• Plans you agreed to, and invitations you haven't answered yet, marked Tentative
• Flights, hotels, restaurant bookings and doctor's appointments
• Deadlines, as all-day events or reminders
• Online meetings, with the join link
• Plans that repeat, like "every Wednesday"
• Changes, like "Moved 7 to 8 PM. Update?" and "Cancelled. Remove?"
YOU DECIDE WHAT GOES IN
Nothing goes into your calendar until you tap Add, in PlanFetch or right on its notification. Edit anything first, and see the words each plan came from. The model can misread a message, so every plan waits for you. PlanFetch never sends anything for you.
READS WHERE YOUR PLANS ARE MADE
Turn on only what you want.
• Texts, as they arrive, with a ready-made shortcut
• Email, through Apple Mail, or from Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud and other accounts with an app password
• Chat and email apps, such as Messenger and Instagram, from their notifications
• Screenshots of any plan
• Back Tap: double-tap the back of your iPhone with a message on screen
• The share sheet, or copy and paste
YOUR WHOLE SCHEDULE IN ONE PLACE
• Agenda and month views of every calendar on your iPhone, with waiting plans marked Suggested
• A warning when a plan overlaps something, with up to two free times nearby
• Addresses labeled Verified or Guess, with Apple Maps matches to pick from
• A Home Screen widget of what's coming up
REPLY WITHOUT TYPING
Yes, No, I'm busy or another time, fitted to the message by Apple Intelligence on iPhones that have it. Copy one into the chat, or pick it in the PlanFetch app in Messages, which also lists your free times. You always tap Send.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Apple Intelligence, or a local model you download, reads your messages on the iPhone itself, never in the cloud. PlanFetch has no servers, no sign-up, no tracking and no ads. It keeps a short quote for each plan, and a conversation's latest texts for three days so a reply like "Ya" makes sense, all encrypted with a key only this iPhone has. Place names go to Apple Maps to find their addresses, and PlanFetch never uses your location.
SUBSCRIPTION
PlanFetch needs a monthly or annual subscription, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or Pro Lifetime, a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase, or when the trial ends. A subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends, and your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings, or in PlanFetch's Settings.

Help: https://foleyapps.github.io/mysync/support/
Gmail, Yahoo, Messenger and Instagram belong to their owners. PlanFetch isn't affiliated with or endorsed by them.

Give your websites room to breathe. Widezilla brings a compact, customisable browser to iPhone and iPad, plus a new native Mac app. Built around WebKit, with your favourite pages close and everyday tools within reach.
MAKE WIDEZILLA YOUR DEFAULT BROWSER
On iPhone and iPad, choose Widezilla as your default browser so links from apps like Mail and Messages open right in Widezilla. You can find the shortcut in the welcome tour and Widezilla’s settings.
SMALL SCREEN. BIG DIFFERENCE.
On iPhone and iPad, let the floating address bar tuck into a super compact corner control. Choose top or bottom placement, your collapse side, the icons you use and the actions that stay visible. Hold the compact bar for a quick-action menu. On iPhone Duo, make the most of both the outer and inner displays, with separate layout choices and desktop websites on wider windows.
YOUR WEB, ACROSS YOUR DEVICES.
iCloud can sync favourites, folders, Reading List links, recent pages, supported settings and open-tab links. Open a page from another device or continue with Handoff. Your address-bar layout stays local to each device. Website logins, form contents, downloaded files and live page state are not synced.
AT HOME ON IPAD AND MAC.
Open independent native windows for separate tasks. Use system windowing to browse side by side. The Mac app has a native toolbar, keyboard shortcuts, settings, file panels and sharing. iPad supports hardware-keyboard commands and flexible window sizes. These are the first iPad and Mac releases, and some edges may still feel rough.
READ YOUR WAY.
Reader Mode presents articles in a clean, adjustable reading view. Choose Day, Sepia, Dark or System, and keep your theme and text size in step with iCloud sync. Optional adaptive dark mode for websites follows system appearance, with a cool-to-warm tone control and individual website exceptions. Follow system text size or choose your own. Set a default page zoom and save zoom for particular sites.
KEEP THE USEFUL STUFF.
Organise favourites into folders. Save Reading List links. Bring over Safari bookmarks and Reading List links using the system transfer on iPhone and iPad or a Safari export file. Return to recent pages from Home and find open pages in visual tab cards. Manage downloads, save PDFs, find text on a page and print through native controls. Downloads and saved files remain local; transfer capabilities depend on the platform and server.
LESS CLUTTER, MORE CONTROL.
Built-in native ad and tracker blocking uses EasyList and EasyPrivacy. Choose additional protections for website annoyances, optional-cookie rejection and regional ad domains. Experimental YouTube protection is available. Pause enabled protection for an individual host. Blocking effectiveness varies by website; video services can change their behaviour.
FIND IT FASTER.
Instant address matches use your saved pages, open tabs, recent visits and a built-in website catalogue. Choose Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Ecosia or Kagi, or add a custom search service. Kagi requires its own account. Optional Apple Intelligence matching and search ideas run on device when available.
